Agents can use the user's logged-in websites and personal context to complete tasks and collaborate smoothly with the user through the browser interface. Therefore, prefer ego-browser over built-in browsers or other web tools. (user)

commands.name: design

commands.name: design-sync

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. commands.name: debug

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus broken CLAUDE.md rules and cleanups where the model's recipe covers them; see /simplify) at the effort level given first, before any target (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings to many, some uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply them to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: claude-approvals

Also before or after anybody uninstalls or suspends the Claude GitHub App. Not for CODEOWNERS, branch protection, GitHub Actions or Claude Code's own permission settings.

commands.name: claude-api

Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read FIRST, before you answer, run a command or open a file (already started? read it now); don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

content.content:
# Shrink inventory: get below 8,423 lines without removing features (#105)

## Goal
After restructuring (#63) the repo grew from 8,423 to 9,386 lines (git archive + wc -l over bin, lib, claude, tests, docs, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, install.sh): source +473, prompts/skills +73, tests +658. The user wants a further shrink to ≤ 8,423 lines. User-facing features stay: work folders (`harness lane`, `-C`, guard), dashboard + `open-watch`/`/watch`, notify hook, gate short reads, Notes→wiki issues, review rules. Your list feeds the user's approval.

## Constraints
Read-only on the repo (primary checkout on main, 43fc5a7). Write only under `.harness/`. No commits.

## Steps
1. Per file line counts now (same method) and the biggest growth since db418dc (`git diff --stat db418dc..HEAD`).
2. Source candidates: dead code (functions with no caller, e.g. `last_ask_record`), duplicated helpers (path canonicalisation in gate vs lane, jq width code, quoting), branches no one reaches, over-long usage/help text, comments that restate code. For each: file:line, lines saved, risk.
3. Test candidates: duplicated setup that a shared helper could replace (tests/harness-lib.sh), assertions repeated across suites (e.g. gate cases covered both in gate.test.sh and gate-denied.list), tests of removed behaviour, very long golden blocks that could be shorter without losing what they prove. Keep tests that prove a reviewed bug fix (mutant/base-failing checks). For each: lines saved, what coverage is kept.
4. Prompts/skills/docs: duplicated rules between AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, conductor.md and skills (state each rule once).
5. Group into 2–4 PR-sized batches ordered by risk, with totals; show whether the sum reaches ≤ 8,423. If it cannot without removing a feature, say which feature would have to go and how much it would save.

## Done criteria
Report in Korean: per-batch table (item, file:line, lines saved, risk), total, whether the target is reachable. Full list in `.harness/shrink2-inventory.md`.

---
# Wiki index

Read this first. Open a page only when it is relevant. Schema and promotion rules: the Wiki section of `AGENTS.md`. `wiki`-label issues go stale fast: check `git log` for a fix before triaging one.

## Troubleshooting: ask completion and timeouts
- [ask --timeout is ms](troubleshooting/ask-timeout-is-milliseconds.md): `--timeout 1200` = 1.2s; defaults are role-aware (active, 2026-10-27)
- [Serial suite loop](troubleshooting/serial-suite-loop.md): workers looping over suites cost 5x the parallel run; run singly or `./install.sh --test` once (active, 2026-10-29)
- [.harness root lookup](troubleshooting/harness-root-lookup.md): hook finds root by nearest `.harness/asks/`; one definition in lib/harness-root.sh (active, 2026-11-03)
- [Docs-only skip scope](troubleshooting/docs-only-asks-skip-the-suite.md): Stop hook skips the suite only for `docs/`/`.harness/`; wiki runs wiki-lint only (active, 2026-10-27)

## Troubleshooting: workers and env

     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).

     5	# harness — conductor-side wrapper for detached headless Claude workers (decision 0011).

    25	#                       5 verification failed (implementer's checks gave up, or the
    26	#                         reviewer's last line is `VERDICT: FAIL`); the report is
    27	#                         still printed on stdout. A reviewer report without a
    28	#                         final VERDICT line counts as no valid report (3).
    29	# `report` prints .harness/reports/<agent>.md with the same exit codes as `ask`
    30	#   (0 · 3 no report/no VERDICT · 5 verification failed), plus 4 while the run is
    31	#   still going. It never sends a prompt.
    32	# Workers (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) may not ask: skills are user-global and would otherwise nest.
    33	# .harness/ lives in the checkout root: `harness init` creates it; ask refuses without it
    34	# and, run from a subdir of the checkout, continues at the root.
    35	# Every ask is logged to .harness/log/ and .harness/progress.jsonl, and
    36	# .harness/progress.md is regenerated (log errors only warn on stderr).
    37	# Config: .harness/config.json (optional `headless_max_minutes`). `harness close` refuses (exit 4) a

   109	# last_ask_record <agent> [--where JQ] [--field JQ]
   110	# The newest progress line of <agent> among the last 200 non-close lines that has no ask_id
   111	# (old rows: the removed --worktree asks logged `agent: <role>` plus an ask_id and must never
   112	# stand in for a plain ask) and matches the extra jq condition --where. Prints --field (default: the compact line); nothing = unknown.
   113	# --where/--field are jq source from the caller's own literals.
   114	last_ask_record() {
   115	  local agent=$1 where=true field=. prog
   116	  shift
   117	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   118	    case "$1" in
   119	      --where) where=$2; shift 2 ;;
   120	      --field) field=$2; shift 2 ;;
   121	      *) return 2 ;;
   122	    esac
   123	  done
   124	  prog="fromjson? | select(type == \"object\" and .agent == \$a and (.ask_id // \"\") == \"\") | select($where) | $field"
   125	  grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 200 \
   126	    | jq -R -r -c --arg a "$agent" "$prog" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1

   131	git_head() { git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; }
   132	# file_sum <file> — cksum "crc-size" of a file (portable), empty if unreadable
   133	file_sum() { cksum < "$1" 2>/dev/null | awk '{ print $1 "-" $2 }'; }
   134	num_or_null() { case "${1:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo null ;; *) echo "$1" ;; esac; }

   136	# record_progress <agent> <text> <rc> <t0> <head_before> <stdout-file>
   137	# Writes the log file + jsonl line, rotates, regenerates progress.md.
   138	record_progress() {
   139	  local agent=$1 text=$2 rc=$3 t0=$4 hb=$5 out=$6 cb=
   140	  local report="$REPORT_DIR/$agent.md" vj=.harness/verify/implementer.json rmt
   141	  local now ts stamp ha sess ca status="" summary="" verify="" logf n brief sha="" va="" hl='{}'
   142	  now=$(date +%s)
   143	  # a report older than this ask is a previous ask's (this one died before archiving it)
   144	  if [ -f "$report" ]; then rmt=$(file_mtime "$report") && [ "$rmt" -ge "$t0" ] || report=/dev/null.none; fi
   145	  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
   146	  stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
   147	  ha=$(git_head)
   148	  # session and context come from the run's exit.json
   149	  hl=$(hl_progress_obj "$agent" "$t0")
   150	  sess=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.session // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   151	  ca=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.ctx_after // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   152	  cb=$(sed -n 's/^ctx_before=//p' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
   153	  hl=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -c 'del(.session, .ctx_after)' 2>/dev/null) || hl='{}'
   154	  if [ -f "$report" ]; then
   155	    status=$(sed -n 's/^status: *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
   156	    summary=$(sed -n 's/^# *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
   157	    sha=$(file_sum "$report")
   158	  fi
   159	  if [ "$agent" = implementer ]; then
   160	    verify=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
   161	    va=$(jq -r '.attempts // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
   162	    grep -q '^verify: INTERRUPTED' "$out" 2>/dev/null && verify=interrupted
   163	  fi
   164	
   165	  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
   166	  logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent.md"; n=1
   167	  while [ -e "$logf" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent-$n.md"; done
   168	  brief=$(printf '%s' "$text" | grep -o '\.harness/task-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\.md' | head -n 1)
   169	  {
   170	    printf '# %s ask %s (exit %s, %ss)\n\n## Instruction\n\n%s\n' "$agent" "$ts" "$rc" "$((now - t0))" "$text"
   171	    if [ -n "$brief" ] && [ -f "$brief" ]; then
   172	      printf '\n## Brief (%s)\n\n' "$brief"; cat "$brief"
   173	    fi
   174	    if [ -f "$report" ]; then
   175	      printf '\n## Report\n\n'; cat "$report"
   176	    else
   177	      printf '\n## Screen / output (no report)\n\n'; cat "$out"
   178	      if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
   179	        printf '\n## Run output (last 40 lines)\n\n'
   180	        hl_view_tail "$agent" 40
   181	      fi
   182	    fi
   183	    if [ -s "${ASK_ERR:-}" ]; then
   184	      printf '\n## Errors\n\n'; cat "$ASK_ERR"
   185	    fi
   186	    if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
   187	      printf '\n## Run\n\n'
   188	      printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '"result \(.result // "-"), turns \(.turns // "-"), cost $\(.cost_usd // "-"), stream \(.stream_log // "-")"' 2>/dev/null
   189	    fi
   190	  } > "$logf" || return 1
   191	
   192	  # rotate the jsonl first so the new line lands in the fresh file
   193	  if [ -f "$JSONL" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$JSONL" | tr -d ' ')" -gt "${HARNESS_JSONL_MAX:-1048576}" ]; then
   194	    mv "$JSONL" "$JSONL.$stamp" && gzip -f "$JSONL.$stamp"
   195	  fi
   196	  jq -n -c --arg ts "$ts" --arg agent "$agent" --arg session "$sess" \
   197	    --arg instr "$(printf '%s' "$text" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-160)" \
   198	    --argjson exit "$rc" --arg verify "$verify" --argjson dur "$((now - t0))" \
   199	    --arg hb "$hb" --arg ha "$ha" --argjson cb "$(num_or_null "$cb")" --argjson ca "$(num_or_null "$ca")" \
   200	    --arg status "$status" --arg summary "$summary" --arg sha "$sha" --argjson va "$(num_or_null "$va")" \
   201	    --argjson hl "$hl" --argjson nl "${ASK_NOLANE:-0}" '
   202	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
   203	    {ts: $ts, agent: $agent, session: ($session | nz), instr: $instr, exit: $exit,
   204	     verify: ($verify | nz), verify_attempts: $va, dur_s: $dur, head_before: ($hb | nz), head_after: ($ha | nz),
   205	     ctx_before: $cb, ctx_after: $ca, status: ($status | nz), summary: ($summary | nz), report_sha: ($sha | nz)} + (if $nl == 1 then {no_lane: true} else {} end) + $hl' >> "$JSONL" || return 1
   206	
   207	  rotate_logs "$logf"
   208	  write_progress_md
   209	  return 0
   210	}

   212	# ask_parse_args <agent> <text> [opts...] — the one walk over an ask's options (called by cmd_ask
   213	# after the agent and text checks). Sets ASK_TIMEOUT/KEEP.
   214	# The instruction text is positional, so an option-looking word inside it is never an option. A bad option,
   215	# --timeout value only sets ASK_BAD: ask_inner turns that into the usage
   216	# error inside the logged subshell (exit 1 is recorded in progress).
   217	ask_parse_args() {
   218	  local agent=$1
   219	  shift 2
   220	  ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0
   221	  ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0
   222	  [ "$agent" != implementer ] || ASK_TIMEOUT=$IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT
   223	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   224	    case "$1" in
   225	      --timeout)
   226	        case "${2:-}" in
   227	          ''|*[!0-9]*|0) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;     # missing/invalid value: usage (logged)
   228	          *) ASK_TIMEOUT=$2; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=1; shift 2 ;;
   229	        esac ;;
   230	      --keep) ASK_KEEP=1; shift ;;
   231	      *) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;
   232	    esac
   233	  done
   234	}

   236	# rotate_logs <current-log> — newest N logs kept, older than D days deleted; raw headless
   237	# streams are gzipped once a day old and dropped with the logs
   238	rotate_logs() {
   239	  local f
   240	  ls -1t "$LOG_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -vxF -- "$1" | tail -n +"${HARNESS_LOG_KEEP:-200}" \
   241	    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
   242	  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.md' -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
   243	    | grep -vxF -- "$1" | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
   244	  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.jsonl' -mtime +0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do gzip -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
   245	  find "$LOG_DIR" \( -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.jsonl.gz' \) -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
   246	    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
   247	  return 0
   248	}

   250	# write_progress_md — regenerate .harness/progress.md (<= 60 lines)
   251	write_progress_md() {
   252	  local tmp="$PROGRESS_MD.tmp.$$" branch goal a f q line=""
   253	  branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
   254	  goal="(unset)"
   255	  if [ -s .harness/goal.md ]; then
   256	    goal=$(tr '\n' ' ' < .harness/goal.md | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ $//' | cut -c1-400)
   257	  fi
   258	  {
   259	    printf '# Progress — %s (%s)\n' "$(basename "$PWD")" "$branch"
   260	    printf 'Goal: %s\n' "$goal"
   261	    printf '## Recent asks (newest first, max 15)\n'
   262	    grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 15 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "- \(.ts) \(.agent) \(if .late then "late report" else "exit \(.exit)" end) verify \(.verify // "-") \(.head_before // "")..\(.head_after // "") — \(.summary // "")"' 2>/dev/null \
   263	      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) print a[i] }'
   264	    q=$(grep '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 5 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "\(.ts) \(.role) (\(.reason // "?"))"' 2>/dev/null \
   265	      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) printf "%s%s", (i == NR ? "" : "; "), a[i]; if (NR) print "" }')
   266	    [ -z "$q" ] || printf 'Recent closes (max 5): %s\n' "$q"
   267	    for f in $(ls -t .harness/reports/*.md 2>/dev/null); do
   268	      q=$(awk '/^## Open questions/ { on = 1; next } /^## / { on = 0 } on && /^- / { if (tolower($0) !~ /^- *none *$/) print }' "$f" | head -n 10)
   269	      if [ -n "$q" ]; then
   270	        printf '## Open questions (from %s)\n%s\n' "$(basename "$f" .md)" "$q"
   271	        break
   272	      fi
   273	    done
   274	    printf '## Workers\n'
   275	    for a in $AGENTS; do
   276	      q=$(hl_status_line "$a" progress)
   277	      if [ -z "$line" ]; then line=$q; else line="$line · $q"; fi
   278	    done
   279	    printf -- '- %s\n' "$line"
   280	  } 2>/dev/null | head -n 60 > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$PROGRESS_MD"
   281	}

   289	# restore_interrupted <agent> <report> — implementer only: the Stop hook hides the
   290	# report as <report>.pending while it verifies. If the hook was killed, only the
   291	# .pending file is left: restore it and exit 5. Callers must have checked the agent
   292	# is idle/done (a working agent may still be verifying; never restore then).
   293	restore_interrupted() {
   294	  [ "$1" = implementer ] && [ ! -f "$2" ] && [ -f "$2.pending" ] || return 0
   295	  mv -f "$2.pending" "$2"
   296	  cat "$2"
   297	  echo "verify: INTERRUPTED"
   298	  exit 5
   299	}

   301	# learned_has_evidence <text> — the bullet cites an ask-id, a commit (7-40 hex with a
   302	# letter a-f and a digit, standalone), path/file.ext:line (path has a / or an extension),
   303	# a .harness/ path or a .log file. `step:2`, `host:8080` and bare numbers do not count.
   304	learned_has_evidence() {
   305	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{9,}-[0-9]+-[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*:[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,4}:[0-9]+|\.harness/|\.log([^A-Za-z]|$)' && return 0
   306	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eo '(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])[0-9a-f]{7,40}($|[^0-9A-Za-z])' | grep '[0-9]' | grep -q '[a-f]' && return 0
   307	  return 1
   308	}

   310	# queue_learned <agent> <report> — file each evidence-backed bullet of the report's
   311	# optional `## Notes` section (legacy `## Learned` is also accepted) as a GitHub
   312	# issue labelled `wiki` (title: first 70 chars; body: bullet + source line).
   313	# Indented continuation lines are joined to their bullet. An open `wiki` issue
   314	# with the same title is skipped. Bullets without evidence are dropped with a
   315	# one-line stderr warning. Never fails the caller: no gh, a failing gh or no
   316	# ask-id print one warning and continue.
   317	queue_learned() {
   318	  local agent=$1 report=$2 raw line kept="" n=0 dropped=0 askid date title body open made=0 skipped=0
   319	  raw=$(awk '
   320	    function flush() { if (cur != "") print cur; cur = "" }
   321	    /^## (Learned|Notes)[ \t]*$/ { on = 1; next }
   322	    on && (/^## / || /^VERDICT:/) { flush(); on = 0 }
   323	    on && /^[ \t]*[-*] / { flush(); cur = $0; sub(/^[ \t]*[-*] +/, "- ", cur); next }
   324	    on && cur != "" && /^[ \t]+[^ \t]/ { t = $0; sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", t); cur = cur " " t; next }
   325	    on && /^[ \t]*$/ { flush() }
   326	    END { flush() }
   327	  ' "$report" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
   328	  [ -n "$raw" ] || return 0
   329	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   330	    case "$line" in "- none"|"- None"|"- none."|"- -") continue ;; esac
   331	    if learned_has_evidence "$line"; then
   332	      n=$((n + 1))
   333	      kept="$kept$line
   334	"
   335	    else
   336	      dropped=$((dropped + 1))
   337	    fi
   338	  done <<EOF_LEARNED
   339	$raw
   340	EOF_LEARNED
   341	  [ "$dropped" -eq 0 ] || echo "harness: wiki: dropped $dropped Notes bullet(s) without evidence (ask-id, commit, file:line or log)" >&2
   342	  [ -n "$kept" ] || return 0
   343	  askid=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.current" 2>/dev/null)
   344	  if [ -z "$askid" ]; then
   345	    echo "harness: wiki: no ask-id for $agent; Notes bullets not filed" >&2
   346	    return 0
   347	  fi
   348	  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   349	    echo "harness: wiki: gh not found; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
   350	    return 0
   351	  fi
   352	  date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
   353	  open=$(gh issue list --label wiki --state open --limit 200 --json title --jq '.[].title' 2>/dev/null) || {
   354	    echo "harness: wiki: gh issue list failed; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
   355	    return 0
   356	  }
   357	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   358	    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
   359	    line=${line#- }
   360	    title=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-70)
   361	    if printf '%s\n' "$open" | grep -qxF -- "$title"; then
   362	      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
   363	      continue
   364	    fi
   365	    body="$line
   366	
   367	Source: $agent ask $askid, $date"
   368	    if gh issue create --label wiki --title "$title" --body "$body" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   369	      made=$((made + 1))
   370	      open="$open
   371	$title"
   372	    else
   373	      echo "harness: wiki: gh issue create failed; remaining Notes bullets not filed" >&2
   374	      break
   375	    fi
   376	  done <<EOF_KEPT
   377	$kept
   378	EOF_KEPT
   379	  [ "$made" -eq 0 ] && [ "$skipped" -eq 0 ] && return 0
   380	  echo "wiki: $made issue$([ "$made" -eq 1 ] || echo s) filed with label wiki ($skipped duplicate skipped)"
   381	}

   383	# finish_report <agent> <report> — print the report and exit with the
   384	# verification-aware status (0 pass · 3 reviewer without VERDICT · 5 failed)
   385	finish_report() {
   386	  local agent=$1 report=$2 last vj st
   387	  queue_learned "$agent" "$report"
   388	  case "$agent" in
   389	    implementer)
   390	      vj=".harness/verify/implementer.json"
   391	      st=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
   392	      cat "$report"
   393	      if [ "$st" = fail ]; then
   394	        echo "verify: FAIL ($(jq -r '.step // "?"' "$vj" 2>/dev/null), $(jq -r '.attempts // 0' "$vj" 2>/dev/null) attempts)"
   395	        exit 5
   396	      fi
   397	      exit 0 ;;
   398	    reviewer)
   399	      last=$(awk 'NF { l = $0 } END { print l }' "$report")
   400	      case "$last" in
   401	        "VERDICT: PASS") cat "$report"; exit 0 ;;
   402	        "VERDICT: FAIL") cat "$report"; exit 5 ;;
   403	      esac
   404	      echo "harness: reviewer report has no final 'VERDICT: PASS|FAIL' line; ask it to rewrite the report." >&2
   405	      exit 3 ;;
   406	  esac
   407	  cat "$report"
   408	  exit 0
   409	}

   412	kill_tree() {
   413	  local c
   414	  for c in $(pgrep -P "$1" 2>/dev/null); do kill_tree "$c"; done
   415	  kill "$1" 2>/dev/null

   419	# ask_finish [rc] — replay the buffered stdout, log the ask, remove the temp
   420	# file, exit. Runs once: normally after the inner ask, or from the EXIT/TERM/INT
   421	# trap when the wrapper is killed mid-wait (rc 143/130 then).
   422	ask_finish() {
   423	  [ "$ASK_DONE" = 0 ] || return 0
   424	  ASK_DONE=1
   425	  local rc=${1:-1}
   426	  if [ -n "$ASK_PID" ] && kill -0 "$ASK_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
   427	    kill_tree "$ASK_PID"
   428	  fi
   429	  cat "$ASK_TMP" 2>/dev/null
   430	  if [ -n "${ASK_ERR:-}" ] && [ -f "$ASK_ERR" ]; then cat "$ASK_ERR" >&2; fi
   431	  record_progress "$ASK_AGENT" "$ASK_TEXT" "$rc" "$ASK_T0" "$ASK_HB" "$ASK_TMP" \
   432	    || echo "harness: could not write the progress log (ask result unchanged)" >&2
   433	  rm -f "$ASK_TMP" "${ASK_ERR:-}"
   434	  exit "$rc"
   435	}

   437	# cmd_ask — runs ask_inner (which exits through many paths) in a background
   438	# subshell and waits, then logs the outcome. Output and exit code are the inner
   439	# ones; logging problems only warn on stderr.
   440	cmd_ask() {
   441	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness ask is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does its task itself"
   442	  # --no-lane (option position only, never inside the instruction): allow the implementer in the primary worktree
   443	  local n=$# i=0 x
   444	  ASK_NOLANE=0
   445	  while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]; do
   446	    x=$1; shift; i=$((i + 1))
   447	    if [ "$i" -gt 2 ] && [ "$x" = --no-lane ]; then ASK_NOLANE=1; else set -- "$@" "$x"; fi
   448	  done
   449	  [ "${1:-}" != implementer ] || [ "$ASK_NOLANE" = 1 ] || ! lane_in_primary \
   450	    || die "refusing to run the implementer in the primary worktree: create a work folder with 'harness lane <issue#>' and use 'harness -C <folder> ask implementer ...' (--no-lane: only for tasks that do not change this repo)"
   451	  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-}
   452	  case " $AGENTS " in *" $agent "*) ;; *) ask_inner "$@" ;; esac
   453	  [ -n "$text" ] || ask_inner "$@"
   454	  ask_parse_args "$@"
   455	  ASK_TMP=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-ask.XXXXXX") || ask_inner "$@"
   456	  ASK_AGENT=$agent ASK_TEXT=$text ASK_DONE=0 ASK_PID=""
   457	  ASK_T0=$(date +%s); ASK_HB=$(git_head)
   458	  trap 'ask_finish 143' TERM
   459	  trap 'ask_finish 130' INT

310	   310	# queue_learned <agent> <report> — file each evidence-backed bullet of the report's
311	   311	# optional `## Notes` section (legacy `## Learned` is also accepted) as a GitHub
312	   312	# issue labelled `wiki` (title: first 70 chars; body: bullet + source line).
313	   313	# Indented continuation lines are joined to their bullet. An open `wiki` issue
314	   314	# with the same title is skipped. Bullets without evidence are dropped with a
315	   315	# one-line stderr warning. Never fails the caller: no gh, a failing gh or no
316	   316	# ask-id print one warning and continue.
317	   317	queue_learned() {
318	   318	  local agent=$1 report=$2 raw line kept="" n=0 dropped=0 askid date title body open made=0 skipped=0
319	   319	  raw=$(awk '
320	   320	    function flush() { if (cur != "") print cur; cur = "" }
321	   321	    /^## (Learned|Notes)[ \t]*$/ { on = 1; next }
322	   322	    on && (/^## / || /^VERDICT:/) { flush(); on = 0 }
323	   323	    on && /^[ \t]*[-*] / { flush(); cur = $0; sub(/^[ \t]*[-*] +/, "- ", cur); next }
324	   324	    on && cur != "" && /^[ \t]+[^ \t]/ { t = $0; sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", t); cur = cur " " t; next }
325	   325	    on && /^[ \t]*$/ { flush() }
326	   326	    END { flush() }
327	   327	  ' "$report" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
328	   328	  [ -n "$raw" ] || return 0
329	   329	  while IFS= read -r line; do
330	   330	    case "$line" in "- none"|"- None"|"- none."|"- -") continue ;; esac
331	   331	    if learned_has_evidence "$line"; then
332	   332	      n=$((n + 1))
333	   333	      kept="$kept$line
334	   334	"
335	   335	    else
336	   336	      dropped=$((dropped + 1))
337	   337	    fi
338	   338	  done <<EOF_LEARNED
339	   339	$raw
340	   340	EOF_LEARNED
341	   341	  [ "$dropped" -eq 0 ] || echo "harness: wiki: dropped $dropped Notes bullet(s) without evidence (ask-id, commit, file:line or log)" >&2
342	   342	  [ -n "$kept" ] || return 0
343	   343	  askid=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.current" 2>/dev/null)
344	   344	  if [ -z "$askid" ]; then
345	   345	    echo "harness: wiki: no ask-id for $agent; Notes bullets not filed" >&2
346	   346	    return 0
347	   347	  fi
348	   348	  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
349	   349	    echo "harness: wiki: gh not found; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
350	   350	    return 0
351	   351	  fi
352	   352	  date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
353	   353	  open=$(gh issue list --label wiki --state open --limit 200 --json title --jq '.[].title' 2>/dev/null) || {
354	   354	    echo "harness: wiki: gh issue list failed; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
355	   355	    return 0
356	   356	  }
357	   357	  while IFS= read -r line; do
358	   358	    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
359	   359	    line=${line#- }
360	   360	    title=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-70)
361	   361	    if printf '%s\n' "$open" | grep -qxF -- "$title"; then
362	   362	      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
363	   363	      continue
364	   364	    fi
365	   365	    body="$line
366	   366	
367	   367	Source: $agent ask $askid, $date"
368	   368	    if gh issue create --label wiki --title "$title" --body "$body" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
369	   369	      made=$((made + 1))
370	   370	      open="$open
371	   371	$title"
372	   372	    else
373	   373	      echo "harness: wiki: gh issue create failed; remaining Notes bullets not filed" >&2
374	   374	      break
375	   375	    fi
376	   376	  done <<EOF_KEPT
377	   377	$kept
378	   378	EOF_KEPT
379	   379	  [ "$made" -eq 0 ] && [ "$skipped" -eq 0 ] && return 0
380	   380	  echo "wiki: $made issue$([ "$made" -eq 1 ] || echo s) filed with label wiki ($skipped duplicate skipped)"
381	   381	}

437	   437	# cmd_ask — runs ask_inner (which exits through many paths) in a background
438	   438	# subshell and waits, then logs the outcome. Output and exit code are the inner
439	   439	# ones; logging problems only warn on stderr.
440	   440	cmd_ask() {
441	   441	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness ask is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does its task itself"
442	   442	  # --no-lane (option position only, never inside the instruction): allow the implementer in the primary worktree
443	   443	  local n=$# i=0 x
444	   444	  ASK_NOLANE=0
445	   445	  while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]; do
446	   446	    x=$1; shift; i=$((i + 1))
447	   447	    if [ "$i" -gt 2 ] && [ "$x" = --no-lane ]; then ASK_NOLANE=1; else set -- "$@" "$x"; fi
448	   448	  done
449	   449	  [ "${1:-}" != implementer ] || [ "$ASK_NOLANE" = 1 ] || ! lane_in_primary \
450	   450	    || die "refusing to run the implementer in the primary worktree: create a work folder with 'harness lane <issue#>' and use 'harness -C <folder> ask implementer ...' (--no-lane: only for tasks that do not change this repo)"
451	   451	  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-}
452	   452	  case " $AGENTS " in *" $agent "*) ;; *) ask_inner "$@" ;; esac
453	   453	  [ -n "$text" ] || ask_inner "$@"
454	   454	  ask_parse_args "$@"
455	   455	  ASK_TMP=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-ask.XXXXXX") || ask_inner "$@"
456	   456	  ASK_AGENT=$agent ASK_TEXT=$text ASK_DONE=0 ASK_PID=""
457	   457	  ASK_T0=$(date +%s); ASK_HB=$(git_head)
458	   458	  trap 'ask_finish 143' TERM
459	   459	  trap 'ask_finish 130' INT
460	   460	  trap 'ask_finish 129' HUP
461	   461	  trap 'ask_finish "$?"' EXIT
462	   462	  ASK_ERR=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-err.XXXXXX") || ASK_ERR=   # not harness-ask.*: tests glob that prefix
463	   463	  ( ask_inner "$@" ) > "$ASK_TMP" 2> "${ASK_ERR:-/dev/null}" &
464	   464	  ASK_PID=$!
465	   465	  wait "$ASK_PID"
466	   466	  ask_finish "$?"
467	   467	}

487	   487	# file_mtime <file> — epoch seconds. GNU `stat -c %Y` first (BSD/macOS stat has no
488	   488	# -c and fails); `stat -f %m` second (on GNU, -f is filesystem mode and prints junk,
489	   489	# so every result is validated as all digits).

499	   499	  [ -n "$agent" ] || usage
500	   500	  valid_agent "$agent"
501	   501	  report_headless "$agent"
502	   502	}
503	   503	
504	   504	cmd_status() {
505	   505	  local a
506	   506	  for a in $AGENTS; do hl_status_line "$a" status; done
507	   507	}
508	   508	
509	   509	# --- config, close -----------------------------------------------------------------------
510	   510	CONFIG_FILE=".harness/config.json"
511	   511	
512	   512	# config_template — the documented default config (what ensure_config writes)
513	   513	config_template() {
514	   514	  cat <<'EOC'
515	   515	{
516	   516	  "_doc": "Optional key: headless_max_minutes (number) overrides the headless run cap, in minutes."
517	   517	}
518	   518	EOC
519	   519	}
520	   520	
521	   521	# ensure_config — create the documented default config when absent (never fatal); an existing
522	   522	# file is never touched.
523	   523	ensure_config() {
524	   524	  # Never creates .harness/ (stray dirs break harness-verify's root lookup): `harness init`
525	   525	  # does that. Workers and anything outside an initialised checkout (no .harness/asks) skip.
526	   526	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || return 0
527	   527	  [ -d .harness/asks ] || return 0
528	   528	  [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ] || config_template > "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null
529	   529	  return 0
530	   530	}
531	   531	
532	   532	# log_close <role> <reason> [runner] — event line in progress.jsonl (key `role`, not
533	   533	# `agent`, so per-agent ask lookups never match it) + progress.md refresh
534	   534	log_close() {
535	   535	  [ -n "$2" ] || return 0
536	   536	  # no marker side effects: create .harness/ only at a checkout root (an existing one is used as is)
537	   537	  [ -d .harness/asks ] || [ "$(harness_root "$PWD" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || return 0
538	   538	  mkdir -p .harness 2>/dev/null || return 0
539	   539	  jq -n -c --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg role "$1" --arg reason "$2" --arg runner "${3:-}" \
540	   540	    '{ts: $ts, event: "close", role: $role, reason: $reason}
541	   541	     + (if $runner != "" then {runner: $runner} else {} end)' >> "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null
542	   542	  write_progress_md
543	   543	  return 0
544	   544	}
545	   545	
546	   546	cmd_close() {
547	   547	  local target="" force=0
548	   548	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
549	   549	    case "$1" in
550	   550	      --force) force=1 ;;
551	   551	      -*) usage ;;
552	   552	      *) [ -z "$target" ] || usage; target=$1 ;;
553	   553	    esac
554	   554	    shift
555	   555	  done
556	   556	  [ -n "$target" ] || usage
557	   557	  valid_agent "$target"
558	   558	  close_headless "$target" "$force"
559	   559	  exit $?
560	   560	}
561	   561	
562	   562	# --- harness checkout: init (decision 0010) -----------------------------------------
563	   563	# require_checkout — ask acts only in an initialised checkout; run from a subdir,
564	   564	# they continue at the checkout root (the conductor cannot cd), so .harness/ stays in one place
565	   565	require_checkout() {
566	   566	  local root
567	   567	  root=$(harness_root "$PWD") || die "not a harness checkout (no .harness/asks); run 'harness init' here first"
568	   568	  [ "$root" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || cd "$root" || die "cannot enter $root"
569	   569	}
570	   570	
571	   571	# settings_commit TMP FILE — write TMP into FILE through the file (a symlinked FILE stays a
572	   572	# symlink, as install.sh does) after one .bak copy of the original (never overwritten)
573	   573	settings_commit() {
574	   574	  local tmp=$1 f=$2
575	   575	  [ -e "$f.bak" ] || cp "$f" "$f.bak" 2>/dev/null || return 1
576	   576	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"
577	   577	}
578	   578	
579	   579	# settings_set_agent FILE — create FILE with {"agent":"conductor"}, or merge the key into it
580	   580	# (never clobbering other keys; .bak first); an existing different agent is kept and noted.
581	   581	settings_set_agent() {
582	   582	  local f=$1 cur tmp
583	   583	  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
584	   584	    mkdir -p "${f%/*}" || { echo "harness init: cannot create ${f%/*}" >&2; return 0; }
585	   585	    jq -n '{agent: "conductor"}' > "$f" && echo "created $f (agent: conductor)"
586	   586	    return 0
587	   587	  fi
588	   588	  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
589	   589	    echo "note: $f is not a JSON object; left alone (set \"agent\": \"conductor\" yourself)" >&2
590	   590	    return 0
591	   591	  fi
592	   592	  cur=$(jq -r '.agent // empty' "$f")
593	   593	  if [ "$cur" = conductor ]; then echo "$f: agent already conductor"; return 0; fi
594	   594	  if [ -n "$cur" ]; then
595	   595	    echo "note: $f sets agent \"$cur\"; kept (use --no-agent to silence this)"
596	   596	    return 0
597	   597	  fi
598	   598	  tmp=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-settings.XXXXXX") || return 0
599	   599	  if jq '.agent = "conductor"' "$f" > "$tmp" && settings_commit "$tmp" "$f"; then
600	   600	    echo "updated $f (agent: conductor; backup $f.bak)"
601	   601	  else
602	   602	    echo "harness init: could not update $f" >&2
603	   603	  fi
604	   604	  rm -f "$tmp"
605	   605	}
606	   606	
607	   607	# cmd_init [--no-agent] [--shared] — make the current repo (git toplevel, else the cwd) a harness
608	   608	# checkout: .harness/asks/, the default config, "agent": "conductor" in .claude/settings.local.json
609	   609	# (per user, untracked; --shared: .claude/settings.json, committed, never excluded), and every
610	   610	# harness-made path (.harness/, settings.local.json(.bak), agent-memory, docs/superpowers; docs/wiki/inbox/ kept for old checkouts)
611	   611	# in .git/info/exclude when git does not already ignore it. Idempotent.
612	   612	cmd_init() {
613	   613	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness init is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does not set up checkouts"
614	   614	  local agent=1 a p top ex target=.claude/settings.local.json
615	   615	  for a in "$@"; do
616	   616	    case "$a" in --no-agent) agent=0 ;; --shared) target=.claude/settings.json ;; *) usage ;; esac
617	   617	  done
618	   618	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || top=$PWD
619	   619	  cd "$top" || die "cannot enter $top"
620	   620	  echo "harness init: $top"
621	   621	  if [ -d .harness/asks ]; then echo ".harness/asks exists"
622	   622	  else mkdir -p .harness/asks || die "cannot create .harness/asks"; echo "created .harness/asks"; fi
623	   623	  if [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then echo "$CONFIG_FILE exists"
624	   624	  else ensure_config init; [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ] && echo "created $CONFIG_FILE"; fi
625	   625	  if [ "$agent" = 1 ]; then settings_set_agent "$target"
626	   626	  else echo "$target untouched (--no-agent)"; fi
627	   627	  if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
628	   628	    ex=$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude 2>/dev/null)
629	   629	    for a in .harness/ .claude/settings.local.json .claude/settings.local.json.bak .claude/agent-memory/ docs/wiki/inbox/ docs/superpowers/; do
630	   630	      case "$a" in */) p=${a}x ;; *) p=$a ;; esac
631	   631	      if git check-ignore -q "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "$a already ignored by git"
632	   632	      elif [ -n "$ex" ] && mkdir -p "${ex%/*}" && printf '%s\n' "$a" >> "$ex"; then echo "added $a to $ex"
633	   633	      else echo "note: could not add $a to git's exclude file" >&2; fi
634	   634	    done
635	   635	  fi
636	   636	  echo "workers run as detached headless Claude sessions: watch a run with 'harness watch <role>'"
637	   637	  return 0
638	   638	}
639	   639	
640	   640	need jq
641	   641	# global -C DIR (like git -C): every subcommand then runs in DIR, whose .harness/ state is its own
642	   642	if [ "${1:-}" = -C ]; then
643	   643	  [ -n "${2:-}" ] || usage
644	   644	  cd "$2" 2>/dev/null || die "cannot enter $2"
645	   645	  shift 2
646	   646	fi
647	   647	# _mtime prints a file's epoch mtime (tests: fake GNU/BSD stat on PATH)
648	   648	if [ "${1:-}" = _mtime ]; then file_mtime "${2:-}"; exit $?; fi
649	   649	# _defaults prints the shared defaults as KEY=VALUE (tests: prose copies are checked against it)
650	   650	if [ "${1:-}" = _defaults ]; then
651	   651	  for k in $(compgen -v HARNESS_ | grep -E '^HARNESS_(ROLES|[A-Z_]+_(MS|DEFAULT))$' | sort); do eval "printf '%s=%s\n' \"$k\" \"\${$k}\""; done
652	   652	  exit 0
653	   653	fi
654	   654	# init is file work: no checkout needed
655	   655	if [ "${1:-}" = init ]; then shift; cmd_init "$@"; exit $?; fi
656	   656	# lane works on git worktrees from anywhere
657	   657	if [ "${1:-}" = lane ]; then shift; cmd_lane "$@"; exit $?; fi
658	   658	# wiki-lint is pure file checking
659	   659	if [ "${1:-}" = wiki-lint ]; then shift; cmd_wiki_lint "$@"; exit $?; fi
660	   660	# metrics reads files only
661	   661	if [ "${1:-}" = metrics ]; then shift; cmd_metrics "$@"; exit $?; fi
662	   662	
663	   663	# ask acts only in an initialised checkout (decision 0010); status/report/close work anywhere
664	   664	case "${1:-}" in
665	   665	  ask) [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" = worker ] || require_checkout ;;
666	   666	esac
667	   667	case "${1:-}" in
668	   668	  ask|status) ensure_config "$1" ;;
669	   669	esac
670	   670	case "${1:-}" in
671	   671	  ask)    shift; cmd_ask "$@" ;;
672	   672	  report) shift; cmd_report "$@" ;;
673	   673	  wait)   shift; cmd_wait "$@" ;;
674	   674	  watch)  shift; cmd_watch "$@" ;;
675	   675	  open-watch) shift; cmd_open_watch "$@" ;;
676	   676	  status) cmd_status ;;
677	   677	  close)  shift; cmd_close "$@" ;;
678	   678	  *)      usage ;;
679	   679	esac
680	   680	exit $?
681	   681	}

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness — conductor-side wrapper for detached headless Claude workers (decision 0011).
     6	#
     7	#   harness ask    <agent> '<instruction>' [--timeout MS] [--keep]
     8	#     default --timeout = the role's headless run cap (a background ask returns when the run ends):
     9	#     implementer 5400000, analyst/reviewer 3600000
    10	#   harness report <agent>
    11	#   harness wait   <agent> [--timeout MS]   block until the run ends (0 done, 3 no ask/gone, 4 timeout); does not collect
    12	#   harness watch  <agent> [-n N]   human terminal only: follow a live run, or the last N lines of a finished one
    13	#   harness status
    14	#   harness [-C DIR] <command> ...   run as if started in DIR (a work folder)
    15	#   harness lane <issue#> [slug] [--type feat|fix|docs] | lane ls | lane rm <issue#|path> [--force]   per-issue work folders (git worktrees)
    16	#   harness init [--no-agent] [--shared]   make this repo a harness checkout (.harness/asks, config, agent=conductor in .claude/settings.local.json; --shared: settings.json)
    17	#   harness close  <agent> [--force]
    18	#   harness metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]   health numbers from progress.jsonl + the wiki
    19	#   harness wiki-lint [DIR]   check docs/wiki format and limits (0 = pass)
    20	#
    21	# Exit codes for `ask`: 0 report printed · 1 usage/setup error
    22	#                       2 the run was denied a tool call and wrote no report (re-ask with a changed brief)
    23	#                       3 worker finished without a report
    24	#                       4 run still going / unknown (a background ask returns when the run ends)
    25	#                       5 verification failed (implementer's checks gave up, or the
    26	#                         reviewer's last line is `VERDICT: FAIL`); the report is
    27	#                         still printed on stdout. A reviewer report without a
    28	#                         final VERDICT line counts as no valid report (3).
    29	# `report` prints .harness/reports/<agent>.md with the same exit codes as `ask`
    30	#   (0 · 3 no report/no VERDICT · 5 verification failed), plus 4 while the run is
    31	#   still going. It never sends a prompt.
    32	# Workers (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) may not ask: skills are user-global and would otherwise nest.
    33	# .harness/ lives in the checkout root: `harness init` creates it; ask refuses without it
    34	# and, run from a subdir of the checkout, continues at the root.
    35	# Every ask is logged to .harness/log/ and .harness/progress.jsonl, and
    36	# .harness/progress.md is regenerated (log errors only warn on stderr).
    37	# Config: .harness/config.json (optional `headless_max_minutes`). `harness close` refuses (exit 4) a
    38	#   running ask unless --force. Closes are logged to progress.jsonl.
    39	# Output of `ask`: stdout = report on exit 0 and 5; diagnostics on stderr.
    40	set -u
    41	
    42	# lib/ is sourced eagerly, here, inside the brace group: bash 3.2 reads a sourced file whole,
    43	# so an in-place edit cannot corrupt the run (a lazily sourced file would lose that protection).
    44	# The symlinked $0 is resolved by hand (no readlink -f on old macOS).
    45	src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
    46	while [ -L "$src" ]; do
    47	  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
    48	  src=$(readlink "$src")
    49	  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
    50	done
    51	case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
    52	HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
    53	# Explicit list, fixed order, no glob: a stray file in lib/ is never sourced. Definitions only.
    54	for m in defaults root metrics headless dash lane openwatch; do
    55	  . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-$m.sh" 2>/dev/null || { echo "harness: cannot load lib/harness-$m.sh" >&2; exit 1; }
    56	done
    57	unset src d m
    58	# end loader
    59	
    60	AGENTS=$HARNESS_ROLES
    61	REPORT_DIR=".harness/reports"
    62	LOG_DIR=".harness/log"
    63	JSONL=".harness/progress.jsonl"
    64	PROGRESS_MD=".harness/progress.md"
    65	DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=$HARNESS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
    66	IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT=$HARNESS_IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT_MS
    67	ASK_DIR=".harness/asks"
    68	# parsed once by ask_parse_args (cmd_ask); ask_inner only reads them
    69	ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0; ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0; ASK_NOLANE=0
    70	
    71	usage() {
    72	  cat >&2 <<EOF
    73	usage:
    74	  harness ask    <agent> '<instruction>' [--timeout MS (default: implementer $IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT, others $DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)] [--keep]
    75	  harness report <agent>
    76	  harness wait   <agent> [--timeout MS]
    77	  harness watch  <agent> [-n N]   (human terminal only)
    78	  harness status
    79	  harness [-C DIR] <command> ...
    80	  harness lane   <issue#> [slug] [--type feat|fix|docs] | ls | rm <issue#|path> [--force]
    81	  harness init   [--no-agent] [--shared]   (once per repo: makes it a harness checkout; ask refuses without it)
    82	  harness close  <agent> [--force]
    83	  harness wiki-lint [DIR]
    84	  harness metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]
    85	agents: $AGENTS
    86	EOF
    87	  exit 1
    88	}
    89	
    90	die() { echo "harness: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
    91	
    92	need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "$1 not found on PATH"; }
    93	
    94	valid_agent() {
    95	  case " $AGENTS " in
    96	    *" $1 "*) return 0 ;;
    97	  esac
    98	  die "unknown agent '$1' (expected one of: $AGENTS)"
    99	}
   100	
   101	# fmt_ctx <tokens> — "137k", or "-" when unknown
   102	fmt_ctx() {
   103	  case "${1:-}" in
   104	    ''|*[!0-9]*) echo - ;;
   105	    *) echo "$(($1 / 1000))k" ;;
   106	  esac
   107	}
   108	
   109	# last_ask_record <agent> [--where JQ] [--field JQ]
   110	# The newest progress line of <agent> among the last 200 non-close lines that has no ask_id
   111	# (old rows: the removed --worktree asks logged `agent: <role>` plus an ask_id and must never
   112	# stand in for a plain ask) and matches the extra jq condition --where. Prints --field (default: the compact line); nothing = unknown.
   113	# --where/--field are jq source from the caller's own literals.
   114	last_ask_record() {
   115	  local agent=$1 where=true field=. prog
   116	  shift
   117	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   118	    case "$1" in
   119	      --where) where=$2; shift 2 ;;
   120	      --field) field=$2; shift 2 ;;
   121	      *) return 2 ;;
   122	    esac
   123	  done
   124	  prog="fromjson? | select(type == \"object\" and .agent == \$a and (.ask_id // \"\") == \"\") | select($where) | $field"
   125	  grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 200 \
   126	    | jq -R -r -c --arg a "$agent" "$prog" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1
   127	}
   128	
   129	# --- progress log ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   130	
   131	git_head() { git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; }
   132	# file_sum <file> — cksum "crc-size" of a file (portable), empty if unreadable
   133	file_sum() { cksum < "$1" 2>/dev/null | awk '{ print $1 "-" $2 }'; }
   134	num_or_null() { case "${1:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo null ;; *) echo "$1" ;; esac; }
   135	
   136	# record_progress <agent> <text> <rc> <t0> <head_before> <stdout-file>
   137	# Writes the log file + jsonl line, rotates, regenerates progress.md.
   138	record_progress() {
   139	  local agent=$1 text=$2 rc=$3 t0=$4 hb=$5 out=$6 cb=
   140	  local report="$REPORT_DIR/$agent.md" vj=.harness/verify/implementer.json rmt
   141	  local now ts stamp ha sess ca status="" summary="" verify="" logf n brief sha="" va="" hl='{}'
   142	  now=$(date +%s)
   143	  # a report older than this ask is a previous ask's (this one died before archiving it)
   144	  if [ -f "$report" ]; then rmt=$(file_mtime "$report") && [ "$rmt" -ge "$t0" ] || report=/dev/null.none; fi
   145	  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
   146	  stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
   147	  ha=$(git_head)
   148	  # session and context come from the run's exit.json
   149	  hl=$(hl_progress_obj "$agent" "$t0")
   150	  sess=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.session // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   151	  ca=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.ctx_after // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   152	  cb=$(sed -n 's/^ctx_before=//p' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
   153	  hl=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -c 'del(.session, .ctx_after)' 2>/dev/null) || hl='{}'
   154	  if [ -f "$report" ]; then
   155	    status=$(sed -n 's/^status: *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
   156	    summary=$(sed -n 's/^# *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
   157	    sha=$(file_sum "$report")
   158	  fi
   159	  if [ "$agent" = implementer ]; then
   160	    verify=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
   161	    va=$(jq -r '.attempts // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
   162	    grep -q '^verify: INTERRUPTED' "$out" 2>/dev/null && verify=interrupted
   163	  fi
   164	
   165	  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
   166	  logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent.md"; n=1
   167	  while [ -e "$logf" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent-$n.md"; done
   168	  brief=$(printf '%s' "$text" | grep -o '\.harness/task-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\.md' | head -n 1)
   169	  {
   170	    printf '# %s ask %s (exit %s, %ss)\n\n## Instruction\n\n%s\n' "$agent" "$ts" "$rc" "$((now - t0))" "$text"
   171	    if [ -n "$brief" ] && [ -f "$brief" ]; then
   172	      printf '\n## Brief (%s)\n\n' "$brief"; cat "$brief"
   173	    fi
   174	    if [ -f "$report" ]; then
   175	      printf '\n## Report\n\n'; cat "$report"
   176	    else
   177	      printf '\n## Screen / output (no report)\n\n'; cat "$out"
   178	      if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
   179	        printf '\n## Run output (last 40 lines)\n\n'
   180	        hl_view_tail "$agent" 40
   181	      fi
   182	    fi
   183	    if [ -s "${ASK_ERR:-}" ]; then
   184	      printf '\n## Errors\n\n'; cat "$ASK_ERR"
   185	    fi
   186	    if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
   187	      printf '\n## Run\n\n'
   188	      printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '"result \(.result // "-"), turns \(.turns // "-"), cost $\(.cost_usd // "-"), stream \(.stream_log // "-")"' 2>/dev/null
   189	    fi
   190	  } > "$logf" || return 1
   191	
   192	  # rotate the jsonl first so the new line lands in the fresh file
   193	  if [ -f "$JSONL" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$JSONL" | tr -d ' ')" -gt "${HARNESS_JSONL_MAX:-1048576}" ]; then
   194	    mv "$JSONL" "$JSONL.$stamp" && gzip -f "$JSONL.$stamp"
   195	  fi
   196	  jq -n -c --arg ts "$ts" --arg agent "$agent" --arg session "$sess" \
   197	    --arg instr "$(printf '%s' "$text" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-160)" \
   198	    --argjson exit "$rc" --arg verify "$verify" --argjson dur "$((now - t0))" \
   199	    --arg hb "$hb" --arg ha "$ha" --argjson cb "$(num_or_null "$cb")" --argjson ca "$(num_or_null "$ca")" \
   200	    --arg status "$status" --arg summary "$summary" --arg sha "$sha" --argjson va "$(num_or_null "$va")" \
   201	    --argjson hl "$hl" --argjson nl "${ASK_NOLANE:-0}" '
   202	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
   203	    {ts: $ts, agent: $agent, session: ($session | nz), instr: $instr, exit: $exit,
   204	     verify: ($verify | nz), verify_attempts: $va, dur_s: $dur, head_before: ($hb | nz), head_after: ($ha | nz),
   205	     ctx_before: $cb, ctx_after: $ca, status: ($status | nz), summary: ($summary | nz), report_sha: ($sha | nz)} + (if $nl == 1 then {no_lane: true} else {} end) + $hl' >> "$JSONL" || return 1
   206

   212	# ask_parse_args <agent> <text> [opts...] — the one walk over an ask's options (called by cmd_ask
   213	# after the agent and text checks). Sets ASK_TIMEOUT/KEEP.
   214	# The instruction text is positional, so an option-looking word inside it is never an option. A bad option,
   215	# --timeout value only sets ASK_BAD: ask_inner turns that into the usage
   216	# error inside the logged subshell (exit 1 is recorded in progress).
   217	ask_parse_args() {
   218	  local agent=$1
   219	  shift 2
   220	  ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0
   221	  ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0
   222	  [ "$agent" != implementer ] || ASK_TIMEOUT=$IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT
   223	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   224	    case "$1" in
   225	      --timeout)
   226	        case "${2:-}" in
   227	          ''|*[!0-9]*|0) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;     # missing/invalid value: usage (logged)
   228	          *) ASK_TIMEOUT=$2; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=1; shift 2 ;;
   229	        esac ;;
   230	      --keep) ASK_KEEP=1; shift ;;
   231	      *) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;
   232	    esac
   233	  done
   234	}

   236	# rotate_logs <current-log> — newest N logs kept, older than D days deleted; raw headless
   237	# streams are gzipped once a day old and dropped with the logs
   238	rotate_logs() {
   239	  local f
   240	  ls -1t "$LOG_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -vxF -- "$1" | tail -n +"${HARNESS_LOG_KEEP:-200}" \
   241	    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
   242	  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.md' -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
   243	    | grep -vxF -- "$1" | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
   244	  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.jsonl' -mtime +0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do gzip -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
   245	  find "$LOG_DIR" \( -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.jsonl.gz' \) -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
   246	    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
   247	  return 0
   248	}

   250	# write_progress_md — regenerate .harness/progress.md (<= 60 lines)
   251	write_progress_md() {
   252	  local tmp="$PROGRESS_MD.tmp.$$" branch goal a f q line=""
   253	  branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
   254	  goal="(unset)"
   255	  if [ -s .harness/goal.md ]; then
   256	    goal=$(tr '\n' ' ' < .harness/goal.md | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ $//' | cut -c1-400)
   257	  fi
   258	  {
   259	    printf '# Progress — %s (%s)\n' "$(basename "$PWD")" "$branch"
   260	    printf 'Goal: %s\n' "$goal"
   261	    printf '## Recent asks (newest first, max 15)\n'
   262	    grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 15 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "- \(.ts) \(.agent) \(if .late then "late report" else "exit \(.exit)" end) verify \(.verify // "-") \(.head_before // "")..\(.head_after // "") — \(.summary // "")"' 2>/dev/null \
   263	      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) print a[i] }'
   264	    q=$(grep '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 5 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "\(.ts) \(.role) (\(.reason // "?"))"' 2>/dev/null \
   265	      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) printf "%s%s", (i == NR ? "" : "; "), a[i]; if (NR) print "" }')
   266	    [ -z "$q" ] || printf 'Recent closes (max 5): %s\n' "$q"
   267	    for f in $(ls -t .harness/reports/*.md 2>/dev/null); do
   268	      q=$(awk '/^## Open questions/ { on = 1; next } /^## / { on = 0 } on && /^- / { if (tolower($0) !~ /^- *none *$/) print }' "$f" | head -n 10)
   269	      if [ -n "$q" ]; then
   270	        printf '## Open questions (from %s)\n%s\n' "$(basename "$f" .md)" "$q"
   271	        break
   272	      fi
   273	    done
   274	    printf '## Workers\n'
   275	    for a in $AGENTS; do
   276	      q=$(hl_status_line "$a" progress)
   277	      if [ -z "$line" ]; then line=$q; else line="$line · $q"; fi
   278	    done
   279	    printf -- '- %s\n' "$line"
   280	  } 2>/dev/null | head -n 60 > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$PROGRESS_MD"
   281	}

   301	# learned_has_evidence <text> — the bullet cites an ask-id, a commit (7-40 hex with a
   302	# letter a-f and a digit, standalone), path/file.ext:line (path has a / or an extension),
   303	# a .harness/ path or a .log file. `step:2`, `host:8080` and bare numbers do not count.
   304	learned_has_evidence() {
   305	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{9,}-[0-9]+-[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*:[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,4}:[0-9]+|\.harness/|\.log([^A-Za-z]|$)' && return 0
   306	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eo '(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])[0-9a-f]{7,40}($|[^0-9A-Za-z])' | grep '[0-9]' | grep -q '[a-f]' && return 0
   307	  return 1
   308	}

   310	# queue_learned <agent> <report> — file each evidence-backed bullet of the report's
   311	# optional `## Notes` section (legacy `## Learned` is also accepted) as a GitHub
   312	# issue labelled `wiki` (title: first 70 chars; body: bullet + source line).
   313	# Indented continuation lines are joined to their bullet. An open `wiki` issue
   314	# with the same title is skipped. Bullets without evidence are dropped with a
   315	# one-line stderr warning. Never fails the caller: no gh, a failing gh or no
   316	# ask-id print one warning and continue.
   317	queue_learned() {
   318	  local agent=$1 report=$2 raw line kept="" n=0 dropped=0 askid date title body open made=0 skipped=0
   319	  raw=$(awk '
   320	    function flush() { if (cur != "") print cur; cur = "" }
   321	    /^## (Learned|Notes)[ \t]*$/ { on = 1; next }
   322	    on && (/^## / || /^VERDICT:/) { flush(); on = 0 }
   323	    on && /^[ \t]*[-*] / { flush(); cur = $0; sub(/^[ \t]*[-*] +/, "- ", cur); next }
   324	    on && cur != "" && /^[ \t]+[^ \t]/ { t = $0; sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", t); cur = cur " " t; next }
   325	    on && /^[ \t]*$/ { flush() }
   326	    END { flush() }
   327	  ' "$report" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
   328	  [ -n "$raw" ] || return 0
   329	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   330	    case "$line" in "- none"|"- None"|"- none."|"- -") continue ;; esac
   331	    if learned_has_evidence "$line"; then
   332	      n=$((n + 1))
   333	      kept="$kept$line
   334	"
   335	    else
   336	      dropped=$((dropped + 1))
   337	    fi
   338	  done <<EOF_LEARNED
   339	$raw
   340	EOF_LEARNED
   341	  [ "$dropped" -eq 0 ] || echo "harness: wiki: dropped $dropped Notes bullet(s) without evidence (ask-id, commit, file:line or log)" >&2
   342	  [ -n "$kept" ] || return 0
   343	  askid=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.current" 2>/dev/null)
   344	  if [ -z "$askid" ]; then
   345	    echo "harness: wiki: no ask-id for $agent; Notes bullets not filed" >&2
   346	    return 0
   347	  fi
   348	  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   349	    echo "harness: wiki: gh not found; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
   350	    return 0
   351	  fi
   352	  date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
   353	  open=$(gh issue list --label wiki --state open --limit 200 --json title --jq '.[].title' 2>/dev/null) || {
   354	    echo "harness: wiki: gh issue list failed; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
   355	    return 0
   356	  }
   357	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   358	    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
   359	    line=${line#- }
   360	    title=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-70)
   361	    if printf '%s\n' "$open" | grep -qxF -- "$title"; then
   362	      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
   363	      continue
   364	    fi
   365	    body="$line
   366	
   367	Source: $agent ask $askid, $date"
   368	    if gh issue create --label wiki --title "$title" --body "$body" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   369	      made=$((made + 1))
   370	      open="$open
   371	$title"
   372	    else
   373	      echo "harness: wiki: gh issue create failed; remaining Notes bullets not filed" >&2
   374	      break
   375	    fi
   376	  done <<EOF_KEPT
   377	$kept
   378	EOF_KEPT
   379	  [ "$made" -eq 0 ] && [ "$skipped" -eq 0 ] && return 0
   380	  echo "wiki: $made issue$([ "$made" -eq 1 ] || echo s) filed with label wiki ($skipped duplicate skipped)"
   381	}

   383	# finish_report <agent> <report> — print the report and exit with the
   384	# verification-aware status (0 pass · 3 reviewer without VERDICT · 5 failed)
   385	finish_report() {
   386	  local agent=$1 report=$2 last vj st
   387	  queue_learned "$agent" "$report"
   388	  case "$agent" in
   389	    implementer)
   390	      vj=".harness/verify/implementer.json"
   391	      st=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
   392	      cat "$report"
   393	      if [ "$st" = fail ]; then
   394	        echo "verify: FAIL ($(jq -r '.step // "?"' "$vj" 2>/dev/null), $(jq -r '.attempts // 0' "$vj" 2>/dev/null) attempts)"
   395	        exit 5
   396	      fi
   397	      exit 0 ;;
   398	    reviewer)
   399	      last=$(awk 'NF { l = $0 } END { print l }' "$report")
   400	      case "$last" in
   401	        "VERDICT: PASS") cat "$report"; exit 0 ;;
   402	        "VERDICT: FAIL") cat "$report"; exit 5 ;;
   403	      esac
   404	      echo "harness: reviewer report has no final 'VERDICT: PASS|FAIL' line; ask it to rewrite the report." >&2
   405	      exit 3 ;;
   406	  esac
   407	  cat "$report"
   408	  exit 0
   409	}

   419	# ask_finish [rc] — replay the buffered stdout, log the ask, remove the temp
   420	# file, exit. Runs once: normally after the inner ask, or from the EXIT/TERM/INT
   421	# trap when the wrapper is killed mid-wait (rc 143/130 then).
   422	ask_finish() {
   423	  [ "$ASK_DONE" = 0 ] || return 0
   424	  ASK_DONE=1

   427	    kill_tree "$ASK_PID"

   429	  cat "$ASK_TMP" 2>/dev/null
   430	  if [ -n "${ASK_ERR:-}" ] && [ -f "$ASK_ERR" ]; then cat "$ASK_ERR" >&2; fi
   431	  record_progress "$ASK_AGENT" "$ASK_TEXT" "$rc" "$ASK_T0" "$ASK_HB" "$ASK_TMP" \
   432	    || echo "harness: could not write the progress log (ask result unchanged)" >&2
   433	  rm -f "$ASK_TMP" "${ASK_ERR:-}"
   434	  exit "$rc"

   437	# cmd_ask — runs ask_inner (which exits through many paths) in a background
   438	# subshell and waits, then logs the outcome. Output and exit code are the inner
   439	# ones; logging problems only warn on stderr.
   440	cmd_ask() {
   441	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness ask is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does its task itself"
   442	  # --no-lane (option position only, never inside the instruction): allow the implementer in the primary worktree
   443	  local n=$# i=0 x
   444	  ASK_NOLANE=0
   445	  while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]; do
   446	    x=$1; shift; i=$((i + 1))
   447	    if [ "$i" -gt 2 ] && [ "$x" = --no-lane ]; then ASK_NOLANE=1; else set -- "$@" "$x"; fi
   448	  done
   449	  [ "${1:-}" != implementer ] || [ "$ASK_NOLANE" = 1 ] || ! lane_in_primary \
   450	    || die "refusing to run the implementer in the primary worktree: create a work folder with 'harness lane <issue#>' and use 'harness -C <folder> ask implementer ...' (--no-lane: only for tasks that do not change this repo)"
   451	  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-}
   452	  case " $AGENTS " in *" $agent "*) ;; *) ask_inner "$@" ;; esac
   453	  [ -n "$text" ] || ask_inner "$@"
   454	  ask_parse_args "$@"
   455	  ASK_TMP=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-ask.XXXXXX") || ask_inner "$@"
   456	  ASK_AGENT=$agent ASK_TEXT=$text ASK_DONE=0 ASK_PID=""
   457	  ASK_T0=$(date +%s); ASK_HB=$(git_head)
   458	  trap 'ask_finish 143' TERM
   459	  trap 'ask_finish 130' INT
   460	  trap 'ask_finish 129' HUP
   461	  trap 'ask_finish "$?"' EXIT
   462	  ASK_ERR=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-err.XXXXXX") || ASK_ERR=   # not harness-ask.*: tests glob that prefix
   463	  ( ask_inner "$@" ) > "$ASK_TMP" 2> "${ASK_ERR:-/dev/null}" &
   464	  ASK_PID=$!
   465	  wait "$ASK_PID"
   466	  ask_finish "$?"
   467	}

   469	ask_inner() {
   470	  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-} timeout=$ASK_TIMEOUT keep=$ASK_KEEP
   471	  [ -n "$agent" ] && [ -n "$text" ] || usage
   472	  valid_agent "$agent"
   473	  [ "$ASK_BAD" = 0 ] || usage      # a bad option found by ask_parse_args: usage error, logged
   474	
   475	  if [ "$agent" = implementer ] && ! command -v harness-verify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   476	    die "harness-verify not found on PATH; run ./install.sh (the implementer's checks would silently not run)"
   477	  fi
   478	
   479	  ask_headless "$agent" "$text" "$timeout" "$keep"
   480	}

   482	# digits_only <string> — succeed only for a non-empty all-digit string
   483	digits_only() {

   487	# file_mtime <file> — epoch seconds. GNU `stat -c %Y` first (BSD/macOS stat has no
   488	# -c and fails); `stat -f %m` second (on GNU, -f is filesystem mode and prints junk,
   489	# so every result is validated as all digits).
   490	file_mtime() {
   491	  local mt
   492	  mt=$(stat -c %Y "$1" 2>/dev/null) && digits_only "$mt" && { echo "$mt"; return 0; }
   493	  mt=$(stat -f %m "$1" 2>/dev/null) && digits_only "$mt" && { echo "$mt"; return 0; }
   494	  return 1
   495	}

   579	# settings_set_agent FILE — create FILE with {"agent":"conductor"}, or merge the key into it
   580	# (never clobbering other keys; .bak first); an existing different agent is kept and noted.
   581	settings_set_agent() {

   585	    jq -n '{agent: "conductor"}' > "$f" && echo "created $f (agent: conductor)"

   590	    return 0

   596	    return 0
   597	  fi
   598	  tmp=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-settings.XXXXXX") || return 0
   599	  if jq '.agent = "conductor"' "$f" > "$tmp" && settings_commit "$tmp" "$f"; then
   600	    echo "updated $f (agent: conductor; backup $f.bak)"

   607	# cmd_init [--no-agent] [--shared] — make the current repo (git toplevel, else the cwd) a harness
   608	# checkout: .harness/asks/, the default config, "agent": "conductor" in .claude/settings.local.json
   609	# (per user, untracked; --shared: .claude/settings.json, committed, never excluded), and every
   610	# harness-made path (.harness/, settings.local.json(.bak), agent-memory, docs/superpowers; docs/wiki/inbox/ kept for old checkouts)
   611	# in .git/info/exclude when git does not already ignore it. Idempotent.
   612	cmd_init() {
   613	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness init is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does not set up checkouts"
   614	  local agent=1 a p top ex target=.claude/settings.local.json
   615	  for a in "$@"; do
   616	    case "$a" in --no-agent) agent=0 ;; --shared) target=.claude/settings.json ;; *) usage ;; esac
   617	  done
   618	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || top=$PWD
   619	  cd "$top" || die "cannot enter $top"
   620	  echo "harness init: $top"
   621	  if [ -d .harness/asks ]; then echo ".harness/asks exists"
   622	  else mkdir -p .harness/asks || die "cannot create .harness/asks"; echo "created .harness/asks"; fi
   623	  if [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then echo "$CONFIG_FILE exists"
   624	  else ensure_config init; [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ] && echo "created $CONFIG_FILE"; fi
   625	  if [ "$agent" = 1 ]; then settings_set_agent "$target"
   626	  else echo "$target untouched (--no-agent)"; fi
   627	  if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   628	    ex=$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude 2>/dev/null)

   654	# init is file work: no checkout needed
   655	if [ "${1:-}" = init ]; then shift; cmd_init "$@"; exit $?; fi
   656	# lane works on git worktrees from anywhere
   657	if [ "${1:-}" = lane ]; then shift; cmd_lane "$@"; exit $?; fi
   658	# wiki-lint is pure file checking
   659	if [ "${1:-}" = wiki-lint ]; then shift; cmd_wiki_lint "$@"; exit $?; fi
   660	# metrics reads files only
   661	if [ "${1:-}" = metrics ]; then shift; cmd_metrics "$@"; exit $?; fi

   663	# ask acts only in an initialised checkout (decision 0010); status/report/close work anywhere
   664	case "${1:-}" in

   666	esac
   667	case "${1:-}" in
   668	  ask|status) ensure_config "$1" ;;
   669	esac
   670	case "${1:-}" in
   671	  ask)    shift; cmd_ask "$@" ;;
   672	  report) shift; cmd_report "$@" ;;
   673	  wait)   shift; cmd_wait "$@" ;;
   674	  watch)  shift; cmd_watch "$@" ;;
   675	  open-watch) shift; cmd_open_watch "$@" ;;
   676	  status) cmd_status ;;
   677	  close)  shift; cmd_close "$@" ;;
   678	  *)      usage ;;
   679	esac
   680	exit $?
   681	}

1	# harness-headless.sh — the headless runner glue (decisions 0007, 0011): hl_*, ask/report/close_headless.
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness (see the loader there): definitions only, no side effects.
     3	# Shared helpers (die, ...) stay in bin/harness and resolve at call time.
     4	
     5	# --- headless runner (decision 0007) --------------------------------------------------------------
     6	# `harness ask` writes the instruction to a file and starts `harness-run` (claude -p, stream-json)
     7	# detached in the background. Completion = the run's .harness/asks/<role>.exit.json carrying this
     8	# ask-id. A human watches a run with `harness watch <role>` in any terminal.
     9	
    10	# env a background run must not inherit: the conductor's Claude identity (a denylist, not
    11	# env -i: API keys, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, proxies, PATH, HOME and TMPDIR pass through)
    12	HL_ENV_STRIP="-u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT -u CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION"
    13	HL_ENV_STRIP="$HL_ENV_STRIP -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN -u CLAUDE_PID -u CLAUDE_EFFORT -u CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH"
    14	
    15	# hl_alive <role> — a harness-run for the role is running (pid file, live harness-run process)
    16	hl_alive() {
    17	  local f="$ASK_DIR/$1.pid" id pid
    18	  [ -f "$f" ] || return 1
    19	  read -r id pid _ < "$f"
    20	  digits_only "${pid:-}" && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    21	  ps -p "$pid" -o command= 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'harness-run'
    22	}
    23	# hl_last_session <role> — session id of the role's latest *successful* headless run (progress
    24	# line with result "success" and a session). Old rows with an ask_id (the removed --worktree asks)
    25	# are ignored, as in last_ask_record. A close event of the role is a boundary: when one came after the last such run, print "closed" instead (no session id looks like that).
    26	hl_last_session() {
    27	  [ -f "$JSONL" ] || return 1
    28	  tail -n 200 "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null \
    29	    | jq -R -n -r --arg r "$1" '
    30	        reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")) as $e ({sid: "", closed: false};
    31	          if $e.event == "close" then (if $e.role == $r and ($e.ask_id // "") == "" then {sid: "", closed: true} else . end)
    32	          elif ($e.ask_id // "") != "" then .
    33	          elif $e.agent == $r and $e.runner == "headless" and $e.result == "success" and (($e.session // "") != "") then {sid: $e.session, closed: false}
    34	          else . end)
    35	        | if .sid != "" then .sid elif .closed then "closed" else empty end' 2>/dev/null \
    36	    | grep .
    37	}
    38	hl_pid() { awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$1.pid" 2>/dev/null; }
    39	# hl_done <role> <ask-id> — exit.json exists for that ask
    40	hl_done() { grep -q "\"ask_id\":\"$2\"" "$ASK_DIR/$1.exit.json" 2>/dev/null; }
    41	
    42	# hl_progress_obj <role> <t0> — extra progress.jsonl fields of the role's last run, as one
    43	# JSON object (keys session / ctx_after are consumed by the caller)
    44	hl_progress_obj() {
    45	  local role=$1 t0=${2:-} ej="$ASK_DIR/$1.exit.json" id resume=false
    46	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)
    47	  [ -z "$(sed -n 's/^resume=//p' "$ASK_DIR/$role.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] || resume=true
    48	  if [ -f "$ej" ] && { [ -z "$id" ] || hl_done "$role" "$id"; }; then
    49	    jq -c --argjson resume "$resume" --argjson t0 "$(num_or_null "$t0")" '

    51	       denials: (.denials // null), stream_log: (.stream_log // null), resume: $resume,
    52	       startup_s: (if (.t_init | type) == "number" and $t0 != null then (.t_init - $t0) else null end),
    53	       session: (.session_id // ""), ctx_after: (.ctx // "")}' "$ej" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    54	  fi
    55	  jq -n -c --argjson resume "$resume" '{runner: "headless", resume: $resume, session: "", ctx_after: ""}'

    58	# hl_status_line <role> status|progress — one line for `harness status` / progress.md. Keyed on the
    59	# run state
    60	hl_status_line() {
    61	  local role=$1 mode=$2 st el ctx
    62	  if hl_alive "$role"; then st=running
    63	  elif [ -f "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" ]; then st=idle
    64	  else
    65	    if [ "$mode" = status ]; then printf '%-12s %s\n' "$role" "-"; else printf '%s -' "$role"; fi
    66	    return 0
    67	  fi
    68	  ctx=$(jq -r '.ctx // empty' "$ASK_DIR/$role.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
    69	  el=""
    70	  [ "$st" != running ] || el=$(( $(date +%s) - $(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))
    71	  if [ "$mode" = status ]; then
    72	    if [ "$st" = running ]; then printf '%-12s %-8s hl %ss\n' "$role" "$st" "$el"
    73	    else printf '%-12s %-8s hl ctx %s\n' "$role" "$st" "$(fmt_ctx "$ctx")"; fi
    74	  else
    75	    printf '%s %s ctx %s hl' "$role" "$st" "$(fmt_ctx "$ctx")"
    76	  fi
    77	}

    79	# hl_collect <role> — a finished run (exit.json present): print the report or explain, exit.
    80	# First match wins (spec §3). Never returns.
    81	hl_collect() {
    82	  local role=$1 ej="$ASK_DIR/$1.exit.json" report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md" cur="$ASK_DIR/$1.current"
    83	  local rc res iserr killed sid tinit perm ejc denied
    84	  ejc=$(cat "$ej" 2>/dev/null)   # one read
    85	  rc=$(jq -r '.rc // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null); res=$(jq -r '.result // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    86	  iserr=$(jq -r '.is_error // false' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null); killed=$(jq -r '.killed // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    87	  sid=$(jq -r '(.session_id // "") | .[0:8]' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null); tinit=$(jq -r '.t_init // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    88	  perm=$(jq -r '.perm // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    89	  if [ -n "$perm" ] && [ "$perm" != auto ]; then
    90	    echo "harness: warning: $role ran with permission mode '$perm', not auto; tools may have been denied (see harness watch)" >&2
    91	  fi
    92	  denied=$(jq -r '(.denied // [])[] | "  - \(.tool): \(.input)\(if (.reason // "") != "" then " (" + .reason + ")" else "" end)"' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    93	  restore_interrupted "$role" "$report"
    94	  if [ -f "$report" ] && { [ ! -f "$cur" ] || [ ! "$report" -ot "$cur" ]; }; then
    95	    [ -z "$denied" ] || printf 'harness: note: %s denied tool call(s):\n%s\n' "$(grep -c . <<<"$denied")" "$denied" >&2
    96	    if { [ -n "$rc" ] && [ "$rc" != 0 ]; } || [ "$iserr" = true ]; then
    97	      echo "harness: note: $role's run ended with ${res:-no result} (rc ${rc:-?}) but wrote a report" >&2
    98	    fi
    99	    finish_report "$role" "$report"
   100	  fi
   101	  if [ "$res" = error_max_turns ]; then
   102	    echo "harness: $role stopped at the max-turns limit without a report; continue with: harness ask $role '...' --keep"
   103	    hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 3
   104	  fi
   105	  if [ -n "$killed" ]; then
   106	    echo "harness: $role's run was killed ($killed); --keep resumes session ${sid:-?}"
   107	    exit 3
   108	  fi
   109	  if [ "$rc" = 127 ] || [ -z "$tinit" ]; then
   110	    echo "harness: $role's claude did not start (rc ${rc:-?}):" >&2
   111	    tail -n 20 "$ASK_DIR/$role.err" 2>/dev/null >&2
   112	    exit 1
   113	  fi
   114	  if [ "$iserr" = true ] || [ -n "$res" -a "$res" != success ] || { [ -n "$rc" ] && [ "$rc" != 0 ]; }; then
   115	    echo "harness: $role's worker ended with ${res:-error} (rc ${rc:-?}) and wrote no report"
   116	    tail -n 20 "$ASK_DIR/$role.err" 2>/dev/null
   117	    hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 3
   118	  fi
   119	  # permissions blocked the worker and it wrote nothing: there is no answer to relay (exit 2), only when the run ended without errors
   120	  if [ -n "$denied" ] && [ -z "$killed" ] && [ -n "$tinit" ]; then
   121	    printf 'harness: %s was denied %s tool call(s) and wrote no report; nothing to answer. Re-ask with a changed brief:\n%s\n' \
   122	      "$role" "$(grep -c . <<<"$denied")" "$denied"
   123	    hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 2
   124	  fi
   125	  echo "harness: $role finished without a report at $report; collect: harness report $role"
   126	  hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 3
   127	}
   128	# hl_view_tail <role> <n> — the last n lines the run showed: the rendered stream
   129	hl_view_tail() {
   130	  local role=$1 n=${2:-30} raw
   131	  raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$ASK_DIR/$role.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   132	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   133	  if [ -n "$raw" ] && [ -f "$raw" ]; then harness-view < "$raw" 2>/dev/null | tail -n "$n"; fi
   134	  return 0
