   137	# hl_spawn_bg <role> <id> <root> — start harness-run detached from this process tree: a double fork
   138	# (the subshell exits at once, so the run is reparented to init and ask_finish's kill_tree never
   139	# reaches it) in a new session (no controlling tty, and a pgid kill of the caller's call misses it).
   140	# There is no setsid binary on macOS: perl does it. HARNESS_HL_NO_PERL=1 forces the fallback (tests).
   141	# Under this spawn harness-run's INT/HUP traps are inert (an async start ignores INT, nohup ignores
   142	# HUP); only TERM reaches it, which is what hl_kill sends. Intended.
   143	hl_spawn_bg() {
   144	  local role=$1 id=$2 root=$3 log
   145	  case "$ASK_DIR" in /*) log=$ASK_DIR ;; *) log=$root/$ASK_DIR ;; esac
   146	  log=$log/$role.runner.log
   147	  if [ "${HARNESS_HL_NO_PERL:-}" != 1 ] && command -v perl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   148	    ( cd "$root" && exec env $HL_ENV_STRIP HARNESS_ROLE=worker CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=160000 \
   149	        nohup perl -MPOSIX -e 'POSIX::setsid() or die "setsid: $!"; exec @ARGV or die "exec: $!"' \
   150	        harness-run "$role" "$id" "$root" </dev/null >>"$log" 2>&1 & )
   151	  else
   152	    # no perl: its own process group through job control (the session stays shared)
   153	    ( cd "$root" || exit 1; set -m
   154	      env $HL_ENV_STRIP HARNESS_ROLE=worker CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=160000 \
   155	        nohup harness-run "$role" "$id" "$root" </dev/null >>"$log" 2>&1 & )
   156	  fi
   157	}

   159	# hl_launch <role> <id> <resume> <max_s> <ctxb> <start_s> <poll> — write the run file, start
   160	# harness-run detached in the background and wait for its pid file; exits 1 when it never starts.
   161	hl_launch() {
   162	  local role=$1 id=$2 resume=$3 max_s=$4 ctxb=$5 start_s=$6 poll=$7 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" s0 root
   163	  root=$(pwd -P)
   164	  rm -f "$a.exit.json" "$a.pid"
   165	  printf 'resume=%s\nmax_s=%s\nctx_before=%s\n' "$resume" "$max_s" "$ctxb" > "$a.run"
   166	  hl_spawn_bg "$role" "$id" "$root"
   167	  # the run announces itself with its pid file
   168	  s0=$(date +%s)
   169	  until grep -q "^$id " "$a.pid" 2>/dev/null || hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
   170	    if [ $(( $(date +%s) - s0 )) -ge "$start_s" ]; then
   171	      echo "harness: $role's background run did not start in $start_s s; runner log:" >&2
   172	      tail -n 20 "$a.runner.log" >&2 2>/dev/null
   173	      exit 1
   174	    fi
   175	    sleep "$poll"
   176	  done
   177	}
   178	# hl_resume_missing <role> — the finished run was a --resume that produced no init event because
   179	# claude could not find the conversation (real claude: result-only stream, error_during_execution)
   180	hl_resume_missing() {
   181	  local role=$1 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" raw
   182	  [ -n "$(sed -n 's/^resume=//p' "$a.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] || return 1
   183	  [ -z "$(jq -r '.t_init // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)" ] || return 1
   184	  raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   185	  grep -qi 'no conversation found' "$a.err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
   186	  [ -z "$raw" ] || grep -qi 'no conversation found' "$raw" 2>/dev/null
   187	}

   189	# hl_max_s <role> — the role's headless run cap in seconds: env, then config headless_max_minutes, then the default
   190	hl_max_s() {
   191	  local m=${HARNESS_HL_MAX_S:-}
   192	  digits_only "$m" && { echo "$m"; return 0; }
   193	  m=$(jq -r '.headless_max_minutes // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
   194	  digits_only "$m" && { echo $((m * 60)); return 0; }
   195	  if [ "$1" = implementer ]; then echo "$HARNESS_HL_MAX_S_IMPLEMENTER_DEFAULT"; else echo "$HARNESS_HL_MAX_S_DEFAULT"; fi
   196	}

   198	# hl_clock_gap <prev-epoch> <now-epoch> <poll-s> — print the seconds to add to a deadline when the
   199	# wall clock jumped between two polls (laptop sleep): a gap above 5x the poll interval + 5 s counts as a
   200	# suspend; 0 otherwise. Pure arithmetic, so tests inject the timestamps.
   201	hl_clock_gap() {
   202	  awk -v p="$1" -v n="$2" -v i="${3:-2}" 'BEGIN { g = n - p; if (g > 5 * i + 5) printf "%d\n", g; else print 0 }'
   203	}
   204	# hl_deadline_bump <prev> <now> <poll> <deadline> [<cap-s> <deadline0>] — print the (possibly extended) deadline;
   205	# one stderr line when it moved. With a cap, one bump is at most <cap-s> and all bumps together at most
   206	# 2x<cap-s> over <deadline0> (the deadline before any bump), so a bogus clock jump cannot keep an ask alive forever.
   207	hl_deadline_bump() {
   208	  local g=0 cap=${5:-} d0=${6:-$4} room
   209	  g=$(hl_clock_gap "$1" "$2" "$3")
   210	  case "$cap" in ''|*[!0-9]*) cap=0 ;; esac
   211	  if [ "$g" -gt 0 ] && [ "$cap" -gt 0 ]; then
   212	    [ "$g" -le "$cap" ] || g=$cap
   213	    room=$((2 * cap - ($4 - d0)))
   214	    [ "$room" -gt 0 ] || room=0
   215	    [ "$g" -le "$room" ] || g=$room
   216	  fi
   217	  if [ "$g" -gt 0 ]; then
   218	    echo "harness: clock jumped ${g}s (sleep?); deadline extended" >&2
   219	    echo $(($4 + g))
   220	  else
   221	    echo "$4"
   222	  fi
   223	}

   225	# ask_headless <role> <text> <timeout-ms> <keep> — the whole headless ask; always exits
   226	ask_headless() {
   227	  local role=$1 text=$2 timeout=$3 keep=$4 id start retried resume="" sid max_s ctxb="" report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md"
   228	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$role" now prev deadline dl0 poll=${HARNESS_POLL_SEC:-2} start_s=${HARNESS_HL_START_S:-15} s0 g
   229	  mkdir -p "$ASK_DIR" "$REPORT_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"
   230	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   231	    echo "harness: $role is still running (pid $(hl_pid "$role")); nothing sent. Collect with: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
   232	    exit 4
   233	  fi
   234	  rm -f "$a.run"
   235	  if [ "$keep" = 1 ]; then
   236	    sid=$(sed -n 1p "$a.session" 2>/dev/null)
   237	    if [ -n "$sid" ]; then
   238	      resume=$sid
   239	      ctxb=$(jq -r '.ctx // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   240	    elif sid=$(hl_last_session "$role") && [ "$sid" = closed ]; then
   241	      echo "harness: note: $role was closed after its last successful run; no session to resume — running fresh"
   242	    elif [ -n "$sid" ]; then
   243	      # the previous run died before it reported a session: fall back to the last successful one
   244	      resume=$sid
   245	      echo "harness: note: the previous run recorded no session; resuming the last successful one from progress.jsonl (${sid:0:8})"
   246	    else
   247	      echo "harness: note: no previous session for $role — running fresh"
   248	    fi
   249	  fi
   250	  # a session file left by an earlier run must never be mistaken for this run's
   251	  rm -f "$a.session"
   252	  rm -f "$report"
   253	  id="$(date +%s)-$$-$RANDOM"; start=$(date +%s)
   254	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" "$start" > "$a.current"
   255	  rm -f "$a.exit.json" "$a.pid"
   256	  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then verify_tool baseline implementer 2>/dev/null || rm -f .harness/verify/implementer.json; fi
   257	  max_s=$(hl_max_s "$role")
   258	  printf '%s\n' "$text" > "$a.prompt"
   259	  hl_launch "$role" "$id" "$resume" "$max_s" "$ctxb" "$start_s" "$poll"
   260	  deadline=$((start + (timeout + 999) / 1000))
   261	  # no --timeout: wait for the run to end (its cap plus a margin for the watchdog kill and exit.json), so a
   262	  # background `harness ask` returns exactly when the run does and the conductor's task notification fires
   263	  [ "${ASK_TIMEOUT_SET:-0}" = 1 ] || deadline=$((start + max_s + 30))
   264	  prev=$(date +%s); dl0=$deadline
   265	  retried=0
   266	  while :; do
   267	    if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then
   268	      if [ "$retried" = 0 ] && hl_resume_missing "$role"; then
   269	        # the session is gone: one fresh run in the same ask; the dead sid must not stay the resume target
   270	        retried=1
   271	        echo "harness: resume of ${resume:0:8} failed, running fresh" >&2
   272	        resume=""; ctxb=""
   273	        hl_launch "$role" "$id" "" "$max_s" "" "$start_s" "$poll"
   274	        continue
   275	      fi
   276	      hl_collect "$role"
   277	    fi
   278	    if ! hl_alive "$role"; then
   279	      # the runner may still be writing exit.json (jq, mv) as its pid disappears: give it ~3 s
   280	      g=0; while [ "$g" -lt 30 ] && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do sleep 0.1; g=$((g + 1)); done
   281	      if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then continue; fi
   282	      sid=$(sed -n 1p "$a.session" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-8)
   283	      if [ -n "$sid" ]; then
   284	        echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); --keep resumes session $sid"
   285	      else
   286	        echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); it recorded no session (--keep resumes the last successful one, if any)"
   287	      fi
   288	      exit 3
   289	    fi
   290	    now=$(date +%s)
   291	    deadline=$(hl_deadline_bump "$prev" "$now" "$poll" "$deadline" "$max_s" "$dl0"); prev=$now
   292	    if [ "$now" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
   293	      if [ "$role" = implementer ] && [ -f "$report.pending" ]; then
   294	        # the Stop hook has hidden the report while it verifies; the run is never killed at the deadline
   295	        echo "harness: $role is still verifying (Stop hook running, $(cat .harness/verify/implementer.attempts 2>/dev/null || echo 0) failed attempt(s) so far, $((now - start))s); collect: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
   296	        exit 4
   297	      fi
   298	      echo "harness: $role is still running (pid $(hl_pid "$role"), $((now - start))s); collect: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
   299	      exit 4
   300	    fi
   301	    sleep "$poll"
   302	  done
   303	}

   319	# hl_kill <role> — stop the role's run: TERM the runner (it kills its tree and writes
   320	# exit.json killed:signal), wait up to 5 s, then kill the tree
   321	hl_kill() {
   322	  local role=$1 pid i=0 id

   324	  digits_only "$pid" || return 0
   325	  kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null

   327	    hl_alive "$role" || return 0

   331	  return 0
   332	}

   361	# hl_target <cmd> <target> — validate the role for wait/watch: sets ASK_AGENT; dies for an unknown one
   362	hl_target() {
   363	  case " $AGENTS " in
   364	    *" $2 "*) ASK_AGENT=$2 ;;
   365	    *) die "$1: unknown agent '$2' (expected one of: $AGENTS)" ;;

   368	# hl_starting <role> <id> — the run was just launched and has not written its pid file yet
   369	hl_starting() {

   371	  grep -q "^$2 " "$a.pid" 2>/dev/null && return 1
   372	  st=$(awk -v i="$2" 'NR == 1 && $1 == i { print $2 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)

   376	# cmd_wait <role> [--timeout ms] — block until the target's run ends; never collects.
   377	# 0 done (exit.json carries the ask), 3 no ask / run gone without a result, 4 timeout.
   378	cmd_wait() {
   379	  local t=${1:-} timeout="" role id a start deadline dl0 max_s prev now g poll=${HARNESS_POLL_SEC:-2}
   380	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   381	  shift
   382	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   383	    case "$1" in
   384	      --timeout) case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) die "--timeout needs a number of milliseconds" ;; esac; timeout=$2; shift 2 ;;
   385	      *) usage ;;
   386	    esac
   387	  done
   388	  hl_target wait "$t"
   389	  role=$ASK_AGENT; a="$ASK_DIR/$role"
   390	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   391	  [ -n "$id" ] || { echo "harness: no ask for $role" >&2; exit 3; }
   392	  [ -n "$timeout" ] || timeout=$(( $(hl_max_s "$role") * 1000 ))
   393	  start=$(date +%s); deadline=$((start + (timeout + 999) / 1000)); prev=$start; dl0=$deadline; max_s=$(hl_max_s "$role")
   394	  while :; do
   395	    if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then echo "done; collect: harness report $role"; exit 0; fi
   396	    if ! hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_starting "$role" "$id"; then
   397	      # the runner may still be writing exit.json as its pid disappears: the same ~3 s grace as ask
   398	      g=0; while [ "$g" -lt 30 ] && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do sleep 0.1; g=$((g + 1)); done
   399	      if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then continue; fi
   400	      echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); harness report $role explains" >&2
   401	      exit 3
   402	    fi
   403	    now=$(date +%s)
   404	    deadline=$(hl_deadline_bump "$prev" "$now" "$poll" "$deadline" "$max_s" "$dl0"); prev=$now
   405	    if [ "$now" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
   406	      echo "harness: $role is still running ($((now - start))s waited); harness wait $role again, or harness close $role --force" >&2
   407	      exit 4
   408	    fi
   409	    sleep "$poll"
   410	  done
   411	}

   413	# hl_stream_of <role> — the raw stream of the role's current/last run (empty when unknown): .stream when its
   414	# id is the current ask, else exit.json's stream_log; a rotated stream is <raw>.gz
   415	hl_stream_of() {
   416	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1" raw cur
   417	  cur=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   418	  raw=$(awk -v i="$cur" 'NR == 1 && $1 == i { print $2 }' "$a.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   419	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   420	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$a.stream" 2>/dev/null)

   426	# cmd_watch <role> [-n N] — human only: a live run as a redrawn dashboard (lib/harness-dash.sh), or print the last N
   427	# (default 40) rendered lines of a finished one. 0 ok, 1 refused (not a tty), 3 no stream known.
   428	cmd_watch() {
   429	  local t=${1:-} n=40 nset="" role raw i id
   430	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   431	  shift
   432	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   433	    case "$1" in
   434	      -n) case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) die "-n needs a number of lines" ;; esac; n=$2; nset=1; shift 2 ;;
   435	      *) usage ;;
   436	    esac
   437	  done
   438	  [ -t 1 ] || die "watch is for a human terminal; the conductor reads the report"
   439	  hl_target watch "$t"
   440	  role=$ASK_AGENT
   441	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)
   442	  raw=$(hl_stream_of "$role"); i=0
   443	  # a run that is still starting has not announced its stream yet: give it a few seconds
   444	  while [ "$(hl_stream_id "$role")" != "$id" ] && [ "$i" -lt 100 ] && { hl_alive "$role" || hl_starting "$role" "$id"; }; do
   445	    sleep 0.2; i=$((i + 1)); raw=$(hl_stream_of "$role")
   446	  done
   447	  if [ -z "$raw" ]; then echo "harness: no stream known for $t" >&2; exit 3; fi
   448	  # -n N (or a rotated .gz stream): one-shot plain tail of a finished run (scrollback text; reflows by itself)
   449	  if { [ -n "$nset" ] || [ ! -f "$raw" ]; } && ! hl_alive "$role"; then
   450	    if [ -f "$raw" ]; then harness-view < "$raw" | tail -n "$n"
   451	    elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz" | harness-view | tail -n "$n"
   452	    else echo "harness: stream $raw is gone" >&2; exit 3; fi
   453	    exit 0
   454	  fi
   455	  dash_watch "$role" "$raw" "$id"
   456	  exit 0
   457	}

   137	# hl_spawn_bg <role> <id> <root> — start harness-run detached from this process tree: a double fork
   138	# (the subshell exits at once, so the run is reparented to init and ask_finish's kill_tree never
   139	# reaches it) in a new session (no controlling tty, and a pgid kill of the caller's call misses it).
   140	# There is no setsid binary on macOS: perl does it. HARNESS_HL_NO_PERL=1 forces the fallback (tests).
   141	# Under this spawn harness-run's INT/HUP traps are inert (an async start ignores INT, nohup ignores
   142	# HUP); only TERM reaches it, which is what hl_kill sends. Intended.
   143	hl_spawn_bg() {
   144	  local role=$1 id=$2 root=$3 log
   145	  case "$ASK_DIR" in /*) log=$ASK_DIR ;; *) log=$root/$ASK_DIR ;; esac

   149	        nohup perl -MPOSIX -e 'POSIX::setsid() or die "setsid: $!"; exec @ARGV or die "exec: $!"' \
   150	        harness-run "$role" "$id" "$root" </dev/null >>"$log" 2>&1 & )

   152	    # no perl: its own process group through job control (the session stays shared)

   155	        nohup harness-run "$role" "$id" "$root" </dev/null >>"$log" 2>&1 & )

   198	# hl_clock_gap <prev-epoch> <now-epoch> <poll-s> — print the seconds to add to a deadline when the
   199	# wall clock jumped between two polls (laptop sleep): a gap above 5x the poll interval + 5 s counts as a
   200	# suspend; 0 otherwise. Pure arithmetic, so tests inject the timestamps.
   201	hl_clock_gap() {
   202	  awk -v p="$1" -v n="$2" -v i="${3:-2}" 'BEGIN { g = n - p; if (g > 5 * i + 5) printf "%d\n", g; else print 0 }'

   206	# 2x<cap-s> over <deadline0> (the deadline before any bump), so a bogus clock jump cannot keep an ask alive forever.
   207	hl_deadline_bump() {

   248	    fi

   252	  rm -f "$report"

   254	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" "$start" > "$a.current"
   255	  rm -f "$a.exit.json" "$a.pid"

   307	  local role=$1 report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md"
   308	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   309	    echo "harness: still running ($(( $(date +%s) - $(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))s); harness wait $role blocks until done" >&2
   310	    exit 4
   311	  fi
   312	  if [ ! -f "$ASK_DIR/$role.exit.json" ]; then
   313	    echo "harness: no finished run for $role" >&2
   314	    exit 3
   315	  fi
   316	  hl_collect "$role"
   317	}
   318	
   319	# hl_kill <role> — stop the role's run: TERM the runner (it kills its tree and writes
   320	# exit.json killed:signal), wait up to 5 s, then kill the tree
   321	hl_kill() {
   322	  local role=$1 pid i=0 id
   323	  pid=$(hl_pid "$role"); id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.pid" 2>/dev/null)
   324	  digits_only "$pid" || return 0
   325	  kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null
   326	  while [ "$i" -lt 50 ]; do
   327	    hl_alive "$role" || return 0
   328	    sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1))
   329	  done
   330	  kill_tree "$pid"; kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null
   331	  return 0
   332	}
   333	
   334	# hl_finish_close <role> <reason> — drop the conversation (--keep must not resume a session across
   335	# a close), log
   336	hl_finish_close() {
   337	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1"
   338	  # .current ends the run slot: status shows "-" again (exit.json stays for the post-mortem)
   339	  rm -f "$a.session" "$a.current"
   340	  log_close "$1" "$2" headless
   341	  echo "closed $1"
   342	}
   343	
   344	# close_headless <role> <force> — close the role's run slot: kill a live run (--force)
   345	close_headless() {
   346	  local role=$1 force=$2 reason=manual
   347	  if ! hl_alive "$role" && [ ! -f "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" ]; then
   348	    die "$role is not running"
   349	  fi
   350	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   351	    if [ "$force" != 1 ]; then
   352	      echo "harness: $role has a run in progress (pid $(hl_pid "$role")); not closing (use --force to kill it)" >&2
   353	      return 4
   354	    fi
   355	    hl_kill "$role"
   356	    reason=force_kill
   357	  fi
   358	  hl_finish_close "$role" "$reason"
   359	}
   360	
   361	# hl_target <cmd> <target> — validate the role for wait/watch: sets ASK_AGENT; dies for an unknown one
   362	hl_target() {
   363	  case " $AGENTS " in
   364	    *" $2 "*) ASK_AGENT=$2 ;;
   365	    *) die "$1: unknown agent '$2' (expected one of: $AGENTS)" ;;
   366	  esac
   367	}
   368	# hl_starting <role> <id> — the run was just launched and has not written its pid file yet
   369	hl_starting() {
   370	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1" st
   371	  grep -q "^$2 " "$a.pid" 2>/dev/null && return 1
   372	  st=$(awk -v i="$2" 'NR == 1 && $1 == i { print $2 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   373	  digits_only "${st:-}" && [ $(( $(date +%s) - st )) -lt "${HARNESS_HL_START_S:-15}" ]
   374	}
   375	
   376	# cmd_wait <role> [--timeout ms] — block until the target's run ends; never collects.
   377	# 0 done (exit.json carries the ask), 3 no ask / run gone without a result, 4 timeout.
   378	cmd_wait() {
   379	  local t=${1:-} timeout="" role id a start deadline dl0 max_s prev now g poll=${HARNESS_POLL_SEC:-2}
   380	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   381	  shift
   382	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   383	    case "$1" in
   384	      --timeout) case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) die "--timeout needs a number of milliseconds" ;; esac; timeout=$2; shift 2 ;;
   385	      *) usage ;;
   386	    esac
   387	  done
   388	  hl_target wait "$t"
   389	  role=$ASK_AGENT; a="$ASK_DIR/$role"
   390	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   391	  [ -n "$id" ] || { echo "harness: no ask for $role" >&2; exit 3; }
   392	  [ -n "$timeout" ] || timeout=$(( $(hl_max_s "$role") * 1000 ))
   393	  start=$(date +%s); deadline=$((start + (timeout + 999) / 1000)); prev=$start; dl0=$deadline; max_s=$(hl_max_s "$role")
   394	  while :; do
   395	    if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then echo "done; collect: harness report $role"; exit 0; fi
   396	    if ! hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_starting "$role" "$id"; then
   397	      # the runner may still be writing exit.json as its pid disappears: the same ~3 s grace as ask
   398	      g=0; while [ "$g" -lt 30 ] && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do sleep 0.1; g=$((g + 1)); done
   399	      if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then continue; fi
   400	      echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); harness report $role explains" >&2
   401	      exit 3
   402	    fi
   403	    now=$(date +%s)
   404	    deadline=$(hl_deadline_bump "$prev" "$now" "$poll" "$deadline" "$max_s" "$dl0"); prev=$now
   405	    if [ "$now" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
   406	      echo "harness: $role is still running ($((now - start))s waited); harness wait $role again, or harness close $role --force" >&2
   407	      exit 4
   408	    fi
   409	    sleep "$poll"
   410	  done
   411	}
   412	
   413	# hl_stream_of <role> — the raw stream of the role's current/last run (empty when unknown): .stream when its
   414	# id is the current ask, else exit.json's stream_log; a rotated stream is <raw>.gz
   415	hl_stream_of() {
   416	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1" raw cur
   417	  cur=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   418	  raw=$(awk -v i="$cur" 'NR == 1 && $1 == i { print $2 }' "$a.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   419	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   420	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$a.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   421	  printf '%s' "$raw"
   422	}
   423	
   424	hl_stream_id() { awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$1.stream" 2>/dev/null; }
   425	
   426	# cmd_watch <role> [-n N] — human only: a live run as a redrawn dashboard (lib/harness-dash.sh), or print the last N
   427	# (default 40) rendered lines of a finished one. 0 ok, 1 refused (not a tty), 3 no stream known.
   428	cmd_watch() {
   429	  local t=${1:-} n=40 nset="" role raw i id
   430	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   431	  shift
   432	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   433	    case "$1" in
   434	      -n) case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) die "-n needs a number of lines" ;; esac; n=$2; nset=1; shift 2 ;;
   435	      *) usage ;;
   436	    esac
   437	  done
   438	  [ -t 1 ] || die "watch is for a human terminal; the conductor reads the report"
   439	  hl_target watch "$t"
   440	  role=$ASK_AGENT
   441	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)
   442	  raw=$(hl_stream_of "$role"); i=0
   443	  # a run that is still starting has not announced its stream yet: give it a few seconds
   444	  while [ "$(hl_stream_id "$role")" != "$id" ] && [ "$i" -lt 100 ] && { hl_alive "$role" || hl_starting "$role" "$id"; }; do
   445	    sleep 0.2; i=$((i + 1)); raw=$(hl_stream_of "$role")
   446	  done
   447	  if [ -z "$raw" ]; then echo "harness: no stream known for $t" >&2; exit 3; fi
   448	  # -n N (or a rotated .gz stream): one-shot plain tail of a finished run (scrollback text; reflows by itself)
   449	  if { [ -n "$nset" ] || [ ! -f "$raw" ]; } && ! hl_alive "$role"; then
   450	    if [ -f "$raw" ]; then harness-view < "$raw" | tail -n "$n"
   451	    elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz" | harness-view | tail -n "$n"
   452	    else echo "harness: stream $raw is gone" >&2; exit 3; fi
   453	    exit 0
   454	  fi
   455	  dash_watch "$role" "$raw" "$id"
   456	  exit 0
   457	}

1	# harness-lane.sh — per-issue work folders (git worktrees): `harness lane` (issue #63).
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only. Uses die/usage/cmd_init/hl_alive/AGENTS from it.
     3	
     4	# lane_primary — path of the primary worktree (first entry of git's list), from any folder
     5	lane_primary() { git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'; }
     6	
     7	# lane_in_primary — 0 when the cwd is the primary worktree of a git repo
     8	lane_in_primary() {
     9	  local g c
    10	  g=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    11	  c=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1
    12	  [ "$(cd "$g" && pwd -P)" = "$c" ]
    13	}
    14	
    15	# lane_rows — "path<TAB>branch" for every non-primary worktree (path canonical, pwd -P)
    16	lane_rows() {
    17	  local p b
    18	  git worktree list --porcelain | awk -v RS= -F'\n' 'NR > 1 { p = b = ""
    19	    for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i ~ /^worktree /) p = substr($i, 10); if ($i ~ /^branch /) b = substr($i, 19) }
    20	    print p "\t" b }' | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r p b; do
    21	    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(cd "$p" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P || echo "$p")" "$b"
    22	  done
    23	}
    24	
    25	# lane_running <path> — a worker of this folder is running
    26	lane_running() {
    27	  local a
    28	  for a in $AGENTS; do ( cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && hl_alive "$a" ) && return 0; done
    29	  return 1
    30	}
    31	
    32	# lane_pr <branch> — PR state (OPEN|MERGED|CLOSED) or empty (no PR, no gh)
    33	lane_pr() { command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh pr view "$1" --json state -q .state 2>/dev/null; }
    34	
    35	# lane_prinfo <branch> — "STATE<TAB>headRefOid" of the branch's PR, or empty (no PR, no gh)
    36	lane_prinfo() {
    37	  command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh pr view "$1" --json state,headRefOid -q '[.state,.headRefOid]|@tsv' 2>/dev/null
    38	}
    39	
    40	# lane_find <issue#|path> — "path<TAB>branch" of a work folder (issue numbers match lane branches only)
    41	lane_find() {
    42	  local t=$1 r
    43	  [ ! -d "$t" ] || t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
    44	  r=$(lane_rows | awk -F'\t' -v t="$t" '$1 == t || (t ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ ("^(feat|fix|docs)/" t "-")) { print; exit }')
    45	  [ -n "$r" ] && printf '%s\n' "$r"
    46	}
    47	
    48	lane_ls() {
    49	  local p b n s w
    50	  lane_rows | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r p b; do
    51	    b=${b#refs/heads/}; n=${b#*/}; n=${n%%-*}
    52	    s=$(lane_pr "$b"); w=""
    53	    ! lane_running "$p" || w=" running"
    54	    printf '#%s  %s  %s  PR:%s%s\n' "$n" "$b" "$p" "${s:--}" "$w"
    55	  done
    56	}
    57	
    58	# lane_copy <primary> <dir> — copy the files named in .claude/harness.json "lane_copy" (relative, no ..) from the primary
    59	lane_copy() {
    60	  local f
    61	  jq -r '.lane_copy[]? | strings' "$1/.claude/harness.json" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do
    62	    case "/$f/" in /*//*|*/../*|*/./*) f="" ;; esac
    63	    case "$f" in /*|"") echo "harness lane: lane_copy: skipping an unsafe path" >&2; continue ;; esac
    64	    [ -f "$1/$f" ] || { echo "harness lane: lane_copy: $f is missing in the primary folder; skipped" >&2; continue; }
    65	    [ ! -e "$2/$f" ] || continue
    66	    case "$f" in */*) mkdir -p "$2/${f%/*}" 2>/dev/null ;; esac
    67	    cp -p "$1/$f" "$2/$f" || echo "harness lane: lane_copy: could not copy $f" >&2
    68	  done
    69	}
    70	
    71	# lane_ignored_diff <primary> <dir> — ignored files of the work folder that differ from (or are missing in) the primary
    72	lane_ignored_diff() {
    73	  git -C "$2" ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard \
    74	    | grep -Ev '^\.harness/|^\.claude/settings\.local\.json$|(^|/)(node_modules|dist|build|\.venv|target|\.next|coverage|__pycache__)/' \
    75	    | while IFS= read -r f; do
    76	        if [ ! -e "$1/$f" ]; then echo "$f only in the work folder"
    77	        elif ! cmp -s "$1/$f" "$2/$f"; then echo "$f differs from the original folder"; fi
    78	      done
    79	}
    80	
    81	lane_new() {
    82	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness lane is for the conductor"
    83	  local issue="" slug="" type=feat prim dir base branch hint setup shared=""
    84	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    85	    case "$1" in
    86	      --type) type=${2:-}; shift ;;
    87	      -*) usage ;;
    88	      *) if [ -z "$issue" ]; then issue=$1; elif [ -z "$slug" ]; then slug=$1; else usage; fi ;;
    89	    esac
    90	    shift
    91	  done
    92	  digits_only "$issue" || usage
    93	  case "$type" in feat|fix|docs) ;; *) die "--type must be feat, fix or docs" ;; esac
    94	  prim=$(lane_primary); [ -n "$prim" ] || die "not a git repository"

1	# harness-dash.sh — the viewer dashboard frame for `harness watch <role>` (a live run).
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only, no side effects. hl_dash_frame is a pure
     3	# render (inputs: .harness/asks/<role>.*, the stream, verify/<role>.*) -> text on stdout; the
     4	# redraw loop lives in cmd_watch. bash 3.2 + jq; Recent reuses harness-view (PATH).
     5	
     6	# dash_fmt_dur <seconds> — 45s | 12m04s | 1h02m
     7	dash_fmt_dur() {
     8	  local s=${1:-0}
     9	  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*) s=0 ;; esac
    10	  if [ "$s" -ge 3600 ]; then printf '%dh%02dm' $((s / 3600)) $((s % 3600 / 60))
    11	  elif [ "$s" -ge 60 ]; then printf '%dm%02ds' $((s / 60)) $((s % 60))
    12	  else printf '%ds' "$s"; fi
    13	}
    14	
    15	# dash_min A B
    16	dash_min() { if [ "$1" -lt "$2" ]; then echo "$1"; else echo "$2"; fi; }
    17	
    18	# dash_brief <role> — title line, then "S<TAB>step" / "H<TAB>heading" lines. The brief is the task
    19	# file only when the ask's prompt names it; otherwise the prompt text itself (first line, no steps).
    20	dash_brief() {
    21	  local role=$1 p="$ASK_DIR/$1.prompt" f=".harness/task-$1.md"
    22	  if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF "$f" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    23	    awk '
    24	      BEGIN { t = ""; sec = 0 }
    25	      /^# / && t == "" { t = substr($0, 3); next }
    26	      /^## / { h[++nh] = substr($0, 4); sec = ($0 ~ /^## Steps[ \t]*$/); next }
    27	      sec && /^[0-9]+[.)] / { s = $0; sub(/^[0-9]+[.)] +/, "", s); st[++ns] = ++k ". " s }
    28	      END {
    29	        print (t == "" ? "(untitled brief)" : t)
    30	        if (ns > 0) { for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) print "S\t" st[i] }
    31	        else { for (i = 1; i <= nh; i++) print "H\t" h[i] }
    32	      }' "$f"
    33	  else
    34	    awk 'NR == 1 { print; exit }' "$p" 2>/dev/null
    35	  fi
    36	}
    37	
    38	# dash_facts <raw> — one JSON object of what the stream says (model, turns, ctx, now, verify)
    39	dash_facts() {
    40	  local raw=$1
    41	  { if [ -f "$raw" ]; then cat "$raw"; elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz"; fi; } 2>/dev/null | jq -R -n -c '
    42	    def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    43	    [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
    44	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $i
    45	    | [$e[] | select(.type == "assistant")] as $a
    46	    | ([$a[] | .message.usage?] | map(select(. != null)) | last) as $u
    47	    | [$a[] | (.message.content // [])[] | select((.type == "text" and ((.text // "") | test("\\S"))) or .type == "tool_use")] as $it
    48	    | ($it | last) as $n | ($it | if length > 1 then .[-2] else null end) as $p
    49	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .hook_event == "Stop" and (.subtype == "hook_started" or .subtype == "hook_response"))] | last) as $h
    50	    | {model: ($i.model // "?"),
    51	       turns: ([$a | to_entries[] | (.value.message.id // "n\(.key)")] | unique | length),
    52	       ctx: (if $u then (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)) else 0 end),
    53	       now: (if $n == null then {sum: "", detail: ""}
    54	             elif $n.type == "text" then {sum: "", detail: $n.text}
    55	             else ($n.input // {}) as $in
    56	               | ($in | (.command // .file_path // .pattern // .url // .path // "") | tostring) as $known
    57	               | (if $known != "" then $known elif ($in | type) == "object" and ($in | length) > 0 then ($in | tojson) else "" end) as $arg
    58	               | "\($n.name // "?") \($arg | first_line)" as $fb
    59	               | {sum: (if ((($in.description // "") | tostring) | test("\\S")) then ($in.description | first_line)
    60	                        elif ($p != null and $p.type == "text") then ($p.text | split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S"))) | .[0] // "")
    61	                        else $fb end)} as $o
    62	               | $o + {detail: (if $o.sum == $fb and (($n.name // "") | IN("Read", "Edit", "Write")) then "" else $arg end)} end),
    63	       verify: (if $h == null then "none"
    64	                elif $h.subtype == "hook_started" then "running"
    65	                elif ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block" and ((.reason // "") | test("\\.harness/reports/")))] | length > 0) then "report"
    66	                elif (($h.exit_code // 0) != 0) or ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block")] | length > 0) then "fail"
    67	                else "pass" end)}'
    68	}
    69	
    70	# jq def cw: display columns of a code point (2 = East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth; deliberately conservative: all of
    71	# U+1F000-1FAFF counts 2, overcounting only clips a line early). Autowrap is off while drawing (dash_begin).
    72	DASH_JQ_CW='def cw: [[4352,4447],[8986,8987],[9001,9002],[9193,9196],[9200,9200],[9203,9203],[9725,9726],[9748,9749],
    73	  [9800,9811],[9855,9855],[9875,9875],[9889,9889],[9898,9899],[9917,9918],[9924,9925],[9934,9934],[9940,9940],
    74	  [9962,9962],[9970,9973],[9978,9978],[9981,9981],[9989,9989],[9994,9995],[10024,10024],[10060,10060],
    75	  [10062,10062],[10067,10069],[10071,10071],[10133,10135],[10160,10160],[10175,10175],[11035,11036],
    76	  [11088,11088],[11093,11093],[11904,12350],[12353,13311],[13312,19903],[19968,40959],[40960,42191],
    77	  [44032,55203],[63744,64255],[65040,65049],[65072,65131],[65280,65376],[65504,65510],[126976,129791],
    78	  [131072,262141]] as $r
    79	  | . as $c | if any($r[]; $c >= .[0] and $c <= .[1]) then 2 else 1 end;
    80	# jq def ctl: C0 controls (except \t, handled apart; \n splits lines), DEL and C1 shown as "·", so stream text can
    81	# never drive the terminal (ESC sequences, \r) from inside the frame
    82	def ctl: gsub("[\u0001-\u0008\u000b-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]"; "·");
    83	'
    84	
    85	# dash_wrap <width> <max-lines> — stdin text -> wrapped lines on stdout (by display width, never cut: the rest
    86	# continues on the next line). Blank lines are dropped, tabs become 2 spaces; when more than <max-lines> remain,
    87	# the last kept line ends with "…".
    88	dash_wrap() {
    89	  jq -R -r -s --argjson w "$(( $1 > 2 ? $1 : 2 ))" --argjson m "$2" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
    90	    def wrapline($n): explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, cur: [], out: []};
    91	        ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $n and (.cur | length) > 0 then .out += [.cur] | .cur = [$c] | .w = $k
    92	                          else .cur += [$c] | .w += $k end) | (.out + [.cur]) | map(implode);
    93	    split("\n") | map(gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | select(test("\\S"))) | map(wrapline($w)) | add // []
    94	    | if length > $m then .[0:$m] | .[-1] |= ((wrapline($w - 1) | .[0]) + "…") else . end | .[]'
    95	}
    96	
    97	# dash_size — "H W" of the pane, read fresh on every call: HARNESS_DASH_LINES / HARNESS_DASH_COLS (tests only;
    98	# deliberately not LINES/COLUMNS, which an exported shell value would freeze), else the controlling tty
    99	# (tput inside $(...) has no tty on stdout), else tput, else 24x80. A single override is honoured alone.
   100	dash_size() {
   101	  local sz="" H W
   102	  [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-}" ] && [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-}" ] || sz=$({ stty size </dev/tty; } 2>/dev/null)
   103	  H=${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-${sz%% *}}; W=${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-${sz##* }}
   104	  [ -n "$H" ] || H=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput lines 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$W" ] || W=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput cols 2>/dev/null)
   105	  case "$H" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) H=24 ;; esac
   106	  case "$W" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) W=80 ;; esac
   107	  echo "$H $W"
   108	}
   109	
   110	# dash_nap <seconds> — sleep that a trapped signal (WINCH, INT, ...) interrupts at once (a foreground sleep would
   111	# delay the trap until it returns)
   112	dash_nap() { sleep "$1" & DASH_NAP_PID=$!; wait "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; kill "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }
   113	
   114	# hl_dash_frame <role> <raw> — the dashboard text. Size: dash_size (read per frame). Final frame (result + report head) when the run is not
   115	# live: HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 forces it, else hl_alive decides.
   116	hl_dash_frame() {
   117	  local role=$1 raw=$2 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" H W id start facts model turns ctx verify now_s dur final=0
   118	  read -r H W <<<"$(dash_size)"
   119	  read -r id start _ < "$a.current" 2>/dev/null
   120	  if [ "${HARNESS_DASH_FINAL:-}" = 1 ] || ! hl_alive "$role"; then final=1; fi
   121	  facts=$(dash_facts "$raw"); [ -n "$facts" ] || facts='{"model":"?","turns":0,"ctx":0,"now":{"sum":"","detail":""},"verify":"none"}'
   122	  model=$(jq -r '.model' <<<"$facts"); turns=$(jq -r '.turns' <<<"$facts")
   123	  ctx=$(jq -r 'if .ctx >= 1000 then "\((.ctx / 1000) | round)k" else "\(.ctx)" end' <<<"$facts")
   124	  verify=$(jq -r '.verify' <<<"$facts")
   125	  # the exit record / report count only when they belong to this ask (not left over from an earlier one)
   126	  local exit_ok=0 rep_ok=0
   127	  if [ -f "$a.exit.json" ] && grep -q "\"ask_id\":\"$id\"" "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null; then exit_ok=1; fi
   128	  if [ -f ".harness/reports/$role.md" ] && ! [ ".harness/reports/$role.md" -ot "$a.current" ]; then rep_ok=1; fi
   129	  if [ "$final" = 1 ] && [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
   130	    dur=$(jq -r '((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   131	  elif digits_only "${start:-}"; then dur=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
   132	  else dur=0; fi
   133	
   134	  local bt brief_lines steps="" heads="" l k
   135	  brief_lines=$(dash_brief "$role")
   136	  bt=$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed -n 1p)
   137	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r k l; do
   138	    case "$k" in S) steps="$steps$l"$'\n' ;; H) heads="$heads$l"$'\n' ;; esac
   139	  done <<<"$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed 1d)"
   140	  [ -n "$steps" ] || steps=$(printf '%s' "$heads" | awk '{ print NR ". " $0 }')
   141	  [ -z "$steps" ] || steps=${steps%$'\n'}
   142	  steps=$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | head -n 10)
   143	
   144	  # verify text: the step of a failed run comes from verify/<role>.json when present
   145	  local vtxt
   146	  case "$verify" in
   147	    none) vtxt="not started" ;;
   148	    running) vtxt="verifying…" ;;
   149	    pass) vtxt="pass" ;;
   150	    report) vtxt="waiting for report" ;;
   151	    *) vtxt="fail"
   152	       if ! [ ".harness/verify/$role.json" -ot "$a.current" ]; then
   153	         l=$(jq -r '.step // empty' ".harness/verify/$role.json" 2>/dev/null)
   154	         [ -z "$l" ] || vtxt="fail ($l)"
   155	       fi ;;
   156	  esac
   157	
   158	  # diff (implementer only): git diff --stat against the base sha of the ask
   159	  local diff="" dwant=0 base
   160	  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then
   161	    base=$(sed -n 1p ".harness/verify/$role.base" 2>/dev/null)
   162	    if [ -n "$base" ]; then
   163	      diff=$(git diff --stat "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null)
   164	      [ -n "$diff" ] || diff="(no changes)"
   165	    else diff="(no baseline)"; fi
   166	    dwant=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l) + 1 ))
   167	    [ "$dwant" -le 6 ] || dwant=6
   168	  fi
   169	
   170	  # line budget, in the order of keeping: header, brief, now/result, steps, verify, diff, recent/report
   171	  local rem=$H hdr=1 abrief=0 anow=0 asteps=0 averify=0 adiff=0 arecent=0 want
   172	  rem=$((rem - 1)); [ "$rem" -ge 0 ] || rem=0
   173	  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { abrief=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
   174	  # Now = summary line + the full command/text wrapped (<= 6 lines): the minimum (summary + 1 detail line) is
   175	  # kept before Steps; the other detail lines come after Diff and before Recent
   176	  local nsum=0 dl="" dn=0 xdet=0 dind="    " nmin=1
   177	  if [ "$final" != 1 ]; then
   178	    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts"); [ -z "$l" ] || nsum=1
   179	    [ "$nsum" = 1 ] || dind="  "
   180	    dl=$(jq -r '.now.detail' <<<"$facts" | dash_wrap $((W - 1 - ${#dind})) 6 | sed "s/^/$dind/")
   181	    [ -z "$dl" ] || dn=$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   182	    nmin=$((nsum + (dn > 0 ? 1 : 0))); [ "$nmin" -ge 1 ] || nmin=1
   183	  fi
   184	  anow=$(dash_min $((nmin + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$final" = 1 ] && anow=$(dash_min 1 "$rem")
   185	  [ "$anow" -ge 2 ] || [ "$final" = 1 ] || anow=0
   186	  rem=$((rem - anow))
   187	  want=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l) ))
   188	  if [ "$want" -gt 0 ]; then asteps=$(dash_min $((want + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ] || asteps=0; rem=$((rem - asteps)); fi
   189	  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { averify=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
   190	  if [ "$dwant" -gt 0 ]; then adiff=$(dash_min "$dwant" "$rem"); [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ] || adiff=0; rem=$((rem - adiff)); fi
   191	  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ "$anow" -ge "$((nmin + 1))" ] && [ "$dn" -gt 1 ]; then
   192	    xdet=$(dash_min $((dn - 1)) "$rem"); anow=$((anow + xdet)); rem=$((rem - xdet))
   193	  fi
   194	  [ "$rem" -ge 2 ] && arecent=$rem
   195	
   196	  local out="" sec="── "
   197	  # idle: seconds since the stream last grew (file mtime), shown from 10 s while the run is live
   198	  local idle="" mt
   199	  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ -f "$raw" ] && mt=$(file_mtime "$raw") && [ $(( $(date +%s) - mt )) -ge 10 ]; then
   200	    idle=" · idle $(dash_fmt_dur $(( $(date +%s) - mt )))"
   201	  fi
   202	  out=$(printf '%s  %s  ⏱ %s%s  turns %s  ctx %s  %s' "$role" "${id:-?}" "$(dash_fmt_dur "$dur")" "$idle" "$turns" "$ctx" "$model")
   203	  [ "$abrief" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Brief ── $bt"
   204	  if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
   205	    if [ "$anow" -ge 1 ]; then
   206	      if [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
   207	        l=$(jq -r '"■ \(.result // "ended") · rc \(.rc // "?") · \(.num_turns // 0) turns · \(((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor)s · $\(.cost_usd // 0)"' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   208	      else l="■ ended (no result)"; fi
   209	      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Result ── $l"
   210	    fi
   211	  elif [ "$anow" -ge 2 ]; then
   212	    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts" | sed '/^$/d' | sed 's/^/  → /')
   213	    [ -z "$dl" ] || l="${l:+$l$'\n'}$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | head -n $((anow - 1 - nsum)))"
   214	    [ -n "$l" ] || l="  (waiting for output)"
   215	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Now ──"$'\n'"$l"
   216	  fi
   217	  if [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ]; then
   218	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Steps ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | head -n $((asteps - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')"
   219	  fi
   220	  [ "$averify" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Verify ── $vtxt"
   221	  if [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ]; then
   222	    local nd=$((adiff - 1)) total
   223	    total=$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l)
   224	    if [ "$total" -gt "$nd" ]; then diff=$({ [ "$nd" -le 1 ] || printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed -n "1,$((nd - 1))p"; printf '%s\n' "$diff" | tail -n 1; }); fi
   225	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Diff ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed 's/^/  /')"
   226	  fi
   227	  if [ "$arecent" -ge 2 ]; then
   228	    if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
   229	      l=""; [ "$rep_ok" != 1 ] || l=$(head -n $((arecent - 1)) ".harness/reports/$role.md" 2>/dev/null)
   230	      [ -n "$l" ] || l="(no report)"
   231	      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Report ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$l" | sed 's/^/  /')"
   232	    else
   233	      l=$(tail -n 400 "$raw" 2>/dev/null | harness-view 2>/dev/null | tail -n $((arecent - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')
   234	      [ -z "$l" ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Recent ──"$'\n'"$l"
   235	    fi
   236	  fi
   237	  # cut by display width (East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth incl. emoji = 2 columns; jq works in code points, bash 3.2
   238	  # ${v:0:n} in bytes) so no line wraps; a line is clipped, never wrapped. Tabs become 2 spaces first.
   239	  # Cut at W-1 columns: the trailing \033[K (dash_paint) must never erase the last glyph with autowrap off.
   240	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | jq -R -r --argjson w "$((W > 1 ? W - 1 : 1))" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
   241	    gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, o: [], f: false};
   242	      if .f then . else ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $w then .f = true else .w += $k | .o += [$c] end end)
   243	    | .o | implode'
   244	}
   245	
   246	# dash_begin / dash_end — hide the cursor and turn terminal autowrap off while the loop draws, so a width
   247	# miscount can only cut a line short, never wrap or scroll; dash_end restores both and ends the line
   248	# dash_end is idempotent (traps + normal exit may both call it): only the first call after dash_begin prints
   249	DASH_ON=0
   250	dash_begin() { DASH_ON=1; printf '\033[?25l\033[?7l'; }
   251	dash_end() { [ "$DASH_ON" = 1 ] || return 0; DASH_ON=0; printf '\033[?7h\033[?25h\n'; }
   252	
   253	# dash_paint <frame> — redraw in place (no full clear, so no flicker): home, each line cleared to its
   254	# end, then everything below the frame cleared
   255	dash_paint() {
   256	  printf '\033[H'
   257	  # no newline after the last line: a frame of exactly H lines would scroll the pane by one every tick
   258	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk 'BEGIN { e = sprintf("%c", 27) } { if (NR > 1) printf "\n"; printf "%s%s[K", $0, e }'
   259	  printf '\033[J'
   260	}
   261	
   262	# dash_watch <role> <raw> <id> — the viewer loop: live frames every HARNESS_DASH_SEC and on SIGWINCH, then the final
   263	# frame, kept alive and re-rendered on a size change (polled every HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC too) until HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT
   264	# or the ask is removed or replaced. dash_end runs on every exit path.
   265	dash_watch() {
   266	  local role=$1 raw=$2 id=$3
   267	  trap 'dash_end; exit 130' INT TERM
   268	  trap 'dash_end; exit 129' HUP
   269	  trap 'dash_end; exit 131' QUIT
   270	  trap dash_end EXIT
   271	  trap 'DASH_WINCH=1' WINCH
   272	  dash_begin
   273	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   274	    while hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
   275	      DASH_WINCH=0
   276	      dash_paint "$(hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   277	      [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_SEC:-2}"
   278	    done
   279	    sleep 1   # let the runner write exit.json
   280	  fi
   281	  local sz="" now
   282	  while :; do
   283	    DASH_WINCH=0; now=$(dash_size)
   284	    if [ "$now" != "$sz" ]; then
   285	      sz=$now
   286	      dash_paint "$(HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   287	    fi
   288	    # the ask was removed or replaced: nothing left to show
   289	    [ "$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] || break
   290	    [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC:-1}"
   291	  done
   292	  dash_end
   293	}

1	# harness-dash.sh — the viewer dashboard frame for `harness watch <role>` (a live run).
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only, no side effects. hl_dash_frame is a pure
     3	# render (inputs: .harness/asks/<role>.*, the stream, verify/<role>.*) -> text on stdout; the
     4	# redraw loop lives in cmd_watch. bash 3.2 + jq; Recent reuses harness-view (PATH).
     5	
     6	# dash_fmt_dur <seconds> — 45s | 12m04s | 1h02m
     7	dash_fmt_dur() {
     8	  local s=${1:-0}
     9	  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*) s=0 ;; esac
    10	  if [ "$s" -ge 3600 ]; then printf '%dh%02dm' $((s / 3600)) $((s % 3600 / 60))
    11	  elif [ "$s" -ge 60 ]; then printf '%dm%02ds' $((s / 60)) $((s % 60))
    12	  else printf '%ds' "$s"; fi
    13	}
    14	
    15	# dash_min A B
    16	dash_min() { if [ "$1" -lt "$2" ]; then echo "$1"; else echo "$2"; fi; }
    17	
    18	# dash_brief <role> — title line, then "S<TAB>step" / "H<TAB>heading" lines. The brief is the task
    19	# file only when the ask's prompt names it; otherwise the prompt text itself (first line, no steps).
    20	dash_brief() {
    21	  local role=$1 p="$ASK_DIR/$1.prompt" f=".harness/task-$1.md"
    22	  if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF "$f" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    23	    awk '
    24	      BEGIN { t = ""; sec = 0 }
    25	      /^# / && t == "" { t = substr($0, 3); next }
    26	      /^## / { h[++nh] = substr($0, 4); sec = ($0 ~ /^## Steps[ \t]*$/); next }
    27	      sec && /^[0-9]+[.)] / { s = $0; sub(/^[0-9]+[.)] +/, "", s); st[++ns] = ++k ". " s }
    28	      END {
    29	        print (t == "" ? "(untitled brief)" : t)
    30	        if (ns > 0) { for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) print "S\t" st[i] }
    31	        else { for (i = 1; i <= nh; i++) print "H\t" h[i] }
    32	      }' "$f"
    33	  else
    34	    awk 'NR == 1 { print; exit }' "$p" 2>/dev/null
    35	  fi
    36	}
    37	
    38	# dash_facts <raw> — one JSON object of what the stream says (model, turns, ctx, now, verify)
    39	dash_facts() {
    40	  local raw=$1
    41	  { if [ -f "$raw" ]; then cat "$raw"; elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz"; fi; } 2>/dev/null | jq -R -n -c '
    42	    def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    43	    [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
    44	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $i
    45	    | [$e[] | select(.type == "assistant")] as $a
    46	    | ([$a[] | .message.usage?] | map(select(. != null)) | last) as $u
    47	    | [$a[] | (.message.content // [])[] | select((.type == "text" and ((.text // "") | test("\\S"))) or .type == "tool_use")] as $it
    48	    | ($it | last) as $n | ($it | if length > 1 then .[-2] else null end) as $p
    49	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .hook_event == "Stop" and (.subtype == "hook_started" or .subtype == "hook_response"))] | last) as $h
    50	    | {model: ($i.model // "?"),
    51	       turns: ([$a | to_entries[] | (.value.message.id // "n\(.key)")] | unique | length),
    52	       ctx: (if $u then (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)) else 0 end),
    53	       now: (if $n == null then {sum: "", detail: ""}
    54	             elif $n.type == "text" then {sum: "", detail: $n.text}
    55	             else ($n.input // {}) as $in
    56	               | ($in | (.command // .file_path // .pattern // .url // .path // "") | tostring) as $known
    57	               | (if $known != "" then $known elif ($in | type) == "object" and ($in | length) > 0 then ($in | tojson) else "" end) as $arg
    58	               | "\($n.name // "?") \($arg | first_line)" as $fb
    59	               | {sum: (if ((($in.description // "") | tostring) | test("\\S")) then ($in.description | first_line)
    60	                        elif ($p != null and $p.type == "text") then ($p.text | split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S"))) | .[0] // "")
    61	                        else $fb end)} as $o
    62	               | $o + {detail: (if $o.sum == $fb and (($n.name // "") | IN("Read", "Edit", "Write")) then "" else $arg end)} end),
    63	       verify: (if $h == null then "none"
    64	                elif $h.subtype == "hook_started" then "running"
    65	                elif ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block" and ((.reason // "") | test("\\.harness/reports/")))] | length > 0) then "report"
    66	                elif (($h.exit_code // 0) != 0) or ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block")] | length > 0) then "fail"
    67	                else "pass" end)}'
    68	}
    69	
    70	# jq def cw: display columns of a code point (2 = East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth; deliberately conservative: all of
    71	# U+1F000-1FAFF counts 2, overcounting only clips a line early). Autowrap is off while drawing (dash_begin).
    72	DASH_JQ_CW='def cw: [[4352,4447],[8986,8987],[9001,9002],[9193,9196],[9200,9200],[9203,9203],[9725,9726],[9748,9749],
    73	  [9800,9811],[9855,9855],[9875,9875],[9889,9889],[9898,9899],[9917,9918],[9924,9925],[9934,9934],[9940,9940],
    74	  [9962,9962],[9970,9973],[9978,9978],[9981,9981],[9989,9989],[9994,9995],[10024,10024],[10060,10060],
    75	  [10062,10062],[10067,10069],[10071,10071],[10133,10135],[10160,10160],[10175,10175],[11035,11036],
    76	  [11088,11088],[11093,11093],[11904,12350],[12353,13311],[13312,19903],[19968,40959],[40960,42191],
    77	  [44032,55203],[63744,64255],[65040,65049],[65072,65131],[65280,65376],[65504,65510],[126976,129791],
    78	  [131072,262141]] as $r
    79	  | . as $c | if any($r[]; $c >= .[0] and $c <= .[1]) then 2 else 1 end;
    80	# jq def ctl: C0 controls (except \t, handled apart; \n splits lines), DEL and C1 shown as "·", so stream text can
    81	# never drive the terminal (ESC sequences, \r) from inside the frame
    82	def ctl: gsub("[\u0001-\u0008\u000b-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]"; "·");
    83	'
    84	
    85	# dash_wrap <width> <max-lines> — stdin text -> wrapped lines on stdout (by display width, never cut: the rest
    86	# continues on the next line). Blank lines are dropped, tabs become 2 spaces; when more than <max-lines> remain,
    87	# the last kept line ends with "…".
    88	dash_wrap() {
    89	  jq -R -r -s --argjson w "$(( $1 > 2 ? $1 : 2 ))" --argjson m "$2" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
    90	    def wrapline($n): explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, cur: [], out: []};
    91	        ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $n and (.cur | length) > 0 then .out += [.cur] | .cur = [$c] | .w = $k
    92	                          else .cur += [$c] | .w += $k end) | (.out + [.cur]) | map(implode);
    93	    split("\n") | map(gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | select(test("\\S"))) | map(wrapline($w)) | add // []
    94	    | if length > $m then .[0:$m] | .[-1] |= ((wrapline($w - 1) | .[0]) + "…") else . end | .[]'
    95	}
    96	
    97	# dash_size — "H W" of the pane, read fresh on every call: HARNESS_DASH_LINES / HARNESS_DASH_COLS (tests only;
    98	# deliberately not LINES/COLUMNS, which an exported shell value would freeze), else the controlling tty
    99	# (tput inside $(...) has no tty on stdout), else tput, else 24x80. A single override is honoured alone.
   100	dash_size() {
   101	  local sz="" H W
   102	  [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-}" ] && [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-}" ] || sz=$({ stty size </dev/tty; } 2>/dev/null)
   103	  H=${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-${sz%% *}}; W=${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-${sz##* }}
   104	  [ -n "$H" ] || H=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput lines 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$W" ] || W=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput cols 2>/dev/null)
   105	  case "$H" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) H=24 ;; esac
   106	  case "$W" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) W=80 ;; esac
   107	  echo "$H $W"
   108	}
   109	
   110	# dash_nap <seconds> — sleep that a trapped signal (WINCH, INT, ...) interrupts at once (a foreground sleep would
   111	# delay the trap until it returns)
   112	dash_nap() { sleep "$1" & DASH_NAP_PID=$!; wait "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; kill "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }
   113	
   114	# hl_dash_frame <role> <raw> — the dashboard text. Size: dash_size (read per frame). Final frame (result + report head) when the run is not
   115	# live: HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 forces it, else hl_alive decides.
   116	hl_dash_frame() {
   117	  local role=$1 raw=$2 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" H W id start facts model turns ctx verify now_s dur final=0
   118	  read -r H W <<<"$(dash_size)"
   119	  read -r id start _ < "$a.current" 2>/dev/null
   120	  if [ "${HARNESS_DASH_FINAL:-}" = 1 ] || ! hl_alive "$role"; then final=1; fi
   121	  facts=$(dash_facts "$raw"); [ -n "$facts" ] || facts='{"model":"?","turns":0,"ctx":0,"now":{"sum":"","detail":""},"verify":"none"}'
   122	  model=$(jq -r '.model' <<<"$facts"); turns=$(jq -r '.turns' <<<"$facts")
   123	  ctx=$(jq -r 'if .ctx >= 1000 then "\((.ctx / 1000) | round)k" else "\(.ctx)" end' <<<"$facts")
   124	  verify=$(jq -r '.verify' <<<"$facts")
   125	  # the exit record / report count only when they belong to this ask (not left over from an earlier one)
   126	  local exit_ok=0 rep_ok=0
   127	  if [ -f "$a.exit.json" ] && grep -q "\"ask_id\":\"$id\"" "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null; then exit_ok=1; fi
   128	  if [ -f ".harness/reports/$role.md" ] && ! [ ".harness/reports/$role.md" -ot "$a.current" ]; then rep_ok=1; fi
   129	  if [ "$final" = 1 ] && [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
   130	    dur=$(jq -r '((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   131	  elif digits_only "${start:-}"; then dur=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
   132	  else dur=0; fi
   133	
   134	  local bt brief_lines steps="" heads="" l k
   135	  brief_lines=$(dash_brief "$role")
   136	  bt=$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed -n 1p)
   137	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r k l; do
   138	    case "$k" in S) steps="$steps$l"$'\n' ;; H) heads="$heads$l"$'\n' ;; esac
   139	  done <<<"$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed 1d)"
   140	  [ -n "$steps" ] || steps=$(printf '%s' "$heads" | awk '{ print NR ". " $0 }')
   141	  [ -z "$steps" ] || steps=${steps%$'\n'}
   142	  steps=$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | head -n 10)
   143	
   144	  # verify text: the step of a failed run comes from verify/<role>.json when present
   145	  local vtxt
   146	  case "$verify" in
   147	    none) vtxt="not started" ;;
   148	    running) vtxt="verifying…" ;;
   149	    pass) vtxt="pass" ;;
   150	    report) vtxt="waiting for report" ;;
   151	    *) vtxt="fail"
   152	       if ! [ ".harness/verify/$role.json" -ot "$a.current" ]; then
   153	         l=$(jq -r '.step // empty' ".harness/verify/$role.json" 2>/dev/null)
   154	         [ -z "$l" ] || vtxt="fail ($l)"
   155	       fi ;;
   156	  esac
   157	
   158	  # diff (implementer only): git diff --stat against the base sha of the ask
   159	  local diff="" dwant=0 base
   160	  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then
   161	    base=$(sed -n 1p ".harness/verify/$role.base" 2>/dev/null)
   162	    if [ -n "$base" ]; then
   163	      diff=$(git diff --stat "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null)
   164	      [ -n "$diff" ] || diff="(no changes)"
   165	    else diff="(no baseline)"; fi
   166	    dwant=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l) + 1 ))
   167	    [ "$dwant" -le 6 ] || dwant=6
   168	  fi
   169	
   170	  # line budget, in the order of keeping: header, brief, now/result, steps, verify, diff, recent/report
   171	  local rem=$H hdr=1 abrief=0 anow=0 asteps=0 averify=0 adiff=0 arecent=0 want
   172	  rem=$((rem - 1)); [ "$rem" -ge 0 ] || rem=0
   173	  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { abrief=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
   174	  # Now = summary line + the full command/text wrapped (<= 6 lines): the minimum (summary + 1 detail line) is
   175	  # kept before Steps; the other detail lines come after Diff and before Recent
   176	  local nsum=0 dl="" dn=0 xdet=0 dind="    " nmin=1
   177	  if [ "$final" != 1 ]; then
   178	    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts"); [ -z "$l" ] || nsum=1
   179	    [ "$nsum" = 1 ] || dind="  "
   180	    dl=$(jq -r '.now.detail' <<<"$facts" | dash_wrap $((W - 1 - ${#dind})) 6 | sed "s/^/$dind/")
   181	    [ -z "$dl" ] || dn=$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   182	    nmin=$((nsum + (dn > 0 ? 1 : 0))); [ "$nmin" -ge 1 ] || nmin=1
   183	  fi
   184	  anow=$(dash_min $((nmin + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$final" = 1 ] && anow=$(dash_min 1 "$rem")
   185	  [ "$anow" -ge 2 ] || [ "$final" = 1 ] || anow=0
   186	  rem=$((rem - anow))
   187	  want=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l) ))
   188	  if [ "$want" -gt 0 ]; then asteps=$(dash_min $((want + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ] || asteps=0; rem=$((rem - asteps)); fi
   189	  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { averify=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
   190	  if [ "$dwant" -gt 0 ]; then adiff=$(dash_min "$dwant" "$rem"); [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ] || adiff=0; rem=$((rem - adiff)); fi
   191	  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ "$anow" -ge "$((nmin + 1))" ] && [ "$dn" -gt 1 ]; then
   192	    xdet=$(dash_min $((dn - 1)) "$rem"); anow=$((anow + xdet)); rem=$((rem - xdet))
   193	  fi
   194	  [ "$rem" -ge 2 ] && arecent=$rem
   195	
   196	  local out="" sec="── "
   197	  # idle: seconds since the stream last grew (file mtime), shown from 10 s while the run is live
   198	  local idle="" mt
   199	  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ -f "$raw" ] && mt=$(file_mtime "$raw") && [ $(( $(date +%s) - mt )) -ge 10 ]; then
   200	    idle=" · idle $(dash_fmt_dur $(( $(date +%s) - mt )))"
   201	  fi
   202	  out=$(printf '%s  %s  ⏱ %s%s  turns %s  ctx %s  %s' "$role" "${id:-?}" "$(dash_fmt_dur "$dur")" "$idle" "$turns" "$ctx" "$model")
   203	  [ "$abrief" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Brief ── $bt"
   204	  if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
   205	    if [ "$anow" -ge 1 ]; then
   206	      if [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
   207	        l=$(jq -r '"■ \(.result // "ended") · rc \(.rc // "?") · \(.num_turns // 0) turns · \(((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor)s · $\(.cost_usd // 0)"' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   208	      else l="■ ended (no result)"; fi
   209	      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Result ── $l"
   210	    fi
   211	  elif [ "$anow" -ge 2 ]; then
   212	    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts" | sed '/^$/d' | sed 's/^/  → /')
   213	    [ -z "$dl" ] || l="${l:+$l$'\n'}$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | head -n $((anow - 1 - nsum)))"
   214	    [ -n "$l" ] || l="  (waiting for output)"
   215	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Now ──"$'\n'"$l"
   216	  fi
   217	  if [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ]; then
   218	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Steps ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | head -n $((asteps - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')"
   219	  fi
   220	  [ "$averify" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Verify ── $vtxt"
   221	  if [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ]; then
   222	    local nd=$((adiff - 1)) total
   223	    total=$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l)
   224	    if [ "$total" -gt "$nd" ]; then diff=$({ [ "$nd" -le 1 ] || printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed -n "1,$((nd - 1))p"; printf '%s\n' "$diff" | tail -n 1; }); fi
   225	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Diff ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed 's/^/  /')"
   226	  fi
   227	  if [ "$arecent" -ge 2 ]; then
   228	    if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
   229	      l=""; [ "$rep_ok" != 1 ] || l=$(head -n $((arecent - 1)) ".harness/reports/$role.md" 2>/dev/null)
   230	      [ -n "$l" ] || l="(no report)"
   231	      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Report ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$l" | sed 's/^/  /')"
   232	    else
   233	      l=$(tail -n 400 "$raw" 2>/dev/null | harness-view 2>/dev/null | tail -n $((arecent - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')
   234	      [ -z "$l" ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Recent ──"$'\n'"$l"
   235	    fi
   236	  fi
   237	  # cut by display width (East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth incl. emoji = 2 columns; jq works in code points, bash 3.2
   238	  # ${v:0:n} in bytes) so no line wraps; a line is clipped, never wrapped. Tabs become 2 spaces first.
   239	  # Cut at W-1 columns: the trailing \033[K (dash_paint) must never erase the last glyph with autowrap off.
   240	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | jq -R -r --argjson w "$((W > 1 ? W - 1 : 1))" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
   241	    gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, o: [], f: false};
   242	      if .f then . else ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $w then .f = true else .w += $k | .o += [$c] end end)
   243	    | .o | implode'
   244	}
   245	
   246	# dash_begin / dash_end — hide the cursor and turn terminal autowrap off while the loop draws, so a width
   247	# miscount can only cut a line short, never wrap or scroll; dash_end restores both and ends the line
   248	# dash_end is idempotent (traps + normal exit may both call it): only the first call after dash_begin prints
   249	DASH_ON=0
   250	dash_begin() { DASH_ON=1; printf '\033[?25l\033[?7l'; }
   251	dash_end() { [ "$DASH_ON" = 1 ] || return 0; DASH_ON=0; printf '\033[?7h\033[?25h\n'; }
   252	
   253	# dash_paint <frame> — redraw in place (no full clear, so no flicker): home, each line cleared to its
   254	# end, then everything below the frame cleared
   255	dash_paint() {
   256	  printf '\033[H'
   257	  # no newline after the last line: a frame of exactly H lines would scroll the pane by one every tick
   258	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk 'BEGIN { e = sprintf("%c", 27) } { if (NR > 1) printf "\n"; printf "%s%s[K", $0, e }'
   259	  printf '\033[J'
   260	}
   261	
   262	# dash_watch <role> <raw> <id> — the viewer loop: live frames every HARNESS_DASH_SEC and on SIGWINCH, then the final
   263	# frame, kept alive and re-rendered on a size change (polled every HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC too) until HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT
   264	# or the ask is removed or replaced. dash_end runs on every exit path.
   265	dash_watch() {
   266	  local role=$1 raw=$2 id=$3
   267	  trap 'dash_end; exit 130' INT TERM
   268	  trap 'dash_end; exit 129' HUP
   269	  trap 'dash_end; exit 131' QUIT
   270	  trap dash_end EXIT
   271	  trap 'DASH_WINCH=1' WINCH
   272	  dash_begin
   273	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   274	    while hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
   275	      DASH_WINCH=0
   276	      dash_paint "$(hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   277	      [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_SEC:-2}"
   278	    done
   279	    sleep 1   # let the runner write exit.json
   280	  fi
   281	  local sz="" now
   282	  while :; do
   283	    DASH_WINCH=0; now=$(dash_size)
   284	    if [ "$now" != "$sz" ]; then
   285	      sz=$now
   286	      dash_paint "$(HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   287	    fi
   288	    # the ask was removed or replaced: nothing left to show
   289	    [ "$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] || break
