1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-verify — computational checks (format, lint, test) for harness workers.
     6	#
     7	#   harness-verify detect                 print resolved commands as JSON
     8	#   harness-verify format [file]          PostToolUse hook (reads hook JSON on stdin if no file)
     9	#   harness-verify stop                   Stop hook (reads hook JSON on stdin)
    10	#   harness-verify done ROLE              Stop hook, no checks: only the report gate
    11	#   harness-verify run [lint|test|all]    manual / reviewer: exit 0 pass, 1 fail
    12	#   harness-verify baseline [agent]       record the start state (harness ask calls it)
    13	#
    14	# Never blocks a worker because of its own prerequisites: jq missing, not a git
    15	# repo, or no config all exit 0 (with at most one stderr line).
    16	set -u
    17	
    18	# Shared role list from lib/harness-defaults.sh, sourced eagerly (see bin/harness). This is a
    19	# Stop hook: a missing lib must never fail it, so fall back to the literal list below.
    20	src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
    21	while [ -L "$src" ]; do
    22	  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
    23	  src=$(readlink "$src")
    24	  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
    25	done
    26	case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
    27	HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
    28	if ! . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-defaults.sh" 2>/dev/null; then
    29	  HARNESS_ROLES="analyst implementer reviewer"
    30	  role_in() { case " ${2-$HARNESS_ROLES} " in *" $1 "*) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
    31	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-defaults.sh not found; using the built-in role list" >&2
    32	fi
    33	. "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || {
    34	  harness_root() { return 1; }
    35	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-root.sh not found; root = cwd" >&2
    36	}
    37	unset src d
    38	# end loader
    39	
    40	warn() { echo "harness-verify: $*" >&2; }
    41	
    42	if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    43	  warn "jq not found, skipping"
    44	  exit 0
    45	fi
    46	
    47	STATE_REL=".harness/verify"
    48	IS_GIT=0
    49	ROOT=$PWD
    50	HOOK_CWD=$PWD
    51	AGENT=implementer
    52	STEP_OUT=""
    53	RAN=0
    54	
    55	# enter_root [dir] — cd to the harness root of dir (hook stdin cwd, else the process cwd)
    56	# via harness_root (lib/harness-root.sh); no root found: stay at the cwd. Sets HOOK_CWD,
    57	# IS_GIT and ROOT. bin/harness keeps .harness/ in the conductor's cwd, which may be a
    58	# repo subdir; a worker that ended its turn deeper (cd src) must still land on that same .harness/.
    59	enter_root() {
    60	  local r
    61	  [ -z "${1:-}" ] || cd "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
    62	  HOOK_CWD=$(pwd -P)
    63	  if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ]; then IS_GIT=1; else IS_GIT=0; fi
    64	  r=$(harness_root "$HOOK_CWD") && cd "$r" 2>/dev/null || true
    65	  ROOT=$(pwd -P)
    66	}
    67	
    68	# set_agent NAME — only plain names are used in state file paths
    69	set_agent() {
    70	  case "${1:-}" in
    71	    ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;;
    72	    *) AGENT=$1 ;;
    73	  esac
    74	}
    75	
    76	# --- config --------------------------------------------------------------------
    77	
    78	# cfg_get KEY -> prints the JSON value from the first config file that has KEY
    79	cfg_get() {
    80	  local f
    81	  for f in .harness/verify.local.json .claude/harness.json; do
    82	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    83	    if jq -e --arg k "$1" 'type == "object" and has($k)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    84	      jq -c --arg k "$1" '.[$k]' "$f"
    85	      return 0
    86	    fi
    87	  done
    88	  return 1
    89	}
    90	
    91	# resolve_step KEY -> command string, or nothing when the step is disabled/absent
    92	# (explicit config only: no language or project-type detection)
    93	resolve_step() {
    94	  local v
    95	  if v=$(cfg_get "$1"); then
    96	    printf '%s' "$v" | jq -r 'if type == "string" then . else empty end'
    97	  fi
    98	}
    99	
   100	max_attempts() {
   101	  local v
   102	  v=$(cfg_get maxAttempts 2>/dev/null)
   103	  case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) v=3 ;; esac
   104	  echo "$v"
   105	}
   106	
   107	cmd_detect() {
   108	  local f l t a m
   109	  f=$(resolve_step format); l=$(resolve_step lint); t=$(resolve_step test)
   110	  a=$(cfg_get app 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$a" ] || a=null
   111	  m=$(max_attempts)
   112	  if [ -z "$f$l$t" ] && [ "$a" = null ]; then
   113	    warn "nothing configured: put {\"test\": \"...\"} in .claude/harness.json (or .harness/verify.local.json)"
   114	  fi
   115	  jq -n -c --arg f "$f" --arg l "$l" --arg t "$t" --argjson a "$a" --argjson m "$m" '
   116	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
   117	    {format: ($f | nz), lint: ($l | nz), test: ($t | nz), app: $a, maxAttempts: $m}'
   118	}
   119	
   120	# --- files ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   121	
   122	# changed_files [BASE] -> files (relative to the cwd) changed since BASE (default:
   123	# the baseline, else HEAD) plus untracked ones, one per line
   124	changed_files() {
   125	  local base=${1:-} f
   126	  [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ] || return 0
   127	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   128	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=HEAD
   129	  { git -c core.quotepath=off diff --relative --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   130	    git -c core.quotepath=off ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   131	  } | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do
   132	    [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\n' "$f"
   133	  done
   134	}
   135	
   136	# change_class -> docs-only|wiki|code: what the ask changed since its baseline.
   137	# Paths = committed since the baseline HEAD + staged + unstaged (git diff BASE,
   138	# deletions included) + untracked. Source committed in an EARLIER ask is not
   139	# "since baseline" (the baseline is per ask), so it never counts. Every path under
   140	# docs/ or .harness/ -> docs-only (wiki when any is under docs/wiki/); anything else
   141	# (AGENTS.md, README.md and agents/*.md included: tests read them) -> code.
   142	# docs/ and .harness/ are ROOT's (the cwd's): paths are listed from the git toplevel
   143	# with rename detection off (a move into docs/ lists the source path too), and any
   144	# path outside ROOT counts as code.
   145	change_class() {
   146	  local base f top rel wiki=0 any=0
   147	  base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   148	  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo code; return; }
   149	  git rev-parse --verify -q "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo code; return; }
   150	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo code; return; }
   151	  top=$(cd "$top" && pwd -P)
   152	  # prefix of ROOT (the cwd) inside the toplevel: "" at the top, "pkg/" in a subdir
   153	  rel=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)
   154	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   155	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   156	    any=1
   157	    case "$f" in
   158	      "$rel"docs/wiki/*) wiki=1 ;;
   159	      "$rel"docs/*|"$rel".harness/*) ;;
   160	      *) echo code; return ;;
   161	    esac
   162	  done <<EOF_PATHS
   163	$({ git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-renames --name-only "$base" 2>/dev/null
   164	    git -c core.quotepath=off -C "$top" ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u)
   165	EOF_PATHS
   166	  [ "$any" = 1 ] || { echo code; return; }
   167	  if [ "$wiki" = 1 ]; then echo wiki; else echo docs-only; fi
   168	}
   169	
   170	# harness_bin -> path of the sibling `harness` (symlink-resolved), else PATH
   171	harness_bin() {
   172	  local s=${BASH_SOURCE[0]} d
   173	  while [ -h "$s" ]; do
   174	    d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd); s=$(readlink "$s")
   175	    case "$s" in /*) ;; *) s="$d/$s" ;; esac
   176	  done
   177	  d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd)
   178	  if [ -x "$d/harness" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$d/harness"; else command -v harness; fi
   179	}
   180	
   181	# quote_files -> stdin lines to one shell-quoted, space-separated string
   182	quote_files() {
   183	  local f out=""
   184	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   185	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   186	    out="$out $(printf '%q' "$f")"
   187	  done
   188	  printf '%s' "${out# }"
   189	}
   190	
   191	# expand_files CMD QUOTED -> CMD with every {files} replaced
   192	expand_files() {
   193	  local c=$1 q=$2 tok='{files}' out=""
   194	  while :; do
   195	    case "$c" in
   196	      *"$tok"*) out="$out${c%%"$tok"*}$q"; c=${c#*"$tok"} ;;
   197	      *) break ;;
   198	    esac
   199	  done
   200	  printf '%s' "$out$c"
   201	}
   202	
   203	# --- running steps -------------------------------------------------------------
   204	
   205	# run_step STEP FILES — STEP is lint|test, FILES newline-separated. Sets
   206	# STEP_OUT, RAN. Returns the command's status; 0 when the step is absent or has
   207	# {files} but no (matching) files exist.
   208	run_step() {
   209	  local cmd q rc
   210	  STEP_OUT=""
   211	  cmd=$(resolve_step "$1")
   212	  [ -n "$cmd" ] || return 0
   213	  case "$cmd" in
   214	    *'{files}'*)
   215	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "${2:-}" | quote_files)
   216	      [ -n "$q" ] || return 0
   217	      cmd=$(expand_files "$cmd" "$q") ;;
   218	  esac
   219	  RAN=1
   220	  STEP_OUT=$(/bin/bash -c "$cmd" </dev/null 2>&1)
   221	  rc=$?
   222	  return $rc
   223	}
   224	
   225	tail40() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | tail -n 40; }
   226	
   227	cmd_run() {
   228	  local what=${1:-all} files="" rc=0 ran_any=0 baseref=main mb="" explicit=0
   229	  case "$what" in lint|test|all) shift ;; --*) what=all ;; *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;; esac
   230	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   231	    case "$1" in
   232	      --base) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { warn "--base needs a ref"; exit 1; }; baseref=$2; explicit=1; shift 2 ;;
   233	      *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;;
   234	    esac
   235	  done
   236	  enter_root
   237	  if [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ]; then
   238	    if [ "$explicit" = 0 ] && ! git rev-parse --verify -q "$baseref^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   239	      baseref=master
   240	    fi
   241	    mb=$(git merge-base "$baseref" HEAD 2>/dev/null) || mb=""
   242	    if [ -z "$mb" ]; then
   243	      warn "base ref '$baseref' does not resolve (use --base <ref>)"
   244	      exit 2
   245	    fi
   246	  fi
   247	  files=$(changed_files "$mb")
   248	  [ -n "$files" ] || warn "no changed files versus $baseref"
   249	  if [ "$what" = lint ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   250	    RAN=0
   251	    run_step lint "$files" || rc=1
   252	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== lint ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   253	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   254	  fi
   255	  if [ "$what" = test ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   256	    RAN=0
   257	    run_step test "$files" || rc=1
   258	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== test ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   259	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   260	  fi
   261	  [ "$ran_any" -eq 1 ] || echo "harness-verify: nothing to run"
   262	  exit 0
   263	}
   264	
   265	# --- state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   266	
   267	# state_id -> HEAD sha and a hash of the working tree changes (outside .harness/)
   268	state_id() {
   269	  local head h
   270	  head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
   271	  h=$({ git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   272	        git diff HEAD -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   273	        git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' | while IFS= read -r f; do
   274	          printf '%s\n' "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
   275	        done; } 2>/dev/null | cksum)
   276	  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$head" "$h"
   277	}
   278	
   279	write_result() { # status step tail attempts
   280	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   281	  jq -n -c --arg s "$1" --arg st "$2" --arg t "$3" --argjson a "${4:-0}" \
   282	    '{status: $s, attempts: $a, step: $st, tail: $t}' > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json"
   283	}
   284	
   285	cmd_baseline() {
   286	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   287	  enter_root
   288	  # after a verify FAIL keep the original .base: the next ask must still compare
   289	  # against the tree the failing work started from
   290	  local prev=""
   291	  prev=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json" 2>/dev/null)
   292	  rm -f "${STATE_REL:?}/${AGENT:?}.json" ".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md.pending"
   293	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   294	    warn "not a git repo, no baseline"
   295	    exit 0
   296	  fi
   297	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   298	  if [ "$prev" != fail ] || [ ! -s "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ]; then
   299	    state_id > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base"
   300	  fi
   301	  echo 0 > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   302	  exit 0
   303	}
   304	
   305	# --- hooks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   306	
   307	# cmd_done ROLE — Stop hook for workers without verification (analyst, reviewer): the report gate only
   308	cmd_done() {
   309	  local input
   310	  input=$(cat)
   311	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   312	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   313	  report_gate
   314	  exit 0
   315	}
   316	
   317	# cmd_stop — verification Stop hook: runs the checks and prints their block decision, if any.
   318	cmd_stop() {
   319	  local input out
   320	  input=$(cat)
   321	  # the verification runs in a subshell (it exits through many paths)
   322	  out=$(STOP_INPUT=$input stop_body)
   323	  [ -z "$out" ] || printf '%s\n' "$out"
   324	  exit 0
   325	}
   326	
   327	# report_gate — a harness ask must end with a fresh report: block the stop (at most twice per ask)
   328	# so the worker writes it instead of the ask exiting 3. `[no-report]` opts out, as a marker only: at the
   329	# start of the instruction, or on a line of its own in the brief the instruction points at.
   330	report_gate() {
   331	  local a=.harness/asks/$AGENT id n brief rep=.harness/reports/$AGENT.md
   332	  case "$AGENT" in analyst|implementer|reviewer) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
   333	  [ -f "$a.current" ] || return 0
   334	  case "$(head -n 1 "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null)" in '[no-report]'*) return 0 ;; esac
   335	  # an instruction that only says "Read .harness/<brief>.md and do it": the opt-out may sit in the brief
   336	  brief=$(sed -n 's/.*Read \(\.harness\/[^ ]*\.md\).*/\1/p' "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
   337	  case "$brief" in ''|*..*) ;; *) grep -qx '[[:space:]]*\[no-report\][[:space:]]*' "$brief" 2>/dev/null && return 0 ;; esac
   338	  [ -f "$rep" ] && [ ! "$rep" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   339	  [ -f "$rep.pending" ] && [ ! "$rep.pending" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   340	  id=$(awk 'NR==1 { print $1 }' "$a.current")
   341	  n=$(awk -v i="$id" '$1==i { print $2 }' "$a.reportblocks" 2>/dev/null)
   342	  case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) n=0 ;; esac
   343	  [ "$n" -lt 2 ] || return 0
   344	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" $((n + 1)) > "$a.reportblocks"
   345	  jq -n -c --arg r "write .harness/reports/$AGENT.md for this ask (the report contract in your prompt), then stop" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   346	  exit 0
   347	}
   348	
   349	stop_body() {
   350	  local input=$STOP_INPUT attempts max files step="" out reason rep pend cls hb
   351	  set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   352	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   353	  report_gate
   354	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   355	    exit 0
   356	  fi
   357	  if [ -f "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ] && [ "$(state_id)" = "$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base")" ]; then
   358	    write_result skipped "" "" 0
   359	    exit 0
   360	  fi
   361	  # hide the report while verifying so `harness ask/report` never sees an unverified one
   362	  rep=".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md"; pend="$rep.pending"
   363	  [ ! -f "$rep" ] || mv -f "$rep" "$pend"
   364	  attempts=$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts" 2>/dev/null)
   365	  case "$attempts" in ''|*[!0-9]*) attempts=0 ;; esac
   366	  max=$(max_attempts)
   367	  files=$(changed_files)
   368	
   369	  RAN=0
   370	  cls=$(change_class)
   371	  if [ "$cls" = wiki ]; then
   372	    # docs/wiki changed: only the wiki checks run, no lint / test suite
   373	    hb=$(harness_bin)
   374	    if [ -n "$hb" ] && ! out=$("$hb" wiki-lint 2>&1); then step=wiki-lint; fi
   375	    if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   376	      [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   377	      write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   378	      exit 0
   379	    fi
   380	  elif [ "$cls" = docs-only ]; then
   381	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   382	    write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   383	    exit 0
   384	  elif ! run_step lint "$files"; then
   385	    step=lint; out=$STEP_OUT
   386	  elif ! run_step test "$files"; then
   387	    step=test; out=$STEP_OUT
   388	  fi
   389	  if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   390	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   391	    if [ "$RAN" -eq 1 ]; then write_result pass "" "" "$attempts"; else write_result skipped "" "" "$attempts"; fi
   392	    exit 0
   393	  fi
   394	  out=$(tail40 "$out")
   395	  if [ "$attempts" -lt "$max" ]; then
   396	    attempts=$((attempts + 1))
   397	    echo "$attempts" > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   398	    rm -f "$pend"
   399	    write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   400	    reason=$(printf 'Verification failed at step %s (attempt %s of %s). Last output:\n%s\n\nFix the cause and finish again; then rewrite the report.' "$step" "$attempts" "$max" "$out")
   401	    jq -n -c --arg r "$reason" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   402	    exit 0
   403	  fi
   404	  # cap reached: keep the worker's final report so `harness ask` exits 5 with it
   405	  [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   406	  write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   407	  exit 0
   408	}
   409	
   410	cmd_format() {
   411	  local input="" file="${1:-}" tool cwd q out fcmd lcmd d
   412	  if [ -z "$file" ]; then
   413	    input=$(cat)
   414	    tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   415	    case "$tool" in
   416	      Edit|Write|MultiEdit) ;;
   417	      *) exit 0 ;;
   418	    esac
   419	    file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   420	    cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   421	    set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   422	  else
   423	    cwd=""
   424	  fi
   425	  enter_root "$cwd"
   426	  [ -n "$file" ] || exit 0
   427	  case "$file" in
   428	    /*)
   429	      # compare physical paths (macOS /var -> /private/var)
   430	      d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${file%/*}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0
   431	      file="$d/${file##*/}"
   432	      case "$file" in
   433	        "$ROOT"/*) file=${file#"$ROOT"/} ;;
   434	        *) exit 0 ;;
   435	      esac ;;
   436	  esac
   437	  case "$file" in .harness/*|.git/*|*/../*|../*) exit 0 ;; esac
   438	  [ -f "$file" ] || exit 0
   439	  fcmd=$(resolve_step format)
   440	  if [ -n "$fcmd" ]; then
   441	    case "$fcmd" in
   442	      *'{files}'*)
   443	        q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   444	        fcmd=$(expand_files "$fcmd" "$q") ;;
   445	    esac
   446	    [ -z "$fcmd" ] || /bin/bash -c "$fcmd" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   447	  fi
   448	  lcmd=$(resolve_step lint)
   449	  case "$lcmd" in
   450	    *'{files}'*)
   451	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   452	      lcmd=$(expand_files "$lcmd" "$q")
   453	      if ! out=$(/bin/bash -c "$lcmd" </dev/null 2>&1); then
   454	        out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -n 40)
   455	        jq -n -c --arg r "$(printf 'Lint failed for %s:\n%s' "$file" "$out")" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   456	      fi ;;
   457	  esac
   458	  exit 0
   459	}
   460	
   461	case "${1:-}" in
   462	  detect)   enter_root; cmd_detect ;;
   463	  format)   shift; cmd_format "$@" ;;
   464	  stop)     cmd_stop ;;
   465	  done)     shift; cmd_done "$@" ;;
   466	  run)      shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
   467	  baseline) shift; cmd_baseline "$@" ;;
   468	  *)
   469	    echo "usage: harness-verify detect | format [file] | stop | done ROLE | run [lint|test|all] | baseline [agent]" >&2
   470	    exit 1 ;;
   471	esac
   472	exit $?
   473	}

tool_use_result.stdout:
1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-verify — computational checks (format, lint, test) for harness workers.
     6	#
     7	#   harness-verify detect                 print resolved commands as JSON
     8	#   harness-verify format [file]          PostToolUse hook (reads hook JSON on stdin if no file)
     9	#   harness-verify stop                   Stop hook (reads hook JSON on stdin)
    10	#   harness-verify done ROLE              Stop hook, no checks: only the report gate
    11	#   harness-verify run [lint|test|all]    manual / reviewer: exit 0 pass, 1 fail
    12	#   harness-verify baseline [agent]       record the start state (harness ask calls it)
    13	#
    14	# Never blocks a worker because of its own prerequisites: jq missing, not a git
    15	# repo, or no config all exit 0 (with at most one stderr line).
    16	set -u
    17	
    18	# Shared role list from lib/harness-defaults.sh, sourced eagerly (see bin/harness). This is a
    19	# Stop hook: a missing lib must never fail it, so fall back to the literal list below.
    20	src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
    21	while [ -L "$src" ]; do
    22	  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
    23	  src=$(readlink "$src")
    24	  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
    25	done
    26	case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
    27	HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
    28	if ! . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-defaults.sh" 2>/dev/null; then
    29	  HARNESS_ROLES="analyst implementer reviewer"
    30	  role_in() { case " ${2-$HARNESS_ROLES} " in *" $1 "*) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
    31	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-defaults.sh not found; using the built-in role list" >&2
    32	fi
    33	. "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || {
    34	  harness_root() { return 1; }
    35	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-root.sh not found; root = cwd" >&2
    36	}
    37	unset src d
    38	# end loader
    39	
    40	warn() { echo "harness-verify: $*" >&2; }
    41	
    42	if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    43	  warn "jq not found, skipping"
    44	  exit 0
    45	fi
    46	
    47	STATE_REL=".harness/verify"
    48	IS_GIT=0
    49	ROOT=$PWD
    50	HOOK_CWD=$PWD
    51	AGENT=implementer
    52	STEP_OUT=""
    53	RAN=0
    54	
    55	# enter_root [dir] — cd to the harness root of dir (hook stdin cwd, else the process cwd)
    56	# via harness_root (lib/harness-root.sh); no root found: stay at the cwd. Sets HOOK_CWD,
    57	# IS_GIT and ROOT. bin/harness keeps .harness/ in the conductor's cwd, which may be a
    58	# repo subdir; a worker that ended its turn deeper (cd src) must still land on that same .harness/.
    59	enter_root() {
    60	  local r
    61	  [ -z "${1:-}" ] || cd "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
    62	  HOOK_CWD=$(pwd -P)
    63	  if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ]; then IS_GIT=1; else IS_GIT=0; fi
    64	  r=$(harness_root "$HOOK_CWD") && cd "$r" 2>/dev/null || true
    65	  ROOT=$(pwd -P)
    66	}
    67	
    68	# set_agent NAME — only plain names are used in state file paths
    69	set_agent() {
    70	  case "${1:-}" in
    71	    ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;;
    72	    *) AGENT=$1 ;;
    73	  esac
    74	}
    75	
    76	# --- config --------------------------------------------------------------------
    77	
    78	# cfg_get KEY -> prints the JSON value from the first config file that has KEY
    79	cfg_get() {
    80	  local f
    81	  for f in .harness/verify.local.json .claude/harness.json; do
    82	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    83	    if jq -e --arg k "$1" 'type == "object" and has($k)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    84	      jq -c --arg k "$1" '.[$k]' "$f"
    85	      return 0
    86	    fi
    87	  done
    88	  return 1
    89	}
    90	
    91	# resolve_step KEY -> command string, or nothing when the step is disabled/absent
    92	# (explicit config only: no language or project-type detection)
    93	resolve_step() {
    94	  local v
    95	  if v=$(cfg_get "$1"); then
    96	    printf '%s' "$v" | jq -r 'if type == "string" then . else empty end'
    97	  fi
    98	}
    99	
   100	max_attempts() {
   101	  local v
   102	  v=$(cfg_get maxAttempts 2>/dev/null)
   103	  case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) v=3 ;; esac
   104	  echo "$v"
   105	}
   106	
   107	cmd_detect() {
   108	  local f l t a m
   109	  f=$(resolve_step format); l=$(resolve_step lint); t=$(resolve_step test)
   110	  a=$(cfg_get app 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$a" ] || a=null
   111	  m=$(max_attempts)
   112	  if [ -z "$f$l$t" ] && [ "$a" = null ]; then
   113	    warn "nothing configured: put {\"test\": \"...\"} in .claude/harness.json (or .harness/verify.local.json)"
   114	  fi
   115	  jq -n -c --arg f "$f" --arg l "$l" --arg t "$t" --argjson a "$a" --argjson m "$m" '
   116	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
   117	    {format: ($f | nz), lint: ($l | nz), test: ($t | nz), app: $a, maxAttempts: $m}'
   118	}
   119	
   120	# --- files ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   121	
   122	# changed_files [BASE] -> files (relative to the cwd) changed since BASE (default:
   123	# the baseline, else HEAD) plus untracked ones, one per line
   124	changed_files() {
   125	  local base=${1:-} f
   126	  [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ] || return 0
   127	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   128	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=HEAD
   129	  { git -c core.quotepath=off diff --relative --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   130	    git -c core.quotepath=off ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   131	  } | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do
   132	    [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\n' "$f"
   133	  done
   134	}
   135	
   136	# change_class -> docs-only|wiki|code: what the ask changed since its baseline.
   137	# Paths = committed since the baseline HEAD + staged + unstaged (git diff BASE,
   138	# deletions included) + untracked. Source committed in an EARLIER ask is not
   139	# "since baseline" (the baseline is per ask), so it never counts. Every path under
   140	# docs/ or .harness/ -> docs-only (wiki when any is under docs/wiki/); anything else
   141	# (AGENTS.md, README.md and agents/*.md included: tests read them) -> code.
   142	# docs/ and .harness/ are ROOT's (the cwd's): paths are listed from the git toplevel
   143	# with rename detection off (a move into docs/ lists the source path too), and any
   144	# path outside ROOT counts as code.
   145	change_class() {
   146	  local base f top rel wiki=0 any=0
   147	  base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   148	  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo code; return; }
   149	  git rev-parse --verify -q "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo code; return; }
   150	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo code; return; }
   151	  top=$(cd "$top" && pwd -P)
   152	  # prefix of ROOT (the cwd) inside the toplevel: "" at the top, "pkg/" in a subdir
   153	  rel=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)
   154	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   155	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   156	    any=1
   157	    case "$f" in
   158	      "$rel"docs/wiki/*) wiki=1 ;;
   159	      "$rel"docs/*|"$rel".harness/*) ;;
   160	      *) echo code; return ;;
   161	    esac
   162	  done <<EOF_PATHS
   163	$({ git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-renames --name-only "$base" 2>/dev/null
   164	    git -c core.quotepath=off -C "$top" ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u)
   165	EOF_PATHS
   166	  [ "$any" = 1 ] || { echo code; return; }
   167	  if [ "$wiki" = 1 ]; then echo wiki; else echo docs-only; fi
   168	}
   169	
   170	# harness_bin -> path of the sibling `harness` (symlink-resolved), else PATH
   171	harness_bin() {
   172	  local s=${BASH_SOURCE[0]} d
   173	  while [ -h "$s" ]; do
   174	    d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd); s=$(readlink "$s")
   175	    case "$s" in /*) ;; *) s="$d/$s" ;; esac
   176	  done
   177	  d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd)
   178	  if [ -x "$d/harness" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$d/harness"; else command -v harness; fi
   179	}
   180	
   181	# quote_files -> stdin lines to one shell-quoted, space-separated string
   182	quote_files() {
   183	  local f out=""
   184	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   185	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   186	    out="$out $(printf '%q' "$f")"
   187	  done
   188	  printf '%s' "${out# }"
   189	}
   190	
   191	# expand_files CMD QUOTED -> CMD with every {files} replaced
   192	expand_files() {
   193	  local c=$1 q=$2 tok='{files}' out=""
   194	  while :; do
   195	    case "$c" in
   196	      *"$tok"*) out="$out${c%%"$tok"*}$q"; c=${c#*"$tok"} ;;
   197	      *) break ;;
   198	    esac
   199	  done
   200	  printf '%s' "$out$c"
   201	}
   202	
   203	# --- running steps -------------------------------------------------------------
   204	
   205	# run_step STEP FILES — STEP is lint|test, FILES newline-separated. Sets
   206	# STEP_OUT, RAN. Returns the command's status; 0 when the step is absent or has
   207	# {files} but no (matching) files exist.
   208	run_step() {
   209	  local cmd q rc
   210	  STEP_OUT=""
   211	  cmd=$(resolve_step "$1")
   212	  [ -n "$cmd" ] || return 0
   213	  case "$cmd" in
   214	    *'{files}'*)
   215	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "${2:-}" | quote_files)
   216	      [ -n "$q" ] || return 0
   217	      cmd=$(expand_files "$cmd" "$q") ;;
   218	  esac
   219	  RAN=1
   220	  STEP_OUT=$(/bin/bash -c "$cmd" </dev/null 2>&1)
   221	  rc=$?
   222	  return $rc
   223	}
   224	
   225	tail40() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | tail -n 40; }
   226	
   227	cmd_run() {
   228	  local what=${1:-all} files="" rc=0 ran_any=0 baseref=main mb="" explicit=0
   229	  case "$what" in lint|test|all) shift ;; --*) what=all ;; *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;; esac
   230	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   231	    case "$1" in
   232	      --base) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { warn "--base needs a ref"; exit 1; }; baseref=$2; explicit=1; shift 2 ;;
   233	      *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;;
   234	    esac
   235	  done
   236	  enter_root
   237	  if [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ]; then
   238	    if [ "$explicit" = 0 ] && ! git rev-parse --verify -q "$baseref^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   239	      baseref=master
   240	    fi
   241	    mb=$(git merge-base "$baseref" HEAD 2>/dev/null) || mb=""
   242	    if [ -z "$mb" ]; then
   243	      warn "base ref '$baseref' does not resolve (use --base <ref>)"
   244	      exit 2
   245	    fi
   246	  fi
   247	  files=$(changed_files "$mb")
   248	  [ -n "$files" ] || warn "no changed files versus $baseref"
   249	  if [ "$what" = lint ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   250	    RAN=0
   251	    run_step lint "$files" || rc=1
   252	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== lint ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   253	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   254	  fi
   255	  if [ "$what" = test ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   256	    RAN=0
   257	    run_step test "$files" || rc=1
   258	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== test ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   259	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   260	  fi
   261	  [ "$ran_any" -eq 1 ] || echo "harness-verify: nothing to run"
   262	  exit 0
   263	}
   264	
   265	# --- state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   266	
   267	# state_id -> HEAD sha and a hash of the working tree changes (outside .harness/)
   268	state_id() {
   269	  local head h
   270	  head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
   271	  h=$({ git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   272	        git diff HEAD -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   273	        git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' | while IFS= read -r f; do
   274	          printf '%s\n' "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
   275	        done; } 2>/dev/null | cksum)
   276	  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$head" "$h"
   277	}
   278	
   279	write_result() { # status step tail attempts
   280	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   281	  jq -n -c --arg s "$1" --arg st "$2" --arg t "$3" --argjson a "${4:-0}" \
   282	    '{status: $s, attempts: $a, step: $st, tail: $t}' > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json"
   283	}
   284	
   285	cmd_baseline() {
   286	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   287	  enter_root
   288	  # after a verify FAIL keep the original .base: the next ask must still compare
   289	  # against the tree the failing work started from
   290	  local prev=""
   291	  prev=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json" 2>/dev/null)
   292	  rm -f "${STATE_REL:?}/${AGENT:?}.json" ".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md.pending"
   293	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   294	    warn "not a git repo, no baseline"
   295	    exit 0
   296	  fi
   297	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   298	  if [ "$prev" != fail ] || [ ! -s "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ]; then
   299	    state_id > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base"
   300	  fi
   301	  echo 0 > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   302	  exit 0
   303	}
   304	
   305	# --- hooks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   306	
   307	# cmd_done ROLE — Stop hook for workers without verification (analyst, reviewer): the report gate only
   308	cmd_done() {
   309	  local input
   310	  input=$(cat)
   311	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   312	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   313	  report_gate
   314	  exit 0
   315	}
   316	
   317	# cmd_stop — verification Stop hook: runs the checks and prints their block decision, if any.
   318	cmd_stop() {
   319	  local input out
   320	  input=$(cat)
   321	  # the verification runs in a subshell (it exits through many paths)
   322	  out=$(STOP_INPUT=$input stop_body)
   323	  [ -z "$out" ] || printf '%s\n' "$out"
   324	  exit 0
   325	}
   326	
   327	# report_gate — a harness ask must end with a fresh report: block the stop (at most twice per ask)
   328	# so the worker writes it instead of the ask exiting 3. `[no-report]` opts out, as a marker only: at the
   329	# start of the instruction, or on a line of its own in the brief the instruction points at.
   330	report_gate() {
   331	  local a=.harness/asks/$AGENT id n brief rep=.harness/reports/$AGENT.md
   332	  case "$AGENT" in analyst|implementer|reviewer) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
   333	  [ -f "$a.current" ] || return 0
   334	  case "$(head -n 1 "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null)" in '[no-report]'*) return 0 ;; esac
   335	  # an instruction that only says "Read .harness/<brief>.md and do it": the opt-out may sit in the brief
   336	  brief=$(sed -n 's/.*Read \(\.harness\/[^ ]*\.md\).*/\1/p' "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
   337	  case "$brief" in ''|*..*) ;; *) grep -qx '[[:space:]]*\[no-report\][[:space:]]*' "$brief" 2>/dev/null && return 0 ;; esac
   338	  [ -f "$rep" ] && [ ! "$rep" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   339	  [ -f "$rep.pending" ] && [ ! "$rep.pending" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   340	  id=$(awk 'NR==1 { print $1 }' "$a.current")
   341	  n=$(awk -v i="$id" '$1==i { print $2 }' "$a.reportblocks" 2>/dev/null)
   342	  case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) n=0 ;; esac
   343	  [ "$n" -lt 2 ] || return 0
   344	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" $((n + 1)) > "$a.reportblocks"
   345	  jq -n -c --arg r "write .harness/reports/$AGENT.md for this ask (the report contract in your prompt), then stop" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   346	  exit 0
   347	}
   348	
   349	stop_body() {
   350	  local input=$STOP_INPUT attempts max files step="" out reason rep pend cls hb
   351	  set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   352	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   353	  report_gate
   354	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   355	    exit 0
   356	  fi
   357	  if [ -f "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ] && [ "$(state_id)" = "$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base")" ]; then
   358	    write_result skipped "" "" 0
   359	    exit 0
   360	  fi
   361	  # hide the report while verifying so `harness ask/report` never sees an unverified one
   362	  rep=".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md"; pend="$rep.pending"
   363	  [ ! -f "$rep" ] || mv -f "$rep" "$pend"
   364	  attempts=$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts" 2>/dev/null)
   365	  case "$attempts" in ''|*[!0-9]*) attempts=0 ;; esac
   366	  max=$(max_attempts)
   367	  files=$(changed_files)
   368	
   369	  RAN=0
   370	  cls=$(change_class)
   371	  if [ "$cls" = wiki ]; then
   372	    # docs/wiki changed: only the wiki checks run, no lint / test suite
   373	    hb=$(harness_bin)
   374	    if [ -n "$hb" ] && ! out=$("$hb" wiki-lint 2>&1); then step=wiki-lint; fi
   375	    if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   376	      [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   377	      write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   378	      exit 0
   379	    fi
   380	  elif [ "$cls" = docs-only ]; then
   381	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   382	    write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   383	    exit 0
   384	  elif ! run_step lint "$files"; then
   385	    step=lint; out=$STEP_OUT
   386	  elif ! run_step test "$files"; then
   387	    step=test; out=$STEP_OUT
   388	  fi
   389	  if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   390	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   391	    if [ "$RAN" -eq 1 ]; then write_result pass "" "" "$attempts"; else write_result skipped "" "" "$attempts"; fi
   392	    exit 0
   393	  fi
   394	  out=$(tail40 "$out")
   395	  if [ "$attempts" -lt "$max" ]; then
   396	    attempts=$((attempts + 1))
   397	    echo "$attempts" > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   398	    rm -f "$pend"
   399	    write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   400	    reason=$(printf 'Verification failed at step %s (attempt %s of %s). Last output:\n%s\n\nFix the cause and finish again; then rewrite the report.' "$step" "$attempts" "$max" "$out")
   401	    jq -n -c --arg r "$reason" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   402	    exit 0
   403	  fi
   404	  # cap reached: keep the worker's final report so `harness ask` exits 5 with it
   405	  [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   406	  write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   407	  exit 0
   408	}
   409	
   410	cmd_format() {
   411	  local input="" file="${1:-}" tool cwd q out fcmd lcmd d
   412	  if [ -z "$file" ]; then
   413	    input=$(cat)
   414	    tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   415	    case "$tool" in
   416	      Edit|Write|MultiEdit) ;;
   417	      *) exit 0 ;;
   418	    esac
   419	    file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   420	    cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   421	    set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   422	  else
   423	    cwd=""
   424	  fi
   425	  enter_root "$cwd"
   426	  [ -n "$file" ] || exit 0
   427	  case "$file" in
   428	    /*)
   429	      # compare physical paths (macOS /var -> /private/var)
   430	      d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${file%/*}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0
   431	      file="$d/${file##*/}"
   432	      case "$file" in
   433	        "$ROOT"/*) file=${file#"$ROOT"/} ;;
   434	        *) exit 0 ;;
   435	      esac ;;
   436	  esac
   437	  case "$file" in .harness/*|.git/*|*/../*|../*) exit 0 ;; esac
   438	  [ -f "$file" ] || exit 0
   439	  fcmd=$(resolve_step format)
   440	  if [ -n "$fcmd" ]; then
   441	    case "$fcmd" in
   442	      *'{files}'*)
   443	        q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   444	        fcmd=$(expand_files "$fcmd" "$q") ;;
   445	    esac
   446	    [ -z "$fcmd" ] || /bin/bash -c "$fcmd" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   447	  fi
   448	  lcmd=$(resolve_step lint)
   449	  case "$lcmd" in
   450	    *'{files}'*)
   451	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   452	      lcmd=$(expand_files "$lcmd" "$q")
   453	      if ! out=$(/bin/bash -c "$lcmd" </dev/null 2>&1); then
   454	        out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -n 40)
   455	        jq -n -c --arg r "$(printf 'Lint failed for %s:\n%s' "$file" "$out")" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   456	      fi ;;
   457	  esac
   458	  exit 0
   459	}
   460	
   461	case "${1:-}" in
   462	  detect)   enter_root; cmd_detect ;;
   463	  format)   shift; cmd_format "$@" ;;
   464	  stop)     cmd_stop ;;
   465	  done)     shift; cmd_done "$@" ;;
   466	  run)      shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
   467	  baseline) shift; cmd_baseline "$@" ;;
   468	  *)
   469	    echo "usage: harness-verify detect | format [file] | stop | done ROLE | run [lint|test|all] | baseline [agent]" >&2
   470	    exit 1 ;;
   471	esac
   472	exit $?
   473	}

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-run <role> <ask-id> <root> — run ONE headless worker ask, detached.
     6	# Started by `harness ask`; not for the conductor (the gate only matches `harness`, and this
     7	# refuses to run without HARNESS_ROLE=worker).
     8	# Reads  .harness/asks/<role>.prompt  and  .run (resume=, max_s=).

   154	     result: ($r.subtype // null), is_error: ($r.is_error // null),
   155	     num_turns: ($r.num_turns // null), cost_usd: ($r.total_cost_usd // null),

     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-view — render a `claude -p --output-format stream-json` stream (stdin) as a human view.
     6	# Never fails on odd input: non-JSON lines and unknown event types print nothing.
     7	c=0
     8	if [ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ] && [ -t 1 ]; then c=1; fi
     9	exec jq -R --unbuffered -r --arg c "$c" '
    10	  def col($n; $s): if $c == "1" then "\u001b[\($n)m\($s)\u001b[0m" else $s end;
    11	  def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    12	  def cut($n): if length > $n then .[0:$n] else . end;
    13	  def short: (.command // .file_path // .pattern // .url // .description // (. | tostring)) | first_line | cut(120);
    14	  def money: ((.total_cost_usd // 0) * 100 | round) as $n | "\($n / 100 | floor).\(($n % 100) | tostring | if length < 2 then "0" + . else . end)";
    15	  def content_text: if type == "string" then . elif type == "array" then (map(.text? // (. | tostring)) | join(" ")) else (. | tostring) end;
    16	  # a failed tool result: first line, then (multi-line output, e.g. a failing test run) its last 5 lines
    17	  def failed_result:
    18	    (.content // "") | content_text | split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S"))) as $l
    19	    | "✗ \(($l[0] // "") | cut(200))"
    20	      + (if ($l | length) > 1 then "\n" + ($l[(if ($l | length) > 6 then -5 else 1 end):] | map("  | " + cut(200)) | join("\n")) else "" end);
    21	  # a hook that exited 0 can still block with {"decision":"block","reason":...} on stdout
    22	  def hook_block: ((.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block") | (.reason // "blocked")) // null;
    23	  fromjson? | try (
    24	    if .type == "system" and .subtype == "init" then
    25	      "▶ \(.model // "?") · session \((.session_id // "") | .[0:8]) · perm \(.permissionMode // "?") · \(.cwd // "")"
    26	    elif .type == "assistant" then
    27	      (.message.content // [])[]
    28	      | if .type == "text" then (.text // empty)
    29	        elif .type == "tool_use" then "→ \(.name // "?") \((.input // {}) | short)"
    30	        else empty end
    31	    elif .type == "user" then
    32	      (.message.content // [])[]
    33	      | select(.type == "tool_result" and .is_error == true)
    34	      | col("31"; failed_result)
    35	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "permission_denied" then
    36	      col("31"; "⛔ denied \(.tool_name // "?"): \(.decision_reason // .message // "" | first_line | cut(160))")
    37	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_started" and .hook_event == "Stop" then
    38	      "⧗ verify (Stop hook)…"
    39	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_response" and ((.exit_code // 0) != 0) then
    40	      "hook \(.hook_name // "?") exit \(.exit_code): \((.stderr // "") | first_line | cut(120))"
    41	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_response" and (hook_block != null) then
    42	      col("33"; "⟲ \(.hook_event // .hook_name // "hook") block: \(hook_block | first_line | cut(160))")
    43	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_response" and .hook_event == "Stop" then
    44	      "✓ verify done"
    45	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "task_started" then
    46	      "⧗ bg \(.description // "")"
    47	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "task_notification" then
    48	      "⧗ bg \(.status // "")"
    49	    elif .type == "result" then
    50	      "■ \(.subtype // "?") · \(.num_turns // 0) turns · \(((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor)s · $\(money) · denials \((.permission_denials // []) | length)"
    51	      + (if .is_error == true then col("31"; " ERROR") else "" end)
    52	    else empty end
    53	  ) catch empty
    54	'
    55	exit $?
    56	}
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# SessionStart hook for the conductor (matcher: startup|clear|compact).
     3	# Injects .harness/progress.md as additionalContext so a /clear, compaction or
     4	# crash recovery resumes from the durable progress log. Silent for workers
     5	# (HARNESS_ROLE=worker), when there is nothing to inject, or when jq is unavailable.
     6	# Also appends the `(active,` lines of docs/wiki/index.md (at most WIKI_MAX bytes,
     7	# default 2048, then a "… see docs/wiki/index.md" line). Workers get no SessionStart
     8	# injection; they rely on the AGENTS.md pointer to the wiki index.
     9	# Does nothing outside a harness checkout (no .harness/asks/ between the cwd and
    10	# the repo top; decision 0010): no progress, no wiki, so it never injects into a repo
    11	# that does not use the harness. Reads under the checkout root.
    12	# Never fails: a SessionStart hook must not block a session.
    13	[ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" = worker ] && exit 0
    14	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    15	
    16	dir=$PWD
    17	if [ ! -t 0 ]; then
    18	  c=$(cat 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    19	  [ -z "$c" ] || [ ! -d "$c" ] || dir=$c
    20	fi
    21	# lib/harness-root.sh holds the one harness_root. Hooks are not symlinked (install.sh writes
    22	# the repo paths into settings.json), so the lib sits at a fixed place next to this file.
    23	case ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} in */*) hd=${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*} ;; *) hd=. ;; esac   # run as `bash name` from its dir
    24	. "$(CDPATH= cd -P "$hd/../../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || LIB_MISSING=1
    25	# end loader
    26	[ -z "${LIB_MISSING:-}" ] || exit 0
    27	root=$(harness_root "$dir") || exit 0
    28	f="$root/.harness/progress.md"
    29	ctx=""
    30	if [ -s "$f" ]; then
    31	  ctx=$(printf 'Harness progress (resume from here; verify with harness status)\n'; cat "$f"; printf x)
    32	  ctx=${ctx%x}
    33	fi
    34	
    35	WIKI_HEADER="Wiki (active pages; read docs/wiki/index.md, open a page only when relevant)"
    36	# wiki_lines <index> — active lines, capped so header + lines fit in WIKI_MAX bytes
    37	wiki_lines() {
    38	  LC_ALL=C awk -v max="${WIKI_MAX:-2048}" -v hdr="${#WIKI_HEADER}" '
    39	    BEGIN { max -= hdr + 1; note = "… see docs/wiki/index.md"; used = 0 }
    40	    index($0, "(active,") {
    41	      if (cut) next
    42	      if (used + length($0) + 1 > max - length(note) - 1) { cut = 1; next }
    43	      print; used += length($0) + 1
    44	    }
    45	    END { if (cut) print note }
    46	  ' "$1"
    47	}
    48	w="$root/docs/wiki/index.md"
    49	if [ -s "$w" ]; then
    50	  wl=$(wiki_lines "$w")
    51	  if [ -n "$wl" ]; then
    52	    [ -z "$ctx" ] || ctx="$ctx
    53	"
    54	    ctx="${ctx}$WIKI_HEADER
    55	$wl
    56	"
    57	  fi
    58	fi
    59	[ -n "$ctx" ] || exit 0
    60	
    61	printf '%s' "$ctx" \
    62	  | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}' 2>/dev/null
    63	exit 0
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Notification hook for the conductor: a macOS desktop notification when Claude Code
     3	# waits for the user. Registered globally with the matcher permission_prompt|idle_prompt|
     4	# elicitation_dialog|elicitation_url_dialog|agent_needs_input. Like the gate, it acts only
     5	# when the hook input says agent_type == conductor (workers and plain sessions: no call;
     6	# an inherited HARNESS_ROLE=worker does not matter). Title names the work folder (basename
     7	# of the input's cwd), body is the input's message. Silent without osascript or jq.
     8	# Never fails.
     9	command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    10	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    11	in=$(cat 2>/dev/null)
    12	[ "$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r 'if type == "object" then (.agent_type // empty) else empty end' 2>/dev/null)" = conductor ] || exit 0
    13	msg=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.message // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    14	cwd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    15	[ -n "$cwd" ] || cwd=$PWD
    16	[ -n "$msg" ] || msg="Claude needs your attention"
    17	# AppleScript string literal: escape backslash and double quote, flatten newlines
    18	esc() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\n\r' '  ' | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g'; }
    19	osascript -e "display notification \"$(esc "$msg")\" with title \"Claude: $(esc "${cwd##*/}")\"" >/dev/null 2>&1
    20	exit 0

   151	        {tool: (.tool_name // "?"), input: ((.tool_input.command? // .tool_input.file_path? // "") | tostring | split("\n")[0] | .[0:120]), reason: ""})))
   152	     end) as $den

   154	     result: ($r.subtype // null), is_error: ($r.is_error // null),
   155	     num_turns: ($r.num_turns // null), cost_usd: ($r.total_cost_usd // null),
   156	     duration_ms: ($r.duration_ms // null),
   157	     session_id: ($init.session_id // $r.session_id // null),

   164	     stop_hook: any($e[]; .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_started" and .hook_event == "Stop"),

   171	printf '=== exit %s ===\n' "$rc"

     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-view — render a `claude -p --output-format stream-json` stream (stdin) as a human view.
     6	# Never fails on odd input: non-JSON lines and unknown event types print nothing.
     7	c=0
     8	if [ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ] && [ -t 1 ]; then c=1; fi
     9	exec jq -R --unbuffered -r --arg c "$c" '
    10	  def col($n; $s): if $c == "1" then "\u001b[\($n)m\($s)\u001b[0m" else $s end;
    11	  def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    12	  def cut($n): if length > $n then .[0:$n] else . end;
    13	  def short: (.command // .file_path // .pattern // .url // .description // (. | tostring)) | first_line | cut(120);
    14	  def money: ((.total_cost_usd // 0) * 100 | round) as $n | "\($n / 100 | floor).\(($n % 100) | tostring | if length < 2 then "0" + . else . end)";
    15	  def content_text: if type == "string" then . elif type == "array" then (map(.text? // (. | tostring)) | join(" ")) else (. | tostring) end;
    16	  # a failed tool result: first line, then (multi-line output, e.g. a failing test run) its last 5 lines
    17	  def failed_result:
    18	    (.content // "") | content_text | split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S"))) as $l
    19	    | "✗ \(($l[0] // "") | cut(200))"
    20	      + (if ($l | length) > 1 then "\n" + ($l[(if ($l | length) > 6 then -5 else 1 end):] | map("  | " + cut(200)) | join("\n")) else "" end);
    21	  # a hook that exited 0 can still block with {"decision":"block","reason":...} on stdout
    22	  def hook_block: ((.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block") | (.reason // "blocked")) // null;
    23	  fromjson? | try (
    24	    if .type == "system" and .subtype == "init" then
    25	      "▶ \(.model // "?") · session \((.session_id // "") | .[0:8]) · perm \(.permissionMode // "?") · \(.cwd // "")"
    26	    elif .type == "assistant" then
    27	      (.message.content // [])[]
    28	      | if .type == "text" then (.text // empty)
    29	        elif .type == "tool_use" then "→ \(.name // "?") \((.input // {}) | short)"
    30	        else empty end
    31	    elif .type == "user" then
    32	      (.message.content // [])[]
    33	      | select(.type == "tool_result" and .is_error == true)
    34	      | col("31"; failed_result)
    35	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "permission_denied" then
    36	      col("31"; "⛔ denied \(.tool_name // "?"): \(.decision_reason // .message // "" | first_line | cut(160))")
    37	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_started" and .hook_event == "Stop" then
    38	      "⧗ verify (Stop hook)…"
    39	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_response" and ((.exit_code // 0) != 0) then
    40	      "hook \(.hook_name // "?") exit \(.exit_code): \((.stderr // "") | first_line | cut(120))"
    41	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_response" and (hook_block != null) then
    42	      col("33"; "⟲ \(.hook_event // .hook_name // "hook") block: \(hook_block | first_line | cut(160))")
    43	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_response" and .hook_event == "Stop" then
    44	      "✓ verify done"
    45	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "task_started" then
    46	      "⧗ bg \(.description // "")"
    47	    elif .type == "system" and .subtype == "task_notification" then
    48	      "⧗ bg \(.status // "")"
    49	    elif .type == "result" then
    50	      "■ \(.subtype // "?") · \(.num_turns // 0) turns · \(((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor)s · $\(money) · denials \((.permission_denials // []) | length)"
    51	      + (if .is_error == true then col("31"; " ERROR") else "" end)
    52	    else empty end
    53	  ) catch empty
    54	'
    55	exit $?
    56	}
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# SessionStart hook for the conductor (matcher: startup|clear|compact).
     3	# Injects .harness/progress.md as additionalContext so a /clear, compaction or
     4	# crash recovery resumes from the durable progress log. Silent for workers
     5	# (HARNESS_ROLE=worker), when there is nothing to inject, or when jq is unavailable.
     6	# Also appends the `(active,` lines of docs/wiki/index.md (at most WIKI_MAX bytes,
     7	# default 2048, then a "… see docs/wiki/index.md" line). Workers get no SessionStart
     8	# injection; they rely on the AGENTS.md pointer to the wiki index.
     9	# Does nothing outside a harness checkout (no .harness/asks/ between the cwd and
    10	# the repo top; decision 0010): no progress, no wiki, so it never injects into a repo
    11	# that does not use the harness. Reads under the checkout root.
    12	# Never fails: a SessionStart hook must not block a session.
    13	[ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" = worker ] && exit 0
    14	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    15	
    16	dir=$PWD
    17	if [ ! -t 0 ]; then
    18	  c=$(cat 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    19	  [ -z "$c" ] || [ ! -d "$c" ] || dir=$c
    20	fi
    21	# lib/harness-root.sh holds the one harness_root. Hooks are not symlinked (install.sh writes
    22	# the repo paths into settings.json), so the lib sits at a fixed place next to this file.
    23	case ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} in */*) hd=${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*} ;; *) hd=. ;; esac   # run as `bash name` from its dir
    24	. "$(CDPATH= cd -P "$hd/../../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || LIB_MISSING=1
    25	# end loader
    26	[ -z "${LIB_MISSING:-}" ] || exit 0
    27	root=$(harness_root "$dir") || exit 0
    28	f="$root/.harness/progress.md"
    29	ctx=""
    30	if [ -s "$f" ]; then
    31	  ctx=$(printf 'Harness progress (resume from here; verify with harness status)\n'; cat "$f"; printf x)
    32	  ctx=${ctx%x}
    33	fi
    34	
    35	WIKI_HEADER="Wiki (active pages; read docs/wiki/index.md, open a page only when relevant)"
    36	# wiki_lines <index> — active lines, capped so header + lines fit in WIKI_MAX bytes
    37	wiki_lines() {
    38	  LC_ALL=C awk -v max="${WIKI_MAX:-2048}" -v hdr="${#WIKI_HEADER}" '
    39	    BEGIN { max -= hdr + 1; note = "… see docs/wiki/index.md"; used = 0 }
    40	    index($0, "(active,") {
    41	      if (cut) next
    42	      if (used + length($0) + 1 > max - length(note) - 1) { cut = 1; next }
    43	      print; used += length($0) + 1
    44	    }
    45	    END { if (cut) print note }
    46	  ' "$1"
    47	}
    48	w="$root/docs/wiki/index.md"
    49	if [ -s "$w" ]; then
    50	  wl=$(wiki_lines "$w")
    51	  if [ -n "$wl" ]; then
    52	    [ -z "$ctx" ] || ctx="$ctx
    53	"
    54	    ctx="${ctx}$WIKI_HEADER
    55	$wl
    56	"
    57	  fi
    58	fi
    59	[ -n "$ctx" ] || exit 0
    60	
    61	printf '%s' "$ctx" \
    62	  | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}' 2>/dev/null
    63	exit 0
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Notification hook for the conductor: a macOS desktop notification when Claude Code
     3	# waits for the user. Registered globally with the matcher permission_prompt|idle_prompt|
     4	# elicitation_dialog|elicitation_url_dialog|agent_needs_input. Like the gate, it acts only
     5	# when the hook input says agent_type == conductor (workers and plain sessions: no call;
     6	# an inherited HARNESS_ROLE=worker does not matter). Title names the work folder (basename
     7	# of the input's cwd), body is the input's message. Silent without osascript or jq.
     8	# Never fails.
     9	command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    10	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    11	in=$(cat 2>/dev/null)
    12	[ "$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r 'if type == "object" then (.agent_type // empty) else empty end' 2>/dev/null)" = conductor ] || exit 0
    13	msg=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.message // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    14	cwd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    15	[ -n "$cwd" ] || cwd=$PWD
    16	[ -n "$msg" ] || msg="Claude needs your attention"
    17	# AppleScript string literal: escape backslash and double quote, flatten newlines
    18	esc() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\n\r' '  ' | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g'; }
    19	osascript -e "display notification \"$(esc "$msg")\" with title \"Claude: $(esc "${cwd##*/}")\"" >/dev/null 2>&1
    20	exit 0

   146	        prev: stat($all | map(select(.t >= $start - $len and .t < $start))),

   149	      def pad($n): tostring | . + ([range(0; $n - length) | " "] | join(""));

   157	      | [ "harness metrics  \(.window.start) .. \(.window.end) (\(.window.days)d)  vs  \(.previous.start) .. \(.previous.end)",
   158	          "",

   162	          row("late reports"; .current.total.late; .prev.total.late),
   163	          row("abnormal rate (exit not 0/5, late)"; (.current.total.abnormal_rate | pc); (.prev.total.abnormal_rate | pc)),
   164	          ($roles[] as $r | row("  \($r)"; (.current.roles[$r].abnormal_rate | pc); (.prev.roles[$r].abnormal_rate | pc))),
   165	          row("implementer verify-failure rate"; (.current.roles.implementer.verify_failure_rate | pc); (.prev.roles.implementer.verify_failure_rate | pc)),

   169	          row("reviewer FAIL rate"; (.current.roles.reviewer.fail_rate | pc); (.prev.roles.reviewer.fail_rate | pc)),
   170	          ($roles[] as $r | row("duration median / p95  \($r)"; (.current.roles[$r] | dur); (.prev.roles[$r] | dur))),
   171	          "",
   172	          (if ((.current.by_runner | keys) + (.prev.by_runner | keys) | any(endswith("/headless"))) then
   173	            "  runner split (agent/runner: asks, abnormal, duration median, cost sum, startup median)",
   174	            ((.current.by_runner | to_entries[]) | "    \(.key | pad(24)) \(.value.asks) asks · abn \(.value.abnormal) · \(.value | dur) · $\(.value.cost_usd_sum) · startup \(.value.startup_s_median | f)s")
   175	           else empty end),
   176	          "  exits current:  \(.current.total.exit | dist)",
   177	          "  exits previous: \(.prev.total.exit | dist)",
   178	          "",

     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# install.sh — wire this repo into ~/.claude as the conductor setup:
     3	# agent and skill symlinks, the harness CLI, and settings.json (gate hook,
     4	# resume hook, cache TTLs, Bash timeouts). It no longer sets
     5	# the global `agent` key (a previous `agent: conductor` is removed once): the
     6	# conductor role is per repo, set by `harness init` in .claude/settings.json.
     7	# Idempotent. Re-run after pulling changes.
     8	#
     9	#   ./install.sh          install
    10	#   ./install.sh --test   run the test suites (in parallel) and exit
    11	#                         HARNESS_TEST_SERIAL=1 runs them one at a time;
    12	#                         HARNESS_TEST_TIMEOUT=N caps each suite (default 300 s)
    13	#
    14	# Overridable for tests: CLAUDE_DIR, BIN_DIR
    15	set -eu
    16	
    17	REPO=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
    18	CLAUDE_DIR=${CLAUDE_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}
    19	BIN_DIR=${BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}
    20	SETTINGS="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"
    21	GATE="$REPO/claude/hooks/conductor-gate.sh"
    22	RESUME="$REPO/claude/hooks/conductor-resume.sh"
    23	NOTIFY="$REPO/claude/hooks/notify-decision.sh"
    24	MATCHER="Edit|Write|Read|Grep|Glob|Bash"
    25	
    26	die() { echo "install: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
    27	need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "$1 is required but not on PATH"; }
    28	
    29	if [ "${1:-}" = "--test" ]; then
    30	  # Suites run in parallel (each buffers to its own file; output is printed per
    31	  # suite in finish order). HARNESS_TEST_SERIAL=1 runs them one by one, still
    32	  # running every suite. Each suite has a wall-clock limit (HARNESS_TEST_TIMEOUT,
    33	  # seconds, default 300); a suite over it has its process tree killed and is
    34	  # reported as failed. HARNESS_TESTS_DIR points the runner at another directory
    35	  # of *.test.sh files (used by the runner's own tests; skips the wiki-lint step).
    36	  tests_dir=${HARNESS_TESTS_DIR:-$REPO/tests}
    37	  limit=${HARNESS_TEST_TIMEOUT:-300}
    38	  case "$limit" in ''|*[!0-9]*) limit=300 ;; esac
    39	  # suites are discovered by glob: every <tests_dir>/*.test.sh (helper files such as
    40	  # harness-lib.sh do not match); the real wiki check runs as the extra `wikilint`
    41	  names=""
    42	  for f in "$tests_dir"/*.test.sh; do
    43	    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    44	    b=$(basename "$f"); names="$names ${b%.test.sh}"
    45	  done
    46	  names=${names# }
    47	  if [ -n "${HARNESS_TESTS_DIR:-}" ]; then
    48	    echo "install: HARNESS_TESTS_DIR set: running suites from $tests_dir; wiki-lint skipped" >&2
    49	  else
    50	    names="$names wikilint"
    51	  fi
    52	  tdir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-tests.XXXXXX")
    53	  descendants() {  # descendants PID — every transitive child, one per line
    54	    local c
    55	    for c in $(pgrep -P "$1" 2>/dev/null || true); do echo "$c"; descendants "$c"; done
    56	  }
    57	  killtree() {  # killtree PID — stop PID first (so it cannot record a result), then its tree
    58	    local rest
    59	    rest=$(descendants "$1" | tr '\n' ' ')
    60	    kill -TERM "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
    61	    [ -z "$rest" ] || kill -TERM $rest 2>/dev/null || true
    62	    sleep 0.3
    63	    kill -KILL "$1" $rest 2>/dev/null || true
    64	  }
    65	  kill_all() {
    66	    local f
    67	    for f in "$tdir"/*.pid; do
    68	      [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    69	      killtree "$(cat "$f")"
    70	    done
    71	  }
    72	  trap 'rm -rf "$tdir"' EXIT
    73	  trap 'kill_all; exit 130' INT
    74	  trap 'kill_all; exit 143' TERM
    75	  trap 'kill_all; exit 129' HUP
    76	  run_one() {  # run_one NAME — output to $tdir/NAME.out, exit code to $tdir/NAME.rc (always written)
    77	    set +e  # a failing suite must still record its exit code
    78	    case "$1" in
    79	      wikilint) /bin/bash "$REPO/bin/harness" wiki-lint "$REPO/docs/wiki" ;;  # the real wiki: a bad page fails CI
    80	      *) /bin/bash "$tests_dir/$1.test.sh" ;;
    81	    esac > "$tdir/$1.out" 2>&1
    82	    local r=$?
    83	    echo "$r" > "$tdir/$1.rc.tmp"
    84	    mv "$tdir/$1.rc.tmp" "$tdir/$1.rc"
    85	    rm -f "$tdir/$1.pid"  # finished: bash reaps us, so the pid may be reused; kill_all must not see it
    86	  }
    87	  rc=0; failed=""
    88	  report() {  # report NAME — print its block, record failure
    89	    local r
    90	    r=$(cat "$tdir/$1.rc")
    91	    rm -f "$tdir/$1.pid"  # backstop: run_one may finish before the parent wrote the pid file
    92	    echo "=== $1 ==="; cat "$tdir/$1.out"
    93	    if [ "$r" != 0 ]; then rc=1; failed="$failed $1"; echo "--- $1 FAILED (exit $r) ---"; fi
    94	  }
    95	  maxjobs=1000
    96	  [ "${HARNESS_TEST_SERIAL:-0}" != 1 ] || maxjobs=1
    97	  queue=$names; running=""; nrun=0
    98	  while [ -n "$queue" ] || [ -n "$running" ]; do
    99	    while [ -n "$queue" ] && [ "$nrun" -lt "$maxjobs" ]; do
   100	      n=${queue%% *}
   101	      case "$queue" in *" "*) queue=${queue#* } ;; *) queue="" ;; esac
   102	      run_one "$n" &
   103	      echo $! > "$tdir/$n.pid"
   104	      date +%s > "$tdir/$n.start"
   105	      running="$running $n"; nrun=$((nrun + 1))
   106	    done
   107	    still=""; nrun=0; now=$(date +%s)
   108	    for n in $running; do
   109	      pid=$(cat "$tdir/$n.pid" 2>/dev/null || true)  # gone once run_one has finished
   110	      if [ -f "$tdir/$n.rc" ]; then
   111	        report "$n"
   112	      elif [ -z "$pid" ] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
   113	        if [ ! -f "$tdir/$n.rc" ]; then  # died without recording (e.g. killed from outside)
   114	          echo "suite process $pid vanished without an exit code" >> "$tdir/$n.out"
   115	          echo 1 > "$tdir/$n.rc"
   116	        fi
   117	        report "$n"
   118	      elif [ $((now - $(cat "$tdir/$n.start"))) -ge "$limit" ]; then
   119	        killtree "$pid"
   120	        echo "suite $n timed out after ${limit}s (killed)" >> "$tdir/$n.out"
   121	        echo 124 > "$tdir/$n.rc"
   122	        report "$n"
   123	      else
   124	        still="$still $n"; nrun=$((nrun + 1))
   125	      fi
   126	    done
   127	    running=${still# }
   128	    [ -z "$queue" ] && [ -z "$running" ] || sleep 0.2
   129	  done
   130	  wait
   131	  [ -z "$failed" ] || echo "FAILED suites:$failed"
   132	  exit $rc
   133	fi
   134

   136	
   137	# 0. validate before modifying anything

   139	[ -f "$SETTINGS" ] || echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS"

   142	  || die "$SETTINGS is not a JSON object (or holds more than one value); fix it before installing"
   143	
   144	# 2. agents + skills + harness symlinks

   147	  [ -e "$f" ] || continue

   176	esac
   177	
   178	# 3. settings.json: cache TTLs + exactly one entry each for the gate, resume and notify hooks
   179	bak="$SETTINGS.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
   180	cp "$SETTINGS" "$bak"
   181	tmp=$(mktemp)
   182	trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
   183	if [ "$(jq -r '.agent // empty' "$SETTINGS")" = conductor ]; then
   184	  echo "note: removed the global agent=conductor from $SETTINGS; run 'harness init' in each repo that should use the conductor"
   185	fi
   186	jq --arg gate "$GATE" --arg matcher "$MATCHER" --arg resume "$RESUME" --arg notify "$NOTIFY" '
   187	  (if .agent == "conductor" then del(.agent) else . end)
   188	  | .promptCacheTtl = "1h"
   189	  | .subagentPromptCacheTtl = "1h"
   190	  | .env //= {}
   191	  | .env.BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = "600000"
   192	  | .env.BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS = "7200000"
   193	  | .hooks //= {}
   194	  | .hooks.PreToolUse //= []
   195	  # strip our gate from every entry; drop entries left empty; re-append one canonical entry
   196	  | .hooks.PreToolUse |= map(if any(.hooks[]?; .command == $gate) then (.hooks |= map(select(.command != $gate))) | select((.hooks | length) > 0) else . end)
   197	  | .hooks.PreToolUse += [{matcher: $matcher, hooks: [{type: "command", command: $gate}]}]
   198	  # same for the SessionStart resume hook (other SessionStart hooks stay)
   199	  | .hooks.SessionStart //= []
   200	  | .hooks.SessionStart |= map(if any(.hooks[]?; .command == $resume) then (.hooks |= map(select(.command != $resume))) | select((.hooks | length) > 0) else . end)
   201	  | .hooks.SessionStart += [{matcher: "startup|clear|compact", hooks: [{type: "command", command: $resume}]}]
   202	  # same for the Notification hook (desktop notification when the conductor waits for the user)
   203	  | .hooks.Notification //= []
   204	  | .hooks.Notification |= map(if any(.hooks[]?; .command == $notify) then (.hooks |= map(select(.command != $notify))) | select((.hooks | length) > 0) else . end)
   205	  | .hooks.Notification += [{matcher: "permission_prompt|idle_prompt|elicitation_dialog|elicitation_url_dialog|agent_needs_input", hooks: [{type: "command", command: $notify}]}]
   206	' "$SETTINGS" > "$tmp"
   207	cat "$tmp" > "$SETTINGS" || die "failed to write $SETTINGS; restore from $bak"
   208	
   209	cat <<EOF
   210	installed:
   211	  gate hook      $GATE  (matcher: $MATCHER)
   212	  resume hook    $RESUME  (SessionStart: startup|clear|compact)
   213	  notify hook    $NOTIFY  (Notification: permission_prompt|idle_prompt|elicitation_dialog|elicitation_url_dialog|agent_needs_input)

     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# install.sh — wire this repo into ~/.claude as the conductor setup:
     3	# agent and skill symlinks, the harness CLI, and settings.json (gate hook,
     4	# resume hook, cache TTLs, Bash timeouts). It no longer sets
     5	# the global `agent` key (a previous `agent: conductor` is removed once): the
     6	# conductor role is per repo, set by `harness init` in .claude/settings.json.
     7	# Idempotent. Re-run after pulling changes.
     8	#
     9	#   ./install.sh          install
    10	#   ./install.sh --test   run the test suites (in parallel) and exit
    11	#                         HARNESS_TEST_SERIAL=1 runs them one at a time;
    12	#                         HARNESS_TEST_TIMEOUT=N caps each suite (default 300 s)
    13	#
    14	# Overridable for tests: CLAUDE_DIR, BIN_DIR

    16	
    17	REPO=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
    18	CLAUDE_DIR=${CLAUDE_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}
    19	BIN_DIR=${BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}
    20	SETTINGS="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"
    21	GATE="$REPO/claude/hooks/conductor-gate.sh"
    22	RESUME="$REPO/claude/hooks/conductor-resume.sh"
    23	NOTIFY="$REPO/claude/hooks/notify-decision.sh"
    24	MATCHER="Edit|Write|Read|Grep|Glob|Bash"
    25	
    26	die() { echo "install: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
    27	need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "$1 is required but not on PATH"; }
    28	
    29	if [ "${1:-}" = "--test" ]; then
    30	  # Suites run in parallel (each buffers to its own file; output is printed per
    31	  # suite in finish order). HARNESS_TEST_SERIAL=1 runs them one by one, still
    32	  # running every suite. Each suite has a wall-clock limit (HARNESS_TEST_TIMEOUT,
    33	  # seconds, default 300); a suite over it has its process tree killed and is
    34	  # reported as failed. HARNESS_TESTS_DIR points the runner at another directory
    35	  # of *.test.sh files (used by the runner's own tests; skips the wiki-lint step).
    36	  tests_dir=${HARNESS_TESTS_DIR:-$REPO/tests}
    37	  limit=${HARNESS_TEST_TIMEOUT:-300}
    38	  case "$limit" in ''|*[!0-9]*) limit=300 ;; esac
    39	  # suites are discovered by glob: every <tests_dir>/*.test.sh (helper files such as
    40	  # harness-lib.sh do not match); the real wiki check runs as the extra `wikilint`
    41	  names=""
    42	  for f in "$tests_dir"/*.test.sh; do
    43	    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    44	    b=$(basename "$f"); names="$names ${b%.test.sh}"

    46	  names=${names# }
    47	  if [ -n "${HARNESS_TESTS_DIR:-}" ]; then
    48	    echo "install: HARNESS_TESTS_DIR set: running suites from $tests_dir; wiki-lint skipped" >&2

    50	    names="$names wikilint"
    51	  fi
    52	  tdir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-tests.XXXXXX")
    53	  descendants() {  # descendants PID — every transitive child, one per line
    54	    local c
    55	    for c in $(pgrep -P "$1" 2>/dev/null || true); do echo "$c"; descendants "$c"; done
    56	  }
    57	  killtree() {  # killtree PID — stop PID first (so it cannot record a result), then its tree
    58	    local rest
    59	    rest=$(descendants "$1" | tr '\n' ' ')
    60	    kill -TERM "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
    61	    [ -z "$rest" ] || kill -TERM $rest 2>/dev/null || true
    62	    sleep 0.3
    63	    kill -KILL "$1" $rest 2>/dev/null || true
    64	  }
    65	  kill_all() {
    66	    local f
    67	    for f in "$tdir"/*.pid; do

    70	    done

    73	  trap 'kill_all; exit 130' INT
    74	  trap 'kill_all; exit 143' TERM
    75	  trap 'kill_all; exit 129' HUP

    77	    set +e  # a failing suite must still record its exit code
    78	    case "$1" in
    79	      wikilint) /bin/bash "$REPO/bin/harness" wiki-lint "$REPO/docs/wiki" ;;  # the real wiki: a bad page fails CI

   117	        report "$n"
